7646// TODO(syoyo): refactor function.
7647static bool exportGroupsToShape(shape_t *shape, const PrimGroup &prim_group,
7648 const std::vector<tag_t> &tags,
7649 const int material_id, const std::string &name,
7650 bool triangulate, const std::vector<real_t> &v,
7651 std::string *warn) {
7652 if (prim_group.IsEmpty()) {
7653 return false;
7654 }
7655
7656 shape->name = name;
7657
7658 // polygon
7659 if (!prim_group.faceGroup.empty()) {
7660 // Flatten vertices and indices
7661 for (size_t i = 0; i < prim_group.faceGroup.size(); i++) {
7662 const face_t &face = prim_group.faceGroup[i];
7663
7664 size_t npolys = face.vertex_indices.size();
7665
7666 if (npolys < 3) {
7667 // Face must have 3+ vertices.
7668 if (warn) {
7669 (*warn) += "Degenerated face found\n.";
7670 }
7671 continue;
7672 }
7673
7674 if (triangulate && npolys != 3) {
7675 if (npolys == 4) {
7676 vertex_index_t i0 = face.vertex_indices[0];
7677 vertex_index_t i1 = face.vertex_indices[1];
7678 vertex_index_t i2 = face.vertex_indices[2];
7679 vertex_index_t i3 = face.vertex_indices[3];
7680
7681 if (i0.v_idx < 0 || i1.v_idx < 0 || i2.v_idx < 0 || i3.v_idx < 0) {
7682 if (warn) {
7683 (*warn) += "Face with invalid vertex index found.\n";
7684 }
7685 continue;
7686 }
7687
7688 size_t vi0 = size_t(i0.v_idx);
7689 size_t vi1 = size_t(i1.v_idx);
7690 size_t vi2 = size_t(i2.v_idx);
7691 size_t vi3 = size_t(i3.v_idx);
7692
7693 if (((3 * vi0 + 2) >= v.size()) || ((3 * vi1 + 2) >= v.size()) ||
7694 ((3 * vi2 + 2) >= v.size()) || ((3 * vi3 + 2) >= v.size())) {
7695 // Invalid triangle.
7696 // FIXME(syoyo): Is it ok to simply skip this invalid triangle?
7697 if (warn) {
7698 (*warn) += "Face with invalid vertex index found.\n";
7699 }
7700 continue;
7701 }
7702
7703 real_t v0x = v[vi0 * 3 + 0];
7704 real_t v0y = v[vi0 * 3 + 1];
7705 real_t v0z = v[vi0 * 3 + 2];
7706 real_t v1x = v[vi1 * 3 + 0];
7707 real_t v1y = v[vi1 * 3 + 1];
7708 real_t v1z = v[vi1 * 3 + 2];
7709 real_t v2x = v[vi2 * 3 + 0];
7710 real_t v2y = v[vi2 * 3 + 1];
7711 real_t v2z = v[vi2 * 3 + 2];
7712 real_t v3x = v[vi3 * 3 + 0];
7713 real_t v3y = v[vi3 * 3 + 1];
7714 real_t v3z = v[vi3 * 3 + 2];
7715
7716 // There are two candidates to split the quad into two triangles.
7717 //
7718 // Choose the shortest edge.
7719 // TODO: Is it better to determine the edge to split by calculating
7720 // the area of each triangle?
7721 //
7722 // +---+
7723 // |\ |
7724 // | \ |
7725 // | \|
7726 // +---+
7727 //
7728 // +---+
7729 // | /|
7730 // | / |
7731 // |/ |
7732 // +---+
7733
7734 real_t e02x = v2x - v0x;
7735 real_t e02y = v2y - v0y;
7736 real_t e02z = v2z - v0z;
7737 real_t e13x = v3x - v1x;
7738 real_t e13y = v3y - v1y;
7739 real_t e13z = v3z - v1z;
7740
7741 real_t sqr02 = e02x * e02x + e02y * e02y + e02z * e02z;
7742 real_t sqr13 = e13x * e13x + e13y * e13y + e13z * e13z;
7743
7744 index_t idx0, idx1, idx2, idx3;
7745
7746 idx0.vertex_index = i0.v_idx;
7747 idx0.normal_index = i0.vn_idx;
7748 idx0.texcoord_index = i0.vt_idx;
7749 idx1.vertex_index = i1.v_idx;
7750 idx1.normal_index = i1.vn_idx;
7751 idx1.texcoord_index = i1.vt_idx;
7752 idx2.vertex_index = i2.v_idx;
7753 idx2.normal_index = i2.vn_idx;
7754 idx2.texcoord_index = i2.vt_idx;
7755 idx3.vertex_index = i3.v_idx;
7756 idx3.normal_index = i3.vn_idx;
7757 idx3.texcoord_index = i3.vt_idx;
7758
7759 if (sqr02 < sqr13) {
7760 // [0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]
7761 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx0);
7762 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx1);
7763 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx2);
7764
7765 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx0);
7766 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx2);
7767 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx3);
7768 } else {
7769 // [0, 1, 3], [1, 2, 3]
7770 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx0);
7771 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx1);
7772 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx3);
7773
7774 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx1);
7775 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx2);
7776 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx3);
7777 }
7778
7779 // Two triangle faces
7780 shape->mesh.num_face_vertices.push_back(3);
7781 shape->mesh.num_face_vertices.push_back(3);
7782
7783 shape->mesh.material_ids.push_back(material_id);
7784 shape->mesh.material_ids.push_back(material_id);
7785
7786 shape->mesh.smoothing_group_ids.push_back(face.smoothing_group_id);
7787 shape->mesh.smoothing_group_ids.push_back(face.smoothing_group_id);
7788
7789 } else {
7790#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MAPBOX_EARCUT
7791 // Validate all vertex indices before accessing the vertex array.
7792 {
7793 bool valid_poly = true;
7794 for (size_t k = 0; k < npolys; ++k) {
7795 size_t vi = size_t(face.vertex_indices[k].v_idx);
7796 if ((3 * vi + 2) >= v.size()) {
7797 valid_poly = false;
7798 break;
7799 }
7800 }
7801 if (!valid_poly) {
7802 if (warn) {
7803 (*warn) += "Face with invalid vertex index found.\n";
7804 }
7805 continue;
7806 }
7807 }
7808
7809 vertex_index_t i0 = face.vertex_indices[0];
7810 vertex_index_t i0_2 = i0;
7811
7812 // TMW change: Find the normal axis of the polygon using Newell's
7813 // method
7814 TinyObjPoint n;
7815 for (size_t k = 0; k < npolys; ++k) {
7816 i0 = face.vertex_indices[k % npolys];
7817 size_t vi0 = size_t(i0.v_idx);
7818
7819 size_t j = (k + 1) % npolys;
7820 i0_2 = face.vertex_indices[j];
7821 size_t vi0_2 = size_t(i0_2.v_idx);
7822
7823 real_t v0x = v[vi0 * 3 + 0];
7824 real_t v0y = v[vi0 * 3 + 1];
7825 real_t v0z = v[vi0 * 3 + 2];
7826
7827 real_t v0x_2 = v[vi0_2 * 3 + 0];
7828 real_t v0y_2 = v[vi0_2 * 3 + 1];
7829 real_t v0z_2 = v[vi0_2 * 3 + 2];
7830
7831 const TinyObjPoint point1(v0x, v0y, v0z);
7832 const TinyObjPoint point2(v0x_2, v0y_2, v0z_2);
7833
7834 TinyObjPoint a(point1.x - point2.x, point1.y - point2.y,
7835 point1.z - point2.z);
7836 TinyObjPoint b(point1.x + point2.x, point1.y + point2.y,
7837 point1.z + point2.z);
7838
7839 n.x += (a.y * b.z);
7840 n.y += (a.z * b.x);
7841 n.z += (a.x * b.y);
7842 }
7843 real_t length_n = GetLength(n);
7844 // Check if zero length normal
7845 if (length_n <= 0) {
7846 continue;
7847 }
7848 // Negative is to flip the normal to the correct direction
7849 real_t inv_length = -real_t(1.0) / length_n;
7850 n.x *= inv_length;
7851 n.y *= inv_length;
7852 n.z *= inv_length;
7853
7854 TinyObjPoint axis_w, axis_v, axis_u;
7855 axis_w = n;
7856 TinyObjPoint a;
7857 if (std::fabs(axis_w.x) > real_t(0.9999999)) {
7858 a = TinyObjPoint(0, 1, 0);
7859 } else {
7860 a = TinyObjPoint(1, 0, 0);
7861 }
7862 axis_v = Normalize(cross(axis_w, a));
7863 axis_u = cross(axis_w, axis_v);
7864 using Point = std::array<real_t, 2>;
7865
7866 // first polyline define the main polygon.
7867 // following polylines define holes(not used in tinyobj).
7868 std::vector<std::vector<Point> > polygon;
7869
7870 std::vector<Point> polyline;
7871
7872 // TMW change: Find best normal and project v0x and v0y to those
7873 // coordinates, instead of picking a plane aligned with an axis (which
7874 // can flip polygons).
7875
7876 // Fill polygon data(facevarying vertices).
7877 for (size_t k = 0; k < npolys; k++) {
7878 i0 = face.vertex_indices[k];
7879 size_t vi0 = size_t(i0.v_idx);
7880
7881 assert(((3 * vi0 + 2) < v.size()));
7882
7883 real_t v0x = v[vi0 * 3 + 0];
7884 real_t v0y = v[vi0 * 3 + 1];
7885 real_t v0z = v[vi0 * 3 + 2];
7886
7887 TinyObjPoint polypoint(v0x, v0y, v0z);
7888 TinyObjPoint loc = WorldToLocal(polypoint, axis_u, axis_v, axis_w);
7889
7890 polyline.push_back({loc.x, loc.y});
7891 }
7892
7893 polygon.push_back(polyline);
7894 std::vector<uint32_t> indices = mapbox::earcut<uint32_t>(polygon);
7895 // => result = 3 * faces, clockwise
7896
7897 assert(indices.size() % 3 == 0);
7898
7899 // Reconstruct vertex_index_t
7900 for (size_t k = 0; k < indices.size() / 3; k++) {
7901 {
7902 index_t idx0, idx1, idx2;
7903 idx0.vertex_index = face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 0]].v_idx;
7904 idx0.normal_index =
7905 face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 0]].vn_idx;
7906 idx0.texcoord_index =
7907 face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 0]].vt_idx;
7908 idx1.vertex_index = face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 1]].v_idx;
7909 idx1.normal_index =
7910 face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 1]].vn_idx;
7911 idx1.texcoord_index =
7912 face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 1]].vt_idx;
7913 idx2.vertex_index = face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 2]].v_idx;
7914 idx2.normal_index =
7915 face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 2]].vn_idx;
7916 idx2.texcoord_index =
7917 face.vertex_indices[indices[3 * k + 2]].vt_idx;
7918
7919 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx0);
7920 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx1);
7921 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx2);
7922
7923 shape->mesh.num_face_vertices.push_back(3);
7924 shape->mesh.material_ids.push_back(material_id);
7925 shape->mesh.smoothing_group_ids.push_back(
7926 face.smoothing_group_id);
7927 }
7928 }
7929
7930#else // Built-in ear clipping triangulation
7931 vertex_index_t i0 = face.vertex_indices[0];
7932 vertex_index_t i1(-1);
7933 vertex_index_t i2 = face.vertex_indices[1];
7934
7935 // find the two axes to work in
7936 size_t axes[2] = {1, 2};
7937 for (size_t k = 0; k < npolys; ++k) {
7938 i0 = face.vertex_indices[(k + 0) % npolys];
7939 i1 = face.vertex_indices[(k + 1) % npolys];
7940 i2 = face.vertex_indices[(k + 2) % npolys];
7941 size_t vi0 = size_t(i0.v_idx);
7942 size_t vi1 = size_t(i1.v_idx);
7943 size_t vi2 = size_t(i2.v_idx);
7944
7945 if (((3 * vi0 + 2) >= v.size()) || ((3 * vi1 + 2) >= v.size()) ||
7946 ((3 * vi2 + 2) >= v.size())) {
7947 // Invalid triangle.
7948 // FIXME(syoyo): Is it ok to simply skip this invalid triangle?
7949 continue;
7950 }
7951 real_t v0x = v[vi0 * 3 + 0];
7952 real_t v0y = v[vi0 * 3 + 1];
7953 real_t v0z = v[vi0 * 3 + 2];
7954 real_t v1x = v[vi1 * 3 + 0];
7955 real_t v1y = v[vi1 * 3 + 1];
7956 real_t v1z = v[vi1 * 3 + 2];
7957 real_t v2x = v[vi2 * 3 + 0];
7958 real_t v2y = v[vi2 * 3 + 1];
7959 real_t v2z = v[vi2 * 3 + 2];
7960 real_t e0x = v1x - v0x;
7961 real_t e0y = v1y - v0y;
7962 real_t e0z = v1z - v0z;
7963 real_t e1x = v2x - v1x;
7964 real_t e1y = v2y - v1y;
7965 real_t e1z = v2z - v1z;
7966 real_t cx = std::fabs(e0y * e1z - e0z * e1y);
7967 real_t cy = std::fabs(e0z * e1x - e0x * e1z);
7968 real_t cz = std::fabs(e0x * e1y - e0y * e1x);
7969 const real_t epsilon = std::numeric_limits<real_t>::epsilon();
7970 // std::cout << "cx " << cx << ", cy " << cy << ", cz " << cz <<
7971 // "\n";
7972 if (cx > epsilon || cy > epsilon || cz > epsilon) {
7973 // std::cout << "corner\n";
7974 // found a corner
7975 if (cx > cy && cx > cz) {
7976 // std::cout << "pattern0\n";
7977 } else {
7978 // std::cout << "axes[0] = 0\n";
7979 axes[0] = 0;
7980 if (cz > cx && cz > cy) {
7981 // std::cout << "axes[1] = 1\n";
7982 axes[1] = 1;
7983 }
7984 }
7985 break;
7986 }
7987 }
7988
7989 face_t remainingFace = face; // copy
7990 size_t guess_vert = 0;
7991 vertex_index_t ind[3];
7992 real_t vx[3];
7993 real_t vy[3];
7994
7995 // How many iterations can we do without decreasing the remaining
7996 // vertices.
7997 size_t remainingIterations = face.vertex_indices.size();
7998 size_t previousRemainingVertices =
7999 remainingFace.vertex_indices.size();
8000
8001 while (remainingFace.vertex_indices.size() > 3 &&
8002 remainingIterations > 0) {
8003 // std::cout << "remainingIterations " << remainingIterations <<
8004 // "\n";
8005
8006 npolys = remainingFace.vertex_indices.size();
8007 if (guess_vert >= npolys) {
8008 guess_vert -= npolys;
8009 }
8010
8011 if (previousRemainingVertices != npolys) {
8012 // The number of remaining vertices decreased. Reset counters.
8013 previousRemainingVertices = npolys;
8014 remainingIterations = npolys;
8015 } else {
8016 // We didn't consume a vertex on previous iteration, reduce the
8017 // available iterations.
8018 remainingIterations--;
8019 }
8020
8021 for (size_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
8022 ind[k] = remainingFace.vertex_indices[(guess_vert + k) % npolys];
8023 size_t vi = size_t(ind[k].v_idx);
8024 if (((vi * 3 + axes[0]) >= v.size()) ||
8025 ((vi * 3 + axes[1]) >= v.size())) {
8026 // ???
8027 vx[k] = static_cast<real_t>(0.0);
8028 vy[k] = static_cast<real_t>(0.0);
8029 } else {
8030 vx[k] = v[vi * 3 + axes[0]];
8031 vy[k] = v[vi * 3 + axes[1]];
8032 }
8033 }
8034
8035 //
8036 // area is calculated per face
8037 //
8038 real_t e0x = vx[1] - vx[0];
8039 real_t e0y = vy[1] - vy[0];
8040 real_t e1x = vx[2] - vx[1];
8041 real_t e1y = vy[2] - vy[1];
8042 real_t cross = e0x * e1y - e0y * e1x;
8043 // std::cout << "axes = " << axes[0] << ", " << axes[1] << "\n";
8044 // std::cout << "e0x, e0y, e1x, e1y " << e0x << ", " << e0y << ", "
8045 // << e1x << ", " << e1y << "\n";
8046
8047 real_t area =
8048 (vx[0] * vy[1] - vy[0] * vx[1]) * static_cast<real_t>(0.5);
8049 // std::cout << "cross " << cross << ", area " << area << "\n";
8050 // if an internal angle
8051 if (cross * area < static_cast<real_t>(0.0)) {
8052 // std::cout << "internal \n";
8053 guess_vert += 1;
8054 // std::cout << "guess vert : " << guess_vert << "\n";
8055 continue;
8056 }
8057
8058 // check all other verts in case they are inside this triangle
8059 bool overlap = false;
8060 for (size_t otherVert = 3; otherVert < npolys; ++otherVert) {
8061 size_t idx = (guess_vert + otherVert) % npolys;
8062
8063 if (idx >= remainingFace.vertex_indices.size()) {
8064 // std::cout << "???0\n";
8065 // ???
8066 continue;
8067 }
8068
8069 size_t ovi = size_t(remainingFace.vertex_indices[idx].v_idx);
8070
8071 if (((ovi * 3 + axes[0]) >= v.size()) ||
8072 ((ovi * 3 + axes[1]) >= v.size())) {
8073 // std::cout << "???1\n";
8074 // ???
8075 continue;
8076 }
8077 real_t tx = v[ovi * 3 + axes[0]];
8078 real_t ty = v[ovi * 3 + axes[1]];
8079 if (pnpoly(3, vx, vy, tx, ty)) {
8080 // std::cout << "overlap\n";
8081 overlap = true;
8082 break;
8083 }
8084 }
8085
8086 if (overlap) {
8087 // std::cout << "overlap2\n";
8088 guess_vert += 1;
8089 continue;
8090 }
8091
8092 // this triangle is an ear
8093 {
8094 index_t idx0, idx1, idx2;
8095 idx0.vertex_index = ind[0].v_idx;
8096 idx0.normal_index = ind[0].vn_idx;
8097 idx0.texcoord_index = ind[0].vt_idx;
8098 idx1.vertex_index = ind[1].v_idx;
8099 idx1.normal_index = ind[1].vn_idx;
8100 idx1.texcoord_index = ind[1].vt_idx;
8101 idx2.vertex_index = ind[2].v_idx;
8102 idx2.normal_index = ind[2].vn_idx;
8103 idx2.texcoord_index = ind[2].vt_idx;
8104
8105 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx0);
8106 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx1);
8107 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx2);
8108
8109 shape->mesh.num_face_vertices.push_back(3);
8110 shape->mesh.material_ids.push_back(material_id);
8111 shape->mesh.smoothing_group_ids.push_back(
8112 face.smoothing_group_id);
8113 }
8114
8115 // remove v1 from the list
8116 size_t removed_vert_index = (guess_vert + 1) % npolys;
8117 while (removed_vert_index + 1 < npolys) {
8118 remainingFace.vertex_indices[removed_vert_index] =
8119 remainingFace.vertex_indices[removed_vert_index + 1];
8120 removed_vert_index += 1;
8121 }
8122 remainingFace.vertex_indices.pop_back();
8123 }
8124
8125 // std::cout << "remainingFace.vi.size = " <<
8126 // remainingFace.vertex_indices.size() << "\n";
8127 if (remainingFace.vertex_indices.size() == 3) {
8128 i0 = remainingFace.vertex_indices[0];
8129 i1 = remainingFace.vertex_indices[1];
8130 i2 = remainingFace.vertex_indices[2];
8131 {
8132 index_t idx0, idx1, idx2;
8133 idx0.vertex_index = i0.v_idx;
8134 idx0.normal_index = i0.vn_idx;
8135 idx0.texcoord_index = i0.vt_idx;
8136 idx1.vertex_index = i1.v_idx;
8137 idx1.normal_index = i1.vn_idx;
8138 idx1.texcoord_index = i1.vt_idx;
8139 idx2.vertex_index = i2.v_idx;
8140 idx2.normal_index = i2.vn_idx;
8141 idx2.texcoord_index = i2.vt_idx;
8142
8143 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx0);
8144 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx1);
8145 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx2);
8146
8147 shape->mesh.num_face_vertices.push_back(3);
8148 shape->mesh.material_ids.push_back(material_id);
8149 shape->mesh.smoothing_group_ids.push_back(
8150 face.smoothing_group_id);
8151 }
8152 }
8153#endif
8154 } // npolys
8155 } else {
8156 for (size_t k = 0; k < npolys; k++) {
8157 index_t idx;
8158 idx.vertex_index = face.vertex_indices[k].v_idx;
8159 idx.normal_index = face.vertex_indices[k].vn_idx;
8160 idx.texcoord_index = face.vertex_indices[k].vt_idx;
8161 shape->mesh.indices.push_back(idx);
8162 }
8163
8164 shape->mesh.num_face_vertices.push_back(
8165 static_cast<unsigned int>(npolys));
8166 shape->mesh.material_ids.push_back(material_id); // per face
8167 shape->mesh.smoothing_group_ids.push_back(
8168 face.smoothing_group_id); // per face
8169 }
8170 }
8171
8172 shape->mesh.tags = tags;
8173 }
8174
8175 // line
8176 if (!prim_group.lineGroup.empty()) {
8177 // Flatten indices
8178 for (size_t i = 0; i < prim_group.lineGroup.size(); i++) {
8179 for (size_t j = 0; j < prim_group.lineGroup[i].vertex_indices.size();
8180 j++) {
8181 const vertex_index_t &vi = prim_group.lineGroup[i].vertex_indices[j];
8182
8183 index_t idx;
8184 idx.vertex_index = vi.v_idx;
8185 idx.normal_index = vi.vn_idx;
8186 idx.texcoord_index = vi.vt_idx;
8187
8188 shape->lines.indices.push_back(idx);
8189 }
8190
8191 shape->lines.num_line_vertices.push_back(
8192 int(prim_group.lineGroup[i].vertex_indices.size()));
8193 }
8194 }
8195
8196 // points
8197 if (!prim_group.pointsGroup.empty()) {
8198 // Flatten & convert indices
8199 for (size_t i = 0; i < prim_group.pointsGroup.size(); i++) {
8200 for (size_t j = 0; j < prim_group.pointsGroup[i].vertex_indices.size();
8201 j++) {
8202 const vertex_index_t &vi = prim_group.pointsGroup[i].vertex_indices[j];
8203
8204 index_t idx;
8205 idx.vertex_index = vi.v_idx;
8206 idx.normal_index = vi.vn_idx;
8207 idx.texcoord_index = vi.vt_idx;
8208
8209 shape->points.indices.push_back(idx);
8210 }
8211 }
8212 }
8213
8214 return true;
8215}
8216
8217// Split a string with specified delimiter character and escape character.
8218// https://rosettacode.org/wiki/Tokenize_a_string_with_escaping#C.2B.2B
8219static void SplitString(const std::string &s, char delim, char escape,
8220 std::vector<std::string> &elems) {
8221 std::string token;
8222
8223 bool escaping = false;
8224 for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
8225 char ch = s[i];
8226 if (escaping) {
8227 escaping = false;
8228 } else if (ch == escape) {
8229 if ((i + 1) < s.size()) {
8230 const char next = s[i + 1];
8231 if ((next == delim) || (next == escape)) {
8232 escaping = true;
8233 continue;
8234 }
8235 }
8236 } else if (ch == delim) {
8237 if (!token.empty()) {
8238 elems.push_back(token);
8239 }
8240 token.clear();
8241 continue;
8242 }
8243 token += ch;
8244 }
8245
8246 elems.push_back(token);
8247}
8248
8249static void RemoveEmptyTokens(std::vector<std::string> *tokens) {
8250 if (!tokens) return;
8251
8252 const std::vector<std::string> &src = *tokens;
8253 std::vector<std::string> filtered;
8254 filtered.reserve(src.size());
8255 for (size_t i = 0; i < src.size(); i++) {
8256 if (!src[i].empty()) {
8257 filtered.push_back(src[i]);
8258 }
8259 }
8260 tokens->swap(filtered);
8261}
8262
8263static std::string JoinPath(const std::string &dir,
8264 const std::string &filename) {
8265 if (dir.empty()) {
8266 return filename;
8267 } else {
8268 // check '/'
8269 char lastChar = *dir.rbegin();
8270 if (lastChar != '/') {
8271 return dir + std::string("/") + filename;
8272 } else {
8273 return dir + filename;
8274 }
8275 }
8276}
8277
8278static bool LoadMtlInternal(std::map<std::string, int> *material_map,
8279 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
8280 StreamReader &sr,
8281 std::string *warning, std::string *err,
8282 const std::string &filename = "<stream>") {
8283 if (sr.has_errors()) {
8284 if (err) {
8285 (*err) += sr.get_errors();
8286 }
8287 return false;
8288 }
8289
8290 material_t material;
8291 InitMaterial(&material);
8292
8293 // Issue 43. `d` wins against `Tr` since `Tr` is not in the MTL specification.
8294 bool has_d = false;
8295 bool has_tr = false;
8296
8297 // has_kd is used to set a default diffuse value when map_Kd is present
8298 // and Kd is not.
8299 bool has_kd = false;
8300
8301 std::stringstream warn_ss;
8302
8303 // Handle BOM
8304 if (sr.remaining() >= 3 &&
8305 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek()) == 0xEF &&
8306 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek_at(1)) == 0xBB &&
8307 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek_at(2)) == 0xBF) {
8308 sr.advance(3);
8309 }
8310
8311 while (!sr.eof()) {
8312 sr.skip_space();
8313 if (sr.at_line_end()) { sr.skip_line(); continue; }
8314 if (sr.peek() == '#') { sr.skip_line(); continue; }
8315
8316 size_t line_num = sr.line_num();
8317
8318 // new mtl
8319 if (sr.match("newmtl", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8320 // flush previous material.
8321 if (!material.name.empty()) {
8322 material_map->insert(std::pair<std::string, int>(
8323 material.name, static_cast<int>(materials->size())));
8324 materials->push_back(material);
8325 }
8326
8327 InitMaterial(&material);
8328
8329 has_d = false;
8330 has_tr = false;
8331 has_kd = false;
8332
8333 sr.advance(7);
8334 {
8335 std::string namebuf = sr_parseString(sr);
8336 if (namebuf.empty()) {
8337 if (warning) {
8338 (*warning) += "empty material name in `newmtl`\n";
8339 }
8340 }
8341 material.name = namebuf;
8342 }
8343 sr.skip_line();
8344 continue;
8345 }
8346
8347 // ambient
8348 if (sr.peek() == 'K' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'a' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8349 sr.advance(2);
8350 real_t r, g, b;
8351 if (!sr_parseReal3(&r, &g, &b, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8352 material.ambient[0] = r;
8353 material.ambient[1] = g;
8354 material.ambient[2] = b;
8355 sr.skip_line();
8356 continue;
8357 }
8358
8359 // diffuse
8360 if (sr.peek() == 'K' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'd' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8361 sr.advance(2);
8362 real_t r, g, b;
8363 if (!sr_parseReal3(&r, &g, &b, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8364 material.diffuse[0] = r;
8365 material.diffuse[1] = g;
8366 material.diffuse[2] = b;
8367 has_kd = true;
8368 sr.skip_line();
8369 continue;
8370 }
8371
8372 // specular
8373 if (sr.peek() == 'K' && sr.peek_at(1) == 's' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8374 sr.advance(2);
8375 real_t r, g, b;
8376 if (!sr_parseReal3(&r, &g, &b, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8377 material.specular[0] = r;
8378 material.specular[1] = g;
8379 material.specular[2] = b;
8380 sr.skip_line();
8381 continue;
8382 }
8383
8384 // transmittance
8385 if ((sr.peek() == 'K' && sr.peek_at(1) == 't' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) ||
8386 (sr.peek() == 'T' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'f' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t'))) {
8387 sr.advance(2);
8388 real_t r, g, b;
8389 if (!sr_parseReal3(&r, &g, &b, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8390 material.transmittance[0] = r;
8391 material.transmittance[1] = g;
8392 material.transmittance[2] = b;
8393 sr.skip_line();
8394 continue;
8395 }
8396
8397 // ior(index of refraction)
8398 if (sr.peek() == 'N' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'i' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8399 sr.advance(2);
8400 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.ior, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8401 sr.skip_line();
8402 continue;
8403 }
8404
8405 // emission
8406 if (sr.peek() == 'K' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'e' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8407 sr.advance(2);
8408 real_t r, g, b;
8409 if (!sr_parseReal3(&r, &g, &b, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8410 material.emission[0] = r;
8411 material.emission[1] = g;
8412 material.emission[2] = b;
8413 sr.skip_line();
8414 continue;
8415 }
8416
8417 // shininess
8418 if (sr.peek() == 'N' && sr.peek_at(1) == 's' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8419 sr.advance(2);
8420 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.shininess, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8421 sr.skip_line();
8422 continue;
8423 }
8424
8425 // illum model
8426 if (sr.match("illum", 5) && (sr.peek_at(5) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(5) == '\t')) {
8427 sr.advance(6);
8428 if (!sr_parseInt(sr, &material.illum, err, filename)) return false;
8429 sr.skip_line();
8430 continue;
8431 }
8432
8433 // dissolve
8434 if (sr.peek() == 'd' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
8435 sr.advance(1);
8436 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.dissolve, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8437
8438 if (has_tr) {
8439 warn_ss << "Both `d` and `Tr` parameters defined for \""
8440 << material.name
8441 << "\". Use the value of `d` for dissolve (line " << line_num
8442 << " in .mtl.)\n";
8443 }
8444 has_d = true;
8445 sr.skip_line();
8446 continue;
8447 }
8448 if (sr.peek() == 'T' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'r' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8449 sr.advance(2);
8450 if (has_d) {
8451 warn_ss << "Both `d` and `Tr` parameters defined for \""
8452 << material.name
8453 << "\". Use the value of `d` for dissolve (line " << line_num
8454 << " in .mtl.)\n";
8455 } else {
8456 real_t tr_val;
8457 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &tr_val, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8458 material.dissolve = static_cast<real_t>(1.0) - tr_val;
8459 }
8460 has_tr = true;
8461 sr.skip_line();
8462 continue;
8463 }
8464
8465 // PBR: roughness
8466 if (sr.peek() == 'P' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'r' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8467 sr.advance(2);
8468 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.roughness, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8469 sr.skip_line();
8470 continue;
8471 }
8472
8473 // PBR: metallic
8474 if (sr.peek() == 'P' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'm' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8475 sr.advance(2);
8476 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.metallic, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8477 sr.skip_line();
8478 continue;
8479 }
8480
8481 // PBR: sheen
8482 if (sr.peek() == 'P' && sr.peek_at(1) == 's' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8483 sr.advance(2);
8484 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.sheen, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8485 sr.skip_line();
8486 continue;
8487 }
8488
8489 // PBR: clearcoat thickness
8490 if (sr.peek() == 'P' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'c' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8491 sr.advance(2);
8492 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.clearcoat_thickness, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8493 sr.skip_line();
8494 continue;
8495 }
8496
8497 // PBR: clearcoat roughness
8498 if (sr.match("Pcr", 3) && (sr.peek_at(3) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(3) == '\t')) {
8499 sr.advance(4);
8500 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.clearcoat_roughness, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8501 sr.skip_line();
8502 continue;
8503 }
8504
8505 // PBR: anisotropy
8506 if (sr.match("aniso", 5) && (sr.peek_at(5) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(5) == '\t')) {
8507 sr.advance(6);
8508 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.anisotropy, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8509 sr.skip_line();
8510 continue;
8511 }
8512
8513 // PBR: anisotropy rotation
8514 if (sr.match("anisor", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8515 sr.advance(7);
8516 if (!sr_parseReal(sr, &material.anisotropy_rotation, 0.0, err, filename)) return false;
8517 sr.skip_line();
8518 continue;
8519 }
8520
8521 // For texture directives, read rest of line and delegate to
8522 // ParseTextureNameAndOption (which uses the old const char* parse functions).
8523
8524 // ambient or ambient occlusion texture
8525 if (sr.match("map_Ka", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8526 sr.advance(7);
8527 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8528 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.ambient_texname),
8529 &(material.ambient_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8530 sr.skip_line();
8531 continue;
8532 }
8533
8534 // diffuse texture
8535 if (sr.match("map_Kd", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8536 sr.advance(7);
8537 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8538 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.diffuse_texname),
8539 &(material.diffuse_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8540 if (!has_kd) {
8541 material.diffuse[0] = static_cast<real_t>(0.6);
8542 material.diffuse[1] = static_cast<real_t>(0.6);
8543 material.diffuse[2] = static_cast<real_t>(0.6);
8544 }
8545 sr.skip_line();
8546 continue;
8547 }
8548
8549 // specular texture
8550 if (sr.match("map_Ks", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8551 sr.advance(7);
8552 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8553 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.specular_texname),
8554 &(material.specular_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8555 sr.skip_line();
8556 continue;
8557 }
8558
8559 // specular highlight texture
8560 if (sr.match("map_Ns", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8561 sr.advance(7);
8562 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8563 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.specular_highlight_texname),
8564 &(material.specular_highlight_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8565 sr.skip_line();
8566 continue;
8567 }
8568
8569 // bump texture
8570 if ((sr.match("map_bump", 8) || sr.match("map_Bump", 8)) &&
8571 (sr.peek_at(8) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(8) == '\t')) {
8572 sr.advance(9);
8573 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8574 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.bump_texname),
8575 &(material.bump_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8576 sr.skip_line();
8577 continue;
8578 }
8579
8580 // bump texture (short form)
8581 if (sr.match("bump", 4) && (sr.peek_at(4) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(4) == '\t')) {
8582 sr.advance(5);
8583 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8584 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.bump_texname),
8585 &(material.bump_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8586 sr.skip_line();
8587 continue;
8588 }
8589
8590 // alpha texture
8591 if (sr.match("map_d", 5) && (sr.peek_at(5) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(5) == '\t')) {
8592 sr.advance(6);
8593 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8594 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.alpha_texname),
8595 &(material.alpha_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8596 sr.skip_line();
8597 continue;
8598 }
8599
8600 // displacement texture
8601 if ((sr.match("map_disp", 8) || sr.match("map_Disp", 8)) &&
8602 (sr.peek_at(8) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(8) == '\t')) {
8603 sr.advance(9);
8604 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8605 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.displacement_texname),
8606 &(material.displacement_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8607 sr.skip_line();
8608 continue;
8609 }
8610
8611 // displacement texture (short form)
8612 if (sr.match("disp", 4) && (sr.peek_at(4) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(4) == '\t')) {
8613 sr.advance(5);
8614 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8615 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.displacement_texname),
8616 &(material.displacement_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8617 sr.skip_line();
8618 continue;
8619 }
8620
8621 // reflection map
8622 if (sr.match("refl", 4) && (sr.peek_at(4) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(4) == '\t')) {
8623 sr.advance(5);
8624 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8625 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.reflection_texname),
8626 &(material.reflection_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8627 sr.skip_line();
8628 continue;
8629 }
8630
8631 // PBR: roughness texture
8632 if (sr.match("map_Pr", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8633 sr.advance(7);
8634 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8635 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.roughness_texname),
8636 &(material.roughness_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8637 sr.skip_line();
8638 continue;
8639 }
8640
8641 // PBR: metallic texture
8642 if (sr.match("map_Pm", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8643 sr.advance(7);
8644 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8645 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.metallic_texname),
8646 &(material.metallic_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8647 sr.skip_line();
8648 continue;
8649 }
8650
8651 // PBR: sheen texture
8652 if (sr.match("map_Ps", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8653 sr.advance(7);
8654 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8655 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.sheen_texname),
8656 &(material.sheen_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8657 sr.skip_line();
8658 continue;
8659 }
8660
8661 // PBR: emissive texture
8662 if (sr.match("map_Ke", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
8663 sr.advance(7);
8664 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8665 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.emissive_texname),
8666 &(material.emissive_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8667 sr.skip_line();
8668 continue;
8669 }
8670
8671 // PBR: normal map texture
8672 if (sr.match("norm", 4) && (sr.peek_at(4) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(4) == '\t')) {
8673 sr.advance(5);
8674 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8675 ParseTextureNameAndOption(&(material.normal_texname),
8676 &(material.normal_texopt), line_rest.c_str());
8677 sr.skip_line();
8678 continue;
8679 }
8680
8681 // unknown parameter
8682 {
8683 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
8684 const char *_lp = line_rest.c_str();
8685 const char *_space = strchr(_lp, ' ');
8686 if (!_space) {
8687 _space = strchr(_lp, '\t');
8688 }
8689 if (_space) {
8690 std::ptrdiff_t len = _space - _lp;
8691 std::string key(_lp, static_cast<size_t>(len));
8692 std::string value = _space + 1;
8693 material.unknown_parameter.insert(
8694 std::pair<std::string, std::string>(key, value));
8695 }
8696 }
8697 sr.skip_line();
8698 }
8699 // flush last material (only if it was actually defined).
8700 if (!material.name.empty()) {
8701 material_map->insert(std::pair<std::string, int>(
8702 material.name, static_cast<int>(materials->size())));
8703 materials->push_back(material);
8704 }
8705
8706 if (warning) {
8707 (*warning) += warn_ss.str();
8708 }
8709
8710 return true;
8711}
8712
8713void LoadMtl(std::map<std::string, int> *material_map,
8714 std::vector<material_t> *materials, std::istream *inStream,
8715 std::string *warning, std::string *err) {
8716 StreamReader sr(*inStream);
8717 LoadMtlInternal(material_map, materials, sr, warning, err);
8718}
8719
8720
8721bool MaterialFileReader::operator()(const std::string &matId,
8722 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
8723 std::map<std::string, int> *matMap,
8724 std::string *warn, std::string *err) {
8725 if (!m_mtlBaseDir.empty()) {
8726#ifdef _WIN32
8727 char sep = ';';
8728#else
8729 char sep = ':';
8730#endif
8731
8732 // https://stackoverflow.com/questions/5167625/splitting-a-c-stdstring-using-tokens-e-g
8733 std::vector<std::string> paths;
8734 std::istringstream f(m_mtlBaseDir);
8735
8736 std::string s;
8737 while (getline(f, s, sep)) {
8738 paths.push_back(s);
8739 }
8740
8741 for (size_t i = 0; i < paths.size(); i++) {
8742 std::string filepath = JoinPath(paths[i], matId);
8743
8744#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
8745 {
8746 MappedFile mf;
8747 if (!mf.open(filepath.c_str())) continue;
8748 if (mf.size > TINYOBJLOADER_STREAM_READER_MAX_BYTES) {
8749 if (err) {
8750 std::stringstream ss;
8751 ss << "input stream too large (" << mf.size
8752 << " bytes exceeds limit "
8753 << TINYOBJLOADER_STREAM_READER_MAX_BYTES << " bytes)\n";
8754 (*err) += ss.str();
8755 }
8756 return false;
8757 }
8758 StreamReader sr(mf.data, mf.size);
8759 return LoadMtlInternal(matMap, materials, sr, warn, err, filepath);
8760 }
8761#else // !TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
8762#ifdef _WIN32
8763 std::ifstream matIStream(LongPathW(UTF8ToWchar(filepath)).c_str());
8764#else
8765 std::ifstream matIStream(filepath.c_str());
8766#endif
8767 if (matIStream) {
8768 StreamReader mtl_sr(matIStream);
8769 return LoadMtlInternal(matMap, materials, mtl_sr, warn, err, filepath);
8770 }
8771#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
8772 }
8773
8774 std::stringstream ss;
8775 ss << "Material file [ " << matId
8776 << " ] not found in a path : " << m_mtlBaseDir << "\n";
8777 if (warn) {
8778 (*warn) += ss.str();
8779 }
8780 return false;
8781
8782 } else {
8783 std::string filepath = matId;
8784
8785#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
8786 {
8787 MappedFile mf;
8788 if (mf.open(filepath.c_str())) {
8789 if (mf.size > TINYOBJLOADER_STREAM_READER_MAX_BYTES) {
8790 if (err) {
8791 std::stringstream ss;
8792 ss << "input stream too large (" << mf.size
8793 << " bytes exceeds limit "
8794 << TINYOBJLOADER_STREAM_READER_MAX_BYTES << " bytes)\n";
8795 (*err) += ss.str();
8796 }
8797 return false;
8798 }
8799 StreamReader sr(mf.data, mf.size);
8800 return LoadMtlInternal(matMap, materials, sr, warn, err, filepath);
8801 }
8802 }
8803#else // !TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
8804#ifdef _WIN32
8805 std::ifstream matIStream(LongPathW(UTF8ToWchar(filepath)).c_str());
8806#else
8807 std::ifstream matIStream(filepath.c_str());
8808#endif
8809 if (matIStream) {
8810 StreamReader mtl_sr(matIStream);
8811 return LoadMtlInternal(matMap, materials, mtl_sr, warn, err, filepath);
8812 }
8813#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
8814
8815 std::stringstream ss;
8816 ss << "Material file [ " << filepath
8817 << " ] not found in a path : " << m_mtlBaseDir << "\n";
8818 if (warn) {
8819 (*warn) += ss.str();
8820 }
8821
8822 return false;
8823 }
8824}
8825
8826bool MaterialStreamReader::operator()(const std::string &matId,
8827 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
8828 std::map<std::string, int> *matMap,
8829 std::string *warn, std::string *err) {
8830 (void)matId;
8831 if (!m_inStream) {
8832 std::stringstream ss;
8833 ss << "Material stream in error state. \n";
8834 if (warn) {
8835 (*warn) += ss.str();
8836 }
8837 return false;
8838 }
8839
8840 StreamReader mtl_sr(m_inStream);
8841 return LoadMtlInternal(matMap, materials, mtl_sr, warn, err, "<stream>");
8842}
8843
8844static bool LoadObjInternal(attrib_t *attrib, std::vector<shape_t> *shapes,
8845 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
8846 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
8847 StreamReader &sr,
8848 MaterialReader *readMatFn, bool triangulate,
8849 bool default_vcols_fallback,
8850 const std::string &filename = "<stream>") {
8851 if (sr.has_errors()) {
8852 if (err) {
8853 (*err) += sr.get_errors();
8854 }
8855 return false;
8856 }
8857
8858 std::vector<real_t> v;
8859 std::vector<real_t> vertex_weights;
8860 std::vector<real_t> vn;
8861 std::vector<real_t> vt;
8862 std::vector<real_t> vt_w; // optional [w] component in `vt`
8863 std::vector<real_t> vc;
8864 std::vector<skin_weight_t> vw;
8865 std::vector<tag_t> tags;
8866 PrimGroup prim_group;
8867 std::string name;
8868
8869 // material
8870 std::set<std::string> material_filenames;
8871 std::map<std::string, int> material_map;
8872 int material = -1;
8873
8874 unsigned int current_smoothing_id = 0;
8875
8876 int greatest_v_idx = -1;
8877 int greatest_vn_idx = -1;
8878 int greatest_vt_idx = -1;
8879
8880 shape_t shape;
8881
8882 bool found_all_colors = true;
8883
8884 // Handle BOM
8885 if (sr.remaining() >= 3 &&
8886 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek()) == 0xEF &&
8887 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek_at(1)) == 0xBB &&
8888 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek_at(2)) == 0xBF) {
8889 sr.advance(3);
8890 }
8891
8892 warning_context context;
8893 context.warn = warn;
8894 context.filename = filename;
8895
8896 while (!sr.eof()) {
8897 sr.skip_space();
8898 if (sr.at_line_end()) { sr.skip_line(); continue; }
8899 if (sr.peek() == '#') { sr.skip_line(); continue; }
8900
8901 size_t line_num = sr.line_num();
8902
8903 // vertex
8904 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
8905 sr.advance(2);
8906 real_t x, y, z;
8907 real_t r, g, b;
8908
8909 int num_components = sr_parseVertexWithColor(&x, &y, &z, &r, &g, &b, sr, err, filename);
8910 if (num_components < 0) return false;
8911 found_all_colors &= (num_components == 6);
8912
8913 v.push_back(x);
8914 v.push_back(y);
8915 v.push_back(z);
8916
8917 vertex_weights.push_back(r);
8918
8919 if ((num_components == 6) || default_vcols_fallback) {
8920 vc.push_back(r);
8921 vc.push_back(g);
8922 vc.push_back(b);
8923 }
8924
8925 sr.skip_line();
8926 continue;
8927 }
8928
8929 // normal
8930 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'n' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8931 sr.advance(3);
8932 real_t x, y, z;
8933 if (!sr_parseReal3(&x, &y, &z, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8934 vn.push_back(x);
8935 vn.push_back(y);
8936 vn.push_back(z);
8937 sr.skip_line();
8938 continue;
8939 }
8940
8941 // texcoord
8942 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && sr.peek_at(1) == 't' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8943 sr.advance(3);
8944 real_t x, y;
8945 if (!sr_parseReal2(&x, &y, sr, err, filename)) return false;
8946 vt.push_back(x);
8947 vt.push_back(y);
8948
8949 // Parse optional w component
8950 real_t w = static_cast<real_t>(0.0);
8951 sr_parseReal(sr, &w);
8952 vt_w.push_back(w);
8953
8954 sr.skip_line();
8955 continue;
8956 }
8957
8958 // skin weight. tinyobj extension
8959 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'w' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
8960 sr.advance(3);
8961
8962 int vid;
8963 if (!sr_parseInt(sr, &vid, err, filename)) return false;
8964
8965 skin_weight_t sw;
8966 sw.vertex_id = vid;
8967
8968 size_t vw_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
8969 size_t vw_loop_iter = 0;
8970 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
8971 vw_loop_iter < vw_loop_max) {
8972 real_t j, w;
8973 sr_parseReal2(&j, &w, sr, -1.0);
8974
8975 if (j < static_cast<real_t>(0)) {
8976 if (err) {
8977 (*err) += sr.format_error(filename,
8978 "failed to parse `vw' line: joint_id is negative");
8979 }
8980 return false;
8981 }
8982
8983 // Clamp to int range to avoid UB on float-to-int overflow.
8984 if (j > static_cast<real_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
8985 if (err) {
8986 (*err) += sr.format_error(filename,
8987 "failed to parse `vw' line: joint_id overflow");
8988 }
8989 return false;
8990 }
8991 joint_and_weight_t jw;
8992 jw.joint_id = static_cast<int>(j);
8993 jw.weight = w;
8994
8995 sw.weightValues.push_back(jw);
8996 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
8997 vw_loop_iter++;
8998 }
8999
9000 vw.push_back(sw);
9001 sr.skip_line();
9002 continue;
9003 }
9004
9005 context.line_number = line_num;
9006
9007 // line
9008 if (sr.peek() == 'l' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9009 sr.advance(2);
9010
9011 __line_t line;
9012
9013 size_t l_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
9014 size_t l_loop_iter = 0;
9015 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
9016 l_loop_iter < l_loop_max) {
9017 vertex_index_t vi;
9018 if (!sr_parseTriple(sr, size_to_int(v.size() / 3),
9019 size_to_int(vn.size() / 3),
9020 size_to_int(vt.size() / 2), &vi, context)) {
9021 if (err) {
9022 (*err) += sr.format_error(filename,
9023 "failed to parse `l' line (invalid vertex index)");
9024 }
9025 return false;
9026 }
9027
9028 line.vertex_indices.push_back(vi);
9029 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
9030 l_loop_iter++;
9031 }
9032
9033 prim_group.lineGroup.push_back(line);
9034 sr.skip_line();
9035 continue;
9036 }
9037
9038 // points
9039 if (sr.peek() == 'p' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9040 sr.advance(2);
9041
9042 __points_t pts;
9043
9044 size_t p_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
9045 size_t p_loop_iter = 0;
9046 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
9047 p_loop_iter < p_loop_max) {
9048 vertex_index_t vi;
9049 if (!sr_parseTriple(sr, size_to_int(v.size() / 3),
9050 size_to_int(vn.size() / 3),
9051 size_to_int(vt.size() / 2), &vi, context)) {
9052 if (err) {
9053 (*err) += sr.format_error(filename,
9054 "failed to parse `p' line (invalid vertex index)");
9055 }
9056 return false;
9057 }
9058
9059 pts.vertex_indices.push_back(vi);
9060 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
9061 p_loop_iter++;
9062 }
9063
9064 prim_group.pointsGroup.push_back(pts);
9065 sr.skip_line();
9066 continue;
9067 }
9068
9069 // face
9070 if (sr.peek() == 'f' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9071 sr.advance(2);
9072 sr.skip_space();
9073
9074 face_t face;
9075
9076 face.smoothing_group_id = current_smoothing_id;
9077 face.vertex_indices.reserve(3);
9078
9079 size_t f_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
9080 size_t f_loop_iter = 0;
9081 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
9082 f_loop_iter < f_loop_max) {
9083 vertex_index_t vi;
9084 if (!sr_parseTriple(sr, size_to_int(v.size() / 3),
9085 size_to_int(vn.size() / 3),
9086 size_to_int(vt.size() / 2), &vi, context)) {
9087 if (err) {
9088 (*err) += sr.format_error(filename,
9089 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)");
9090 }
9091 return false;
9092 }
9093
9094 greatest_v_idx = greatest_v_idx > vi.v_idx ? greatest_v_idx : vi.v_idx;
9095 greatest_vn_idx =
9096 greatest_vn_idx > vi.vn_idx ? greatest_vn_idx : vi.vn_idx;
9097 greatest_vt_idx =
9098 greatest_vt_idx > vi.vt_idx ? greatest_vt_idx : vi.vt_idx;
9099
9100 face.vertex_indices.push_back(vi);
9101 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
9102 f_loop_iter++;
9103 }
9104
9105 prim_group.faceGroup.push_back(face);
9106 sr.skip_line();
9107 continue;
9108 }
9109
9110 // use mtl
9111 if (sr.match("usemtl", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
9112 sr.advance(6);
9113 std::string namebuf = sr_parseString(sr);
9114
9115 int newMaterialId = -1;
9116 std::map<std::string, int>::const_iterator it =
9117 material_map.find(namebuf);
9118 if (it != material_map.end()) {
9119 newMaterialId = it->second;
9120 } else {
9121 if (warn) {
9122 (*warn) += "material [ '" + namebuf + "' ] not found in .mtl\n";
9123 }
9124 }
9125
9126 if (newMaterialId != material) {
9127 exportGroupsToShape(&shape, prim_group, tags, material, name,
9128 triangulate, v, warn);
9129 prim_group.faceGroup.clear();
9130 material = newMaterialId;
9131 }
9132
9133 sr.skip_line();
9134 continue;
9135 }
9136
9137 // load mtl
9138 if (sr.match("mtllib", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
9139 if (readMatFn) {
9140 sr.advance(7);
9141
9142 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
9143 std::vector<std::string> filenames;
9144 SplitString(line_rest, ' ', '\\', filenames);
9145 RemoveEmptyTokens(&filenames);
9146
9147 if (filenames.empty()) {
9148 if (warn) {
9149 std::stringstream ss;
9150 ss << "Looks like empty filename for mtllib. Use default "
9151 "material (line "
9152 << line_num << ".)\n";
9153
9154 (*warn) += ss.str();
9155 }
9156 } else {
9157 bool found = false;
9158 for (size_t s = 0; s < filenames.size(); s++) {
9159 if (material_filenames.count(filenames[s]) > 0) {
9160 found = true;
9161 continue;
9162 }
9163
9164 std::string warn_mtl;
9165 std::string err_mtl;
9166 bool ok = (*readMatFn)(filenames[s].c_str(), materials,
9167 &material_map, &warn_mtl, &err_mtl);
9168 if (warn && (!warn_mtl.empty())) {
9169 (*warn) += warn_mtl;
9170 }
9171
9172 if (err && (!err_mtl.empty())) {
9173 (*err) += err_mtl;
9174 }
9175
9176 if (ok) {
9177 found = true;
9178 material_filenames.insert(filenames[s]);
9179 break;
9180 }
9181 }
9182
9183 if (!found) {
9184 if (warn) {
9185 (*warn) +=
9186 "Failed to load material file(s). Use default "
9187 "material.\n";
9188 }
9189 }
9190 }
9191 }
9192
9193 sr.skip_line();
9194 continue;
9195 }
9196
9197 // group name
9198 if (sr.peek() == 'g' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9199 // flush previous face group.
9200 bool ret = exportGroupsToShape(&shape, prim_group, tags, material, name,
9201 triangulate, v, warn);
9202 (void)ret;
9203
9204 if (shape.mesh.indices.size() > 0) {
9205 shapes->push_back(shape);
9206 }
9207
9208 shape = shape_t();
9209
9210 // material = -1;
9211 prim_group.clear();
9212
9213 std::vector<std::string> names;
9214
9215 size_t g_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
9216 size_t g_loop_iter = 0;
9217 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
9218 g_loop_iter < g_loop_max) {
9219 std::string str = sr_parseString(sr);
9220 names.push_back(str);
9221 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
9222 g_loop_iter++;
9223 }
9224
9225 // names[0] must be 'g'
9226
9227 if (names.size() < 2) {
9228 // 'g' with empty names
9229 if (warn) {
9230 std::stringstream ss;
9231 ss << "Empty group name. line: " << line_num << "\n";
9232 (*warn) += ss.str();
9233 name = "";
9234 }
9235 } else {
9236 std::stringstream ss;
9237 ss << names[1];
9238
9239 for (size_t i = 2; i < names.size(); i++) {
9240 ss << " " << names[i];
9241 }
9242
9243 name = ss.str();
9244 }
9245
9246 sr.skip_line();
9247 continue;
9248 }
9249
9250 // object name
9251 if (sr.peek() == 'o' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9252 // flush previous face group.
9253 bool ret = exportGroupsToShape(&shape, prim_group, tags, material, name,
9254 triangulate, v, warn);
9255 (void)ret;
9256
9257 if (shape.mesh.indices.size() > 0 || shape.lines.indices.size() > 0 ||
9258 shape.points.indices.size() > 0) {
9259 shapes->push_back(shape);
9260 }
9261
9262 // material = -1;
9263 prim_group.clear();
9264 shape = shape_t();
9265
9266 sr.advance(2);
9267 std::string rest = sr.read_line();
9268 name = rest;
9269
9270 sr.skip_line();
9271 continue;
9272 }
9273
9274 if (sr.peek() == 't' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9275 const int max_tag_nums = 8192;
9276 tag_t tag;
9277
9278 sr.advance(2);
9279
9280 tag.name = sr_parseString(sr);
9281
9282 tag_sizes ts = sr_parseTagTriple(sr);
9283
9284 if (ts.num_ints < 0) {
9285 ts.num_ints = 0;
9286 }
9287 if (ts.num_ints > max_tag_nums) {
9288 ts.num_ints = max_tag_nums;
9289 }
9290
9291 if (ts.num_reals < 0) {
9292 ts.num_reals = 0;
9293 }
9294 if (ts.num_reals > max_tag_nums) {
9295 ts.num_reals = max_tag_nums;
9296 }
9297
9298 if (ts.num_strings < 0) {
9299 ts.num_strings = 0;
9300 }
9301 if (ts.num_strings > max_tag_nums) {
9302 ts.num_strings = max_tag_nums;
9303 }
9304
9305 tag.intValues.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_ints));
9306
9307 for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_ints); ++i) {
9308 tag.intValues[i] = sr_parseInt(sr);
9309 }
9310
9311 tag.floatValues.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_reals));
9312 for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_reals); ++i) {
9313 tag.floatValues[i] = sr_parseReal(sr);
9314 }
9315
9316 tag.stringValues.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_strings));
9317 for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_strings); ++i) {
9318 tag.stringValues[i] = sr_parseString(sr);
9319 }
9320
9321 tags.push_back(tag);
9322
9323 sr.skip_line();
9324 continue;
9325 }
9326
9327 if (sr.peek() == 's' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9328 // smoothing group id
9329 sr.advance(2);
9330 sr.skip_space();
9331
9332 if (sr.at_line_end()) {
9333 sr.skip_line();
9334 continue;
9335 }
9336
9337 if (sr.peek() == '\r') {
9338 sr.skip_line();
9339 continue;
9340 }
9341
9342 if (sr.remaining() >= 3 && sr.match("off", 3)) {
9343 current_smoothing_id = 0;
9344 } else {
9345 int smGroupId = sr_parseInt(sr);
9346 if (smGroupId < 0) {
9347 current_smoothing_id = 0;
9348 } else {
9349 current_smoothing_id = static_cast<unsigned int>(smGroupId);
9350 }
9351 }
9352
9353 sr.skip_line();
9354 continue;
9355 }
9356
9357 // Ignore unknown command.
9358 sr.skip_line();
9359 }
9360
9361 // not all vertices have colors, no default colors desired? -> clear colors
9362 if (!found_all_colors && !default_vcols_fallback) {
9363 vc.clear();
9364 }
9365
9366 if (greatest_v_idx >= size_to_int(v.size() / 3)) {
9367 if (warn) {
9368 std::stringstream ss;
9369 ss << "Vertex indices out of bounds (line " << sr.line_num() << ".)\n\n";
9370 (*warn) += ss.str();
9371 }
9372 }
9373 if (greatest_vn_idx >= size_to_int(vn.size() / 3)) {
9374 if (warn) {
9375 std::stringstream ss;
9376 ss << "Vertex normal indices out of bounds (line " << sr.line_num()
9377 << ".)\n\n";
9378 (*warn) += ss.str();
9379 }
9380 }
9381 if (greatest_vt_idx >= size_to_int(vt.size() / 2)) {
9382 if (warn) {
9383 std::stringstream ss;
9384 ss << "Vertex texcoord indices out of bounds (line " << sr.line_num()
9385 << ".)\n\n";
9386 (*warn) += ss.str();
9387 }
9388 }
9389
9390 bool ret = exportGroupsToShape(&shape, prim_group, tags, material, name,
9391 triangulate, v, warn);
9392 if (ret || shape.mesh.indices.size()) {
9393 shapes->push_back(shape);
9394 }
9395 prim_group.clear();
9396
9397 attrib->vertices.swap(v);
9398 attrib->vertex_weights.swap(vertex_weights);
9399 attrib->normals.swap(vn);
9400 attrib->texcoords.swap(vt);
9401 attrib->texcoord_ws.swap(vt_w);
9402 attrib->colors.swap(vc);
9403 attrib->skin_weights.swap(vw);
9404
9405 return true;
9406}

9408bool LoadObj(attrib_t *attrib, std::vector<shape_t> *shapes,
9409 std::vector<material_t> *materials, std::string *warn,
9410 std::string *err, const char *filename, const char *mtl_basedir,
9411 bool triangulate, bool default_vcols_fallback) {
9412 attrib->vertices.clear();
9413 attrib->vertex_weights.clear();
9414 attrib->normals.clear();
9415 attrib->texcoords.clear();
9416 attrib->texcoord_ws.clear();
9417 attrib->colors.clear();
9418 attrib->skin_weights.clear();
9419 shapes->clear();
9420
9421 std::string baseDir = mtl_basedir ? mtl_basedir : "";
9422 if (!baseDir.empty()) {
9423#ifndef _WIN32
9424 const char dirsep = '/';
9425#else
9426 const char dirsep = '\\';
9427#endif
9428 if (baseDir[baseDir.length() - 1] != dirsep) baseDir += dirsep;
9429 }
9430 MaterialFileReader matFileReader(baseDir);
9431
9432#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
9433 {
9434 MappedFile mf;
9435 if (!mf.open(filename)) {
9436 if (err) {
9437 std::stringstream ss;
9438 ss << "Cannot open file [" << filename << "]\n";
9439 (*err) = ss.str();
9440 }
9441 return false;
9442 }
9443 if (mf.size > TINYOBJLOADER_STREAM_READER_MAX_BYTES) {
9444 if (err) {
9445 std::stringstream ss;
9446 ss << "input stream too large (" << mf.size
9447 << " bytes exceeds limit "
9448 << TINYOBJLOADER_STREAM_READER_MAX_BYTES << " bytes)\n";
9449 (*err) += ss.str();
9450 }
9451 return false;
9452 }
9453 StreamReader sr(mf.data, mf.size);
9454 return LoadObjInternal(attrib, shapes, materials, warn, err, sr,
9455 &matFileReader, triangulate, default_vcols_fallback,
9456 filename);
9457 }
9458#else // !TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
9459#ifdef _WIN32
9460 std::ifstream ifs(LongPathW(UTF8ToWchar(filename)).c_str());
9461#else
9462 std::ifstream ifs(filename);
9463#endif
9464 if (!ifs) {
9465 if (err) {
9466 std::stringstream ss;
9467 ss << "Cannot open file [" << filename << "]\n";
9468 (*err) = ss.str();
9469 }
9470 return false;
9471 }
9472 {
9473 StreamReader sr(ifs);
9474 return LoadObjInternal(attrib, shapes, materials, warn, err, sr,
9475 &matFileReader, triangulate, default_vcols_fallback,
9476 filename);
9477 }
9478#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
9479}

9499
9500
9501static bool LoadObjWithCallbackInternal(StreamReader &sr,
9502 const callback_t &callback,
9503 void *user_data,
9504 MaterialReader *readMatFn,
9505 std::string *warn,
9506 std::string *err) {
9507 if (sr.has_errors()) {
9508 if (err) {
9509 (*err) += sr.get_errors();
9510 }
9511 return false;
9512 }
9513
9514 // material
9515 std::set<std::string> material_filenames;
9516 std::map<std::string, int> material_map;
9517 int material_id = -1;
9518
9519 std::vector<index_t> indices;
9520 std::vector<material_t> materials;
9521 std::vector<std::string> names;
9522 names.reserve(2);
9523 std::vector<const char *> names_out;
9524
9525 // Handle BOM
9526 if (sr.remaining() >= 3 &&
9527 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek()) == 0xEF &&
9528 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek_at(1)) == 0xBB &&
9529 static_cast<unsigned char>(sr.peek_at(2)) == 0xBF) {
9530 sr.advance(3);
9531 }
9532
9533 while (!sr.eof()) {
9534 sr.skip_space();
9535 if (sr.at_line_end()) { sr.skip_line(); continue; }
9536 if (sr.peek() == '#') { sr.skip_line(); continue; }
9537
9538 // vertex
9539 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9540 sr.advance(2);
9541 real_t x, y, z;
9542 real_t r, g, b;
9543
9544 int num_components = sr_parseVertexWithColor(&x, &y, &z, &r, &g, &b, sr, err, std::string());
9545 if (num_components < 0) {
9546 return false;
9547 }
9548 if (callback.vertex_cb) {
9549 callback.vertex_cb(user_data, x, y, z, r);
9550 }
9551 if (callback.vertex_color_cb) {
9552 bool found_color = (num_components == 6);
9553 callback.vertex_color_cb(user_data, x, y, z, r, g, b, found_color);
9554 }
9555 sr.skip_line();
9556 continue;
9557 }
9558
9559 // normal
9560 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && sr.peek_at(1) == 'n' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
9561 sr.advance(3);
9562 real_t x, y, z;
9563 sr_parseReal3(&x, &y, &z, sr);
9564 if (callback.normal_cb) {
9565 callback.normal_cb(user_data, x, y, z);
9566 }
9567 sr.skip_line();
9568 continue;
9569 }
9570
9571 // texcoord
9572 if (sr.peek() == 'v' && sr.peek_at(1) == 't' && (sr.peek_at(2) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(2) == '\t')) {
9573 sr.advance(3);
9574 real_t x, y, z;
9575 sr_parseReal3(&x, &y, &z, sr);
9576 if (callback.texcoord_cb) {
9577 callback.texcoord_cb(user_data, x, y, z);
9578 }
9579 sr.skip_line();
9580 continue;
9581 }
9582
9583 // face
9584 if (sr.peek() == 'f' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9585 sr.advance(2);
9586 sr.skip_space();
9587
9588 indices.clear();
9589 size_t cf_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
9590 size_t cf_loop_iter = 0;
9591 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
9592 cf_loop_iter < cf_loop_max) {
9593 vertex_index_t vi = sr_parseRawTriple(sr);
9594
9595 index_t idx;
9596 idx.vertex_index = vi.v_idx;
9597 idx.normal_index = vi.vn_idx;
9598 idx.texcoord_index = vi.vt_idx;
9599
9600 indices.push_back(idx);
9601 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
9602 cf_loop_iter++;
9603 }
9604
9605 if (callback.index_cb && indices.size() > 0) {
9606 callback.index_cb(user_data, &indices.at(0),
9607 static_cast<int>(indices.size()));
9608 }
9609
9610 sr.skip_line();
9611 continue;
9612 }
9613
9614 // use mtl
9615 if (sr.match("usemtl", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
9616 sr.advance(6);
9617 std::string namebuf = sr_parseString(sr);
9618
9619 int newMaterialId = -1;
9620 std::map<std::string, int>::const_iterator it =
9621 material_map.find(namebuf);
9622 if (it != material_map.end()) {
9623 newMaterialId = it->second;
9624 } else {
9625 if (warn && (!callback.usemtl_cb)) {
9626 (*warn) += "material [ " + namebuf + " ] not found in .mtl\n";
9627 }
9628 }
9629
9630 if (newMaterialId != material_id) {
9631 material_id = newMaterialId;
9632 }
9633
9634 if (callback.usemtl_cb) {
9635 callback.usemtl_cb(user_data, namebuf.c_str(), material_id);
9636 }
9637
9638 sr.skip_line();
9639 continue;
9640 }
9641
9642 // load mtl
9643 if (sr.match("mtllib", 6) && (sr.peek_at(6) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(6) == '\t')) {
9644 if (readMatFn) {
9645 sr.advance(7);
9646
9647 std::string line_rest = trimTrailingWhitespace(sr.read_line());
9648 std::vector<std::string> filenames;
9649 SplitString(line_rest, ' ', '\\', filenames);
9650 RemoveEmptyTokens(&filenames);
9651
9652 if (filenames.empty()) {
9653 if (warn) {
9654 (*warn) +=
9655 "Looks like empty filename for mtllib. Use default "
9656 "material. \n";
9657 }
9658 } else {
9659 bool found = false;
9660 for (size_t s = 0; s < filenames.size(); s++) {
9661 if (material_filenames.count(filenames[s]) > 0) {
9662 found = true;
9663 continue;
9664 }
9665
9666 std::string warn_mtl;
9667 std::string err_mtl;
9668 bool ok = (*readMatFn)(filenames[s].c_str(), &materials,
9669 &material_map, &warn_mtl, &err_mtl);
9670
9671 if (warn && (!warn_mtl.empty())) {
9672 (*warn) += warn_mtl;
9673 }
9674
9675 if (err && (!err_mtl.empty())) {
9676 (*err) += err_mtl;
9677 }
9678
9679 if (ok) {
9680 found = true;
9681 material_filenames.insert(filenames[s]);
9682 break;
9683 }
9684 }
9685
9686 if (!found) {
9687 if (warn) {
9688 (*warn) +=
9689 "Failed to load material file(s). Use default "
9690 "material.\n";
9691 }
9692 } else {
9693 if (callback.mtllib_cb && !materials.empty()) {
9694 callback.mtllib_cb(user_data, &materials.at(0),
9695 static_cast<int>(materials.size()));
9696 }
9697 }
9698 }
9699 }
9700
9701 sr.skip_line();
9702 continue;
9703 }
9704
9705 // group name
9706 if (sr.peek() == 'g' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9707 names.clear();
9708
9709 size_t cg_loop_max = sr.remaining() + 1;
9710 size_t cg_loop_iter = 0;
9711 while (!sr.at_line_end() && sr.peek() != '#' &&
9712 cg_loop_iter < cg_loop_max) {
9713 std::string str = sr_parseString(sr);
9714 names.push_back(str);
9715 sr.skip_space_and_cr();
9716 cg_loop_iter++;
9717 }
9718
9719 assert(names.size() > 0);
9720
9721 if (callback.group_cb) {
9722 if (names.size() > 1) {
9723 names_out.resize(names.size() - 1);
9724 for (size_t j = 0; j < names_out.size(); j++) {
9725 names_out[j] = names[j + 1].c_str();
9726 }
9727 callback.group_cb(user_data, &names_out.at(0),
9728 static_cast<int>(names_out.size()));
9729
9730 } else {
9731 callback.group_cb(user_data, NULL, 0);
9732 }
9733 }
9734
9735 sr.skip_line();
9736 continue;
9737 }
9738
9739 // object name
9740 if (sr.peek() == 'o' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9741 sr.advance(2);
9742 std::string object_name = sr.read_line();
9743
9744 if (callback.object_cb) {
9745 callback.object_cb(user_data, object_name.c_str());
9746 }
9747
9748 sr.skip_line();
9749 continue;
9750 }
9751
9752#if 0 // @todo
9753 if (sr.peek() == 't' && (sr.peek_at(1) == ' ' || sr.peek_at(1) == '\t')) {
9754 tag_t tag;
9755
9756 sr.advance(2);
9757 tag.name = sr_parseString(sr);
9758
9759 tag_sizes ts = sr_parseTagTriple(sr);
9760
9761 tag.intValues.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_ints));
9762
9763 for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_ints); ++i) {
9764 tag.intValues[i] = sr_parseInt(sr);
9765 }
9766
9767 tag.floatValues.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_reals));
9768 for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_reals); ++i) {
9769 tag.floatValues[i] = sr_parseReal(sr);
9770 }
9771
9772 tag.stringValues.resize(static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_strings));
9773 for (size_t i = 0; i < static_cast<size_t>(ts.num_strings); ++i) {
9774 tag.stringValues[i] = sr_parseString(sr);
9775 }
9776
9777 tags.push_back(tag);
9778 }
9779#endif
9780
9781 // Ignore unknown command.
9782 sr.skip_line();
9783 }
9784
9785 return true;
9786}
9787
9788bool LoadObjWithCallback(std::istream &inStream, const callback_t &callback,
9789 void *user_data /*= NULL*/,
9790 MaterialReader *readMatFn /*= NULL*/,
9791 std::string *warn, /* = NULL*/
9792 std::string *err /*= NULL*/) {
9793 StreamReader sr(inStream);
9794 return LoadObjWithCallbackInternal(sr, callback, user_data, readMatFn,

9798bool ObjReader::ParseFromFile(const std::string &filename,
9799 const ObjReaderConfig &config) {
9800 std::string mtl_search_path;
9801
9802 if (config.mtl_search_path.empty()) {
9803 //
9804 // split at last '/'(for unixish system) or '\\'(for windows) to get
9805 // the base directory of .obj file
9806 //
9807 size_t pos = filename.find_last_of("/\\");
9808 if (pos != std::string::npos) {
9809 mtl_search_path = filename.substr(0, pos);
9810 }
9811 } else {
9812 mtl_search_path = config.mtl_search_path;
9813 }
9814
9815 valid_ = LoadObj(&attrib_, &shapes_, &materials_, &warning_, &error_,
9816 filename.c_str(), mtl_search_path.c_str(),
9817 config.triangulate, config.vertex_color);
9818
9819 return valid_;
9820}

9822bool ObjReader::ParseFromString(const std::string &obj_text,
9823 const std::string &mtl_text,

9825 std::stringbuf obj_buf(obj_text);
9826 std::stringbuf mtl_buf(mtl_text);
9827
9828 std::istream obj_ifs(&obj_buf);
9829 std::istream mtl_ifs(&mtl_buf);
9830
9831 MaterialStreamReader mtl_ss(mtl_ifs);
9832
9833 valid_ = LoadObj(&attrib_, &shapes_, &materials_, &warning_, &error_,
9834 &obj_ifs, &mtl_ss, config.triangulate, config.vertex_color);
9835
9836 return valid_;
9837}
9838
9839// ===========================================================================
9840// Optimized API implementation (C++11+)
9841// ===========================================================================
9842// ---- ArenaAllocator implementation ----
9843
9844void *ArenaAllocator::allocate(size_t bytes, size_t alignment) {
9845 if (bytes == 0) bytes = 1;
9846
9847 // Try to allocate from current block
9848 if (head_) {
9849 size_t space = head_->capacity - head_->used;
9850 void *ptr = head_->data + head_->used;
9851 if (std::align(alignment, bytes, ptr, space)) {
9852 head_->used = static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<unsigned char *>(ptr) -
9853 head_->data) +
9854 bytes;
9855 return ptr;
9856 }
9857 }
9858
9859 // Guard against size_t overflow in bytes + alignment
9860 if (bytes > SIZE_MAX - alignment) {
9861#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_ENABLE_EXCEPTION
9862 throw std::bad_alloc();
9863#else
9864 return nullptr;
9865#endif
9866 }
9867
9868 // Need a new block
9869 Block *b = new_block(bytes + alignment);
9870 if (!b) return nullptr;
9871 size_t space = b->capacity;
9872 void *ptr = b->data;
9873 if (!std::align(alignment, bytes, ptr, space)) {
9874 // Defensive guard: the block was allocated with capacity >= bytes + alignment,
9875 // so alignment should always succeed. This handles edge cases where the
9876 // capacity was insufficient due to unusual alignment requirements.
9877#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_ENABLE_EXCEPTION
9878 throw std::bad_alloc();
9879#else
9880 return nullptr;
9881#endif
9882 }
9883 b->used =
9884 static_cast<size_t>(static_cast<unsigned char *>(ptr) - b->data) + bytes;
9885 return ptr;
9886}
9887
9888void ArenaAllocator::reset() { destroy(); }
9889
9890ArenaAllocator::Block *ArenaAllocator::new_block(size_t min_bytes) {
9891 size_t cap = (min_bytes > default_block_size_) ? min_bytes
9892 : default_block_size_;
9893#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_ENABLE_EXCEPTION
9894 // Allocate data buffer first: if this throws std::bad_alloc, no Block
9895 // struct is leaked. If the subsequent Block allocation throws (very
9896 // unlikely for a small POD), the data buffer is cleaned up.
9897 unsigned char *data = new unsigned char[cap];
9898 Block *b;
9899 try {
9900 b = new Block;
9901 } catch (...) {
9902 delete[] data;
9903 throw;
9904 }
9905 b->data = data;
9906#else
9907 Block *b = new (std::nothrow) Block;
9908 if (!b) return nullptr;
9909 b->data = new (std::nothrow) unsigned char[cap];
9910 if (!b->data) { delete b; return nullptr; }
9911#endif
9912 b->capacity = cap;
9913 b->used = 0;
9914 b->next = head_;
9915 head_ = b;
9916 return b;
9917}
9918
9919void ArenaAllocator::destroy() {
9920 Block *b = head_;
9921 while (b) {
9922 Block *next = b->next;
9923 delete[] b->data;
9924 delete b;
9925 b = next;
9926 }
9927 head_ = nullptr;
9928}
9929
9930// ---- Optimized parser internals ----
9931
9932namespace opt_internal {
9933
9934static const int kOptMaxThreads = 32;
9935
9936struct LineInfo {
9937 size_t pos;
9938 size_t len;
9939};
9940
9941#define TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(x) (((x) == ' ') || ((x) == '\t'))
9942#define TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(x) \
9943 (static_cast<unsigned int>((x) - '0') < static_cast<unsigned int>(10))
9944#define TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(x) \
9945 (((x) == '\r') || ((x) == '\n') || ((x) == '\0'))
9946
9947static inline void opt_skip_space(const char **token) {
9948 while ((**token) == ' ' || (**token) == '\t') {
9949 (*token)++;
9950 }
9951}
9952
9953static inline int opt_until_space(const char *token) {
9954 const char *p = token;
9955 while (p[0] != '\0' && p[0] != ' ' && p[0] != '\t' && p[0] != '\r' &&
9956 p[0] != '\n') {
9957 p++;
9958 }
9959 return static_cast<int>(p - token);
9960}
9961
9962static inline int opt_my_atoi(const char *c) {
9963 unsigned int value = 0;
9964 int sign = 1;
9965 if (*c == '+' || *c == '-') {
9966 if (*c == '-') sign = -1;
9967 c++;
9968 }
9969 while ((*c >= '0') && (*c <= '9')) {
9970 const unsigned int digit = static_cast<unsigned int>(*c - '0');
9971 const unsigned int limit = (sign < 0)
9972 ? static_cast<unsigned int>(INT_MAX) + 1u
9973 : static_cast<unsigned int>(INT_MAX);
9974 if (value > (limit / 10u) ||
9975 (value == (limit / 10u) && digit > (limit % 10u))) {
9976 return (sign < 0) ? INT_MIN : INT_MAX;
9977 }
9978 value = value * 10u + digit;
9979 c++;
9980 }
9981 if (sign < 0) {
9982 if (value == static_cast<unsigned int>(INT_MAX) + 1u) {
9983 return INT_MIN;
9984 }
9985 return -static_cast<int>(value);
9986 }
9987 return static_cast<int>(value);
9988}
9989
9990static inline const char *opt_find_index_token_end(const char *token) {
9991 const char *end = token;
9992 while (*end != '\0' && *end != '/' && *end != ' ' && *end != '\t' &&
9993 *end != '\r' && *end != '\n') {
9994 end++;
9995 }
9996 return end;
9997}
9998
9999static inline bool opt_tryParseIndexToken(const char *token, const char *end,
10000 int *value) {
10001 if (!value || !token || !end || token >= end) return false;
10002
10003 const char *cursor = token;
10004 if (*cursor == '+' || *cursor == '-') {
10005 cursor++;
10006 }
10007 if (cursor >= end) return false;
10008 while (cursor < end) {
10009 if (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(*cursor)) return false;
10010 cursor++;
10011 }
10012
10013 *value = opt_my_atoi(token);
10014 return true;
10015}
10016
10017static inline bool opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(int idx, int n, int *ret,
10018 bool allow_zero) {
10019 if (!ret) return false;
10020 if (idx > 0) {
10021 (*ret) = idx - 1;
10022 return true;
10023 }
10024 if (idx == 0) {
10025 (*ret) = -1;
10026 return allow_zero;
10027 }
10028
10029 (*ret) = n + idx;
10030 return ((*ret) >= 0);
10031}
10032
10033static inline void opt_appendZeroIndexWarning(std::string *warn,
10034 const std::string &source_name,
10035 size_t line_num) {
10036 if (!warn) return;
10037
10038 std::stringstream ss;
10039 ss << source_name << ":" << line_num
10040 << ": warning: zero value index found (will have a value of -1 for "
10041 "normal and tex indices)\n";
10042 (*warn) += ss.str();
10043}
10044
10045static inline bool opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
10046 int raw_idx, int n, bool allow_zero, const std::string &source_name,
10047 size_t line_num, std::string *warn, int *resolved_idx) {
10048 if (raw_idx > 0) {
10049 if (resolved_idx) {
10050 (*resolved_idx) = raw_idx - 1;
10051 }
10052 return true;
10053 }
10054
10055 if (raw_idx == 0) {
10056 opt_appendZeroIndexWarning(warn, source_name, line_num);
10057 if (resolved_idx) {
10058 (*resolved_idx) = -1;
10059 }
10060 return allow_zero;
10061 }
10062
10063 if (resolved_idx) {
10064 (*resolved_idx) = n + raw_idx;
10065 return ((*resolved_idx) >= 0);
10066 }
10067
10068 return ((n + raw_idx) >= 0);
10069}

10071static inline void opt_updateGreatestIndex(int idx, int *greatest) {
10072 if (!greatest) return;
10073 if (idx > *greatest) {
10074 *greatest = idx;

10078static inline void opt_appendOutOfBoundsWarnings(std::string *warn,
10079 int greatest_v_idx,
10080 int greatest_vn_idx,
10081 int greatest_vt_idx,
10082 int num_vertices,
10083 int num_normals,
10084 int num_texcoords,
10085 size_t line_num) {
10086 if (!warn) return;
10087
10088 if (greatest_v_idx >= num_vertices) {
10089 std::stringstream ss;
10090 ss << "Vertex indices out of bounds (line " << line_num << ".)\n\n";
10091 (*warn) += ss.str();
10092 }
10093 if (greatest_vn_idx >= num_normals) {
10094 std::stringstream ss;
10095 ss << "Vertex normal indices out of bounds (line " << line_num << ".)\n\n";
10096 (*warn) += ss.str();
10097 }
10098 if (greatest_vt_idx >= num_texcoords) {
10099 std::stringstream ss;
10100 ss << "Vertex texcoord indices out of bounds (line " << line_num
10101 << ".)\n\n";
10102 (*warn) += ss.str();
10103 }
10104}

10106// Hand-written fallback double parser. Compiled only when fast_float is
10107// disabled (TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT); otherwise callers use
10108// fast_float::from_chars directly and this function is not needed.
10109#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
10110static bool opt_tryParseDouble(const char *s, const char *s_end,
10111 double *result) {
10112 if (s >= s_end) return false;
10113
10114 // Handle nan/inf keywords with OBJ-compatible replacement values.
10115 {
10116 const char *p = s;
10117 bool neg = false;
10118 if (p < s_end && *p == '-') { neg = true; ++p; }
10119 else if (p < s_end && *p == '+') { ++p; }
10120 if (p < s_end) {
10121 char fc = *p;
10122 if (fc >= 'A' && fc <= 'Z') fc += 32;
10123 if (fc == 'n' && (p + 2 < s_end)) {
10124 char c1 = p[1], c2 = p[2];
10125 if (c1 >= 'A' && c1 <= 'Z') c1 += 32;
10126 if (c2 >= 'A' && c2 <= 'Z') c2 += 32;
10127 if (c1 == 'a' && c2 == 'n') {
10128 *result = 0.0;
10129 return true;
10130 }
10131 }
10132 if (fc == 'i' && (p + 2 < s_end)) {
10133 char c1 = p[1], c2 = p[2];
10134 if (c1 >= 'A' && c1 <= 'Z') c1 += 32;
10135 if (c2 >= 'A' && c2 <= 'Z') c2 += 32;
10136 if (c1 == 'n' && c2 == 'f') {
10137 *result = neg ? std::numeric_limits<double>::lowest()
10138 : (std::numeric_limits<double>::max)();
10139 return true;
10140 }
10141 }
10142 }
10143 }
10144
10145 double mantissa = 0.0;
10146 int exponent = 0;
10147 char sign = '+';
10148 char exp_sign = '+';
10149 const char *curr = s;
10150 int read = 0;
10151 bool end_not_reached = false;
10152 bool has_leading_decimal = false;
10153
10154 if (*curr == '+' || *curr == '-') {
10155 sign = *curr;
10156 curr++;
10157 }
10158
10159 if (curr == s_end) return false;
10160
10161 if (*curr == '.') {
10162 has_leading_decimal = true;
10163 } else if (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(*curr)) {
10164 return false;
10165 }
10166
10167 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10168 if (!has_leading_decimal) {
10169 while (end_not_reached && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(*curr)) {
10170 mantissa *= 10;
10171 mantissa += static_cast<int>(*curr - '0');
10172 curr++;
10173 read++;
10174 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10175 }
10176 if (read == 0) return false;
10177 }
10178 if (!end_not_reached) goto opt_assemble;
10179
10180 if (*curr == '.') {
10181 curr++;
10182 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10183 double frac_scale = 0.1;
10184 while (end_not_reached && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(*curr)) {
10185 mantissa += static_cast<int>(*curr - '0') * frac_scale;
10186 frac_scale *= 0.1;
10187 read++;
10188 curr++;
10189 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10190 }
10191 if (has_leading_decimal && read == 0) return false;
10192 } else if (*curr != 'e' && *curr != 'E') {
10193 goto opt_assemble;
10194 }
10195
10196 if (!end_not_reached) goto opt_assemble;
10197
10198 if (*curr == 'e' || *curr == 'E') {
10199 curr++;
10200 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10201 if (!end_not_reached) return false;
10202 if (*curr == '+' || *curr == '-') {
10203 exp_sign = *curr;
10204 curr++;
10205 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10206 } else if (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(*curr)) {
10207 return false;
10208 }
10209 read = 0;
10210 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10211 while (end_not_reached && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_DIGIT(*curr)) {
10212 // Clamp to avoid signed integer overflow (UB). |exponent| > 308
10213 // already exceeds double range, so further digits are irrelevant.
10214 if (exponent < 0x7FFFFFF) {
10215 exponent *= 10;
10216 exponent += static_cast<int>(*curr - '0');
10217 }
10218 curr++;
10219 read++;
10220 end_not_reached = (curr != s_end);
10221 }
10222 exponent *= (exp_sign == '+' ? 1 : -1);
10223 if (read == 0) return false;
10224 }
10225
10226opt_assemble:
10227 *result = (sign == '+' ? 1.0 : -1.0) *
10228 (exponent ? std::ldexp(mantissa * std::pow(5.0, exponent), exponent)
10229 : mantissa);
10230 return true;
10231}
10232#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT

10234struct opt_index_t {
10235 int vertex_index, texcoord_index, normal_index;
10236 // Sentinel for "field not present" to distinguish from OBJ relative index -1.
10237 // Using expression form for C++11 static const initializer compatibility.
10238 static const int kNotPresent = -2147483647 - 1; // == std::numeric_limits<int>::min()
10239 opt_index_t()
10240 : vertex_index(kNotPresent),
10241 texcoord_index(kNotPresent),
10242 normal_index(kNotPresent) {}
10243 opt_index_t(int vi, int ti, int ni)
10244 : vertex_index(vi), texcoord_index(ti), normal_index(ni) {}
10245};
10246
10247static bool opt_parseRawTriple(const char **token, opt_index_t *ret) {
10248 if (!token || !ret) return false;
10249
10250 opt_index_t vi;
10251 const char *segment_end = opt_find_index_token_end(*token);
10252 if (!opt_tryParseIndexToken(*token, segment_end, &vi.vertex_index)) {
10253 return false;
10254 }
10255 *token = segment_end;
10256 if (**token != '/') {
10257 *ret = vi;
10258 return true;
10259 }
10260 (*token)++;
10261
10262 if (**token == '/') {
10263 (*token)++;
10264 segment_end = opt_find_index_token_end(*token);
10265 if (!opt_tryParseIndexToken(*token, segment_end, &vi.normal_index)) {
10266 return false;
10267 }
10268 *token = segment_end;
10269 *ret = vi;
10270 return true;
10271 }
10272
10273 segment_end = opt_find_index_token_end(*token);
10274 if (!opt_tryParseIndexToken(*token, segment_end, &vi.texcoord_index)) {
10275 return false;
10276 }
10277 *token = segment_end;
10278 if (**token != '/') {
10279 *ret = vi;
10280 return true;
10281 }
10282 (*token)++;
10283 segment_end = opt_find_index_token_end(*token);
10284 if (!opt_tryParseIndexToken(*token, segment_end, &vi.normal_index)) {
10285 return false;
10286 }
10287 *token = segment_end;
10288 *ret = vi;
10289 return true;
10290}
