10292static inline int opt_length_until_newline(const char *token, size_t n) {
10293 size_t len = 0;
10294 for (len = 0; len < n; len++) {
10295 if (token[len] == '\n' || token[len] == '\r') break;
10296 }
10297 // Trim trailing whitespace
10298 while (len > 0 && (token[len - 1] == ' ' || token[len - 1] == '\t')) {
10299 len--;
10300 }
10301 return static_cast<int>(len);
10302}
10303
10304static inline int opt_length_until_token_or_comment(const char *token, size_t n) {
10305 size_t len = 0;
10306 for (len = 0; len < n; len++) {
10307 const char c = token[len];
10308 if (c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == ' ' || c == '\t') break;
10309 }
10310 return static_cast<int>(len);
10311}
10312
10313static inline std::string opt_parseGroupName(const char *token, size_t n) {
10314 std::string name;
10315 size_t i = 0;
10316 while (i < n) {
10317 while (i < n && (token[i] == ' ' || token[i] == '\t')) {
10318 i++;
10319 }
10320 if (i >= n || token[i] == '\n' || token[i] == '\r' || token[i] == '\0' ||
10321 token[i] == '#') {
10322 break;
10323 }
10324
10325 const size_t start = i;
10326 while (i < n && token[i] != '\n' && token[i] != '\r' &&
10327 token[i] != '\0' && token[i] != ' ' && token[i] != '\t') {
10328 i++;
10329 }
10330
10331 if (!name.empty()) {
10332 name.push_back(' ');
10333 }
10334 name.append(token + start, i - start);
10335 }
10336 return name;
10337}
10338
10339static inline bool opt_tryParseFloatToken(real_t *out, const char **token) {
10340 if (!out || !token) return false;
10341 const char *cursor = *token;
10342 opt_skip_space(&cursor);
10343 if (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(cursor[0]) || cursor[0] == '#' || cursor[0] == '\0') {
10344 return false;
10345 }
10346 const char *end = cursor;
10347 while (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(end[0]) && end[0] != '#' && end[0] != ' ' &&
10348 end[0] != '\t' && end[0] != '\0') {
10349 end++;
10350 }
10351#ifndef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
10352 // Handle nan/inf with OBJ-compatible values before fast_float.
10353 {
10354 const char *q = cursor;
10355 if (q < end && (*q == '+' || *q == '-')) ++q;
10356 if (q < end) {
10357 char fc = *q;
10358 if (fc >= 'A' && fc <= 'Z') fc += 32;
10359 if (fc == 'n' || fc == 'i') {
10360 double special_val;
10361 const char *end_ptr;
10362 if (detail_fp::tryParseNanInf(cursor, end, &special_val, &end_ptr)) {
10363 *out = static_cast<real_t>(special_val);
10364 *token = end;
10365 return true;
10366 }
10367 }
10368 }
10369 }
10370 // Parse directly to real_t (float or double) via fast_float — avoids
10371 // the double→float conversion and is ~3-4x faster than the hand-rolled parser.
10372 real_t tmp;
10373 auto r = fast_float::from_chars(cursor, end, tmp,
10374 fast_float::chars_format::general |
10375 fast_float::chars_format::allow_leading_plus);
10376 if (r.ec == tinyobj_ff::ff_errc::ok) {
10377 *out = tmp;
10378 *token = end;
10379 return true;
10380 }
10381 return false;
10382#else
10383 double val = 0.0;
10384 if (!opt_tryParseDouble(cursor, end, &val)) {
10385 return false;
10386 }
10387 *out = static_cast<real_t>(val);
10388 *token = end;
10389 return true;
10390#endif
10391}
10392
10393static inline int opt_count_remaining_scalars(const char *token) {
10394 int count = 0;
10395 const char *cursor = token;
10396 while (true) {
10397 opt_skip_space(&cursor);
10398 if (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(cursor[0]) || cursor[0] == '#' ||
10399 cursor[0] == '\0') {
10400 break;
10401 }
10402 count++;
10403 while (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(cursor[0]) && cursor[0] != '#' &&
10404 cursor[0] != ' ' && cursor[0] != '\t' && cursor[0] != '\0') {
10405 cursor++;
10406 }
10407 }
10408 return count;
10409}

10585static inline bool opt_is_valid_face_vertex(const std::vector<real_t> &vertices,
10586 const index_t &idx) {
10587 if (idx.vertex_index < 0) return false;
10588 const size_t vi = static_cast<size_t>(idx.vertex_index);
10589 return ((3 * vi + 2) < vertices.size());
10590}
10591
10592static inline size_t opt_triangulate_face(const std::vector<real_t> &vertices,
10593 const index_t *face,
10594 size_t face_count,
10595 index_t *dst) {
10596 if (face_count < 3) return 0;
10597 if (face_count == 3) {
10598 dst[0] = face[0];
10599 dst[1] = face[1];
10600 dst[2] = face[2];
10601 return 3;
10602 }
10603
10604 for (size_t i = 0; i < face_count; i++) {
10605 if (!opt_is_valid_face_vertex(vertices, face[i])) {
10606 return 0;
10607 }
10608 }
10609
10610 if (face_count == 4) {
10611 const size_t vi0 = static_cast<size_t>(face[0].vertex_index);
10612 const size_t vi1 = static_cast<size_t>(face[1].vertex_index);
10613 const size_t vi2 = static_cast<size_t>(face[2].vertex_index);
10614 const size_t vi3 = static_cast<size_t>(face[3].vertex_index);
10615
10616 const real_t v0x = vertices[vi0 * 3 + 0];
10617 const real_t v0y = vertices[vi0 * 3 + 1];
10618 const real_t v0z = vertices[vi0 * 3 + 2];
10619 const real_t v1x = vertices[vi1 * 3 + 0];
10620 const real_t v1y = vertices[vi1 * 3 + 1];
10621 const real_t v1z = vertices[vi1 * 3 + 2];
10622 const real_t v2x = vertices[vi2 * 3 + 0];
10623 const real_t v2y = vertices[vi2 * 3 + 1];
10624 const real_t v2z = vertices[vi2 * 3 + 2];
10625 const real_t v3x = vertices[vi3 * 3 + 0];
10626 const real_t v3y = vertices[vi3 * 3 + 1];
10627 const real_t v3z = vertices[vi3 * 3 + 2];
10628
10629 const real_t e02x = v2x - v0x;
10630 const real_t e02y = v2y - v0y;
10631 const real_t e02z = v2z - v0z;
10632 const real_t e13x = v3x - v1x;
10633 const real_t e13y = v3y - v1y;
10634 const real_t e13z = v3z - v1z;
10635 const real_t sqr02 = e02x * e02x + e02y * e02y + e02z * e02z;
10636 const real_t sqr13 = e13x * e13x + e13y * e13y + e13z * e13z;
10637
10638 if (sqr02 < sqr13) {
10639 dst[0] = face[0];
10640 dst[1] = face[1];
10641 dst[2] = face[2];
10642 dst[3] = face[0];
10643 dst[4] = face[2];
10644 dst[5] = face[3];
10645 } else {
10646 dst[0] = face[0];
10647 dst[1] = face[1];
10648 dst[2] = face[3];
10649 dst[3] = face[1];
10650 dst[4] = face[2];
10651 dst[5] = face[3];
10652 }
10653 return 6;
10654 }
10655
10656 std::vector<index_t> remaining(face, face + face_count);
10657 size_t axes[2] = {1, 2};
10658 for (size_t k = 0; k < face_count; ++k) {
10659 const size_t vi0 = static_cast<size_t>(face[(k + 0) % face_count].vertex_index);
10660 const size_t vi1 = static_cast<size_t>(face[(k + 1) % face_count].vertex_index);
10661 const size_t vi2 = static_cast<size_t>(face[(k + 2) % face_count].vertex_index);
10662 const real_t v0x = vertices[vi0 * 3 + 0];
10663 const real_t v0y = vertices[vi0 * 3 + 1];
10664 const real_t v0z = vertices[vi0 * 3 + 2];
10665 const real_t v1x = vertices[vi1 * 3 + 0];
10666 const real_t v1y = vertices[vi1 * 3 + 1];
10667 const real_t v1z = vertices[vi1 * 3 + 2];
10668 const real_t v2x = vertices[vi2 * 3 + 0];
10669 const real_t v2y = vertices[vi2 * 3 + 1];
10670 const real_t v2z = vertices[vi2 * 3 + 2];
10671 const real_t e0x = v1x - v0x;
10672 const real_t e0y = v1y - v0y;
10673 const real_t e0z = v1z - v0z;
10674 const real_t e1x = v2x - v1x;
10675 const real_t e1y = v2y - v1y;
10676 const real_t e1z = v2z - v1z;
10677 const real_t cx = std::fabs(e0y * e1z - e0z * e1y);
10678 const real_t cy = std::fabs(e0z * e1x - e0x * e1z);
10679 const real_t cz = std::fabs(e0x * e1y - e0y * e1x);
10680 const real_t epsilon = std::numeric_limits<real_t>::epsilon();
10681 if (cx > epsilon || cy > epsilon || cz > epsilon) {
10682 if (!(cx > cy && cx > cz)) {
10683 axes[0] = 0;
10684 if (cz > cx && cz > cy) {
10685 axes[1] = 1;
10686 }
10687 }
10688 break;
10689 }
10690 }
10691
10692 size_t out = 0;
10693 size_t guess_vert = 0;
10694 size_t remaining_iterations = remaining.size();
10695 size_t previous_remaining_vertices = remaining.size();
10696 while (remaining.size() > 3 && remaining_iterations > 0) {
10697 const size_t npolys = remaining.size();
10698 if (guess_vert >= npolys) {
10699 guess_vert -= npolys;
10700 }
10701
10702 if (previous_remaining_vertices != npolys) {
10703 previous_remaining_vertices = npolys;
10704 remaining_iterations = npolys;
10705 } else {
10706 remaining_iterations--;
10707 }
10708
10709 index_t ind[3];
10710 real_t vx[3];
10711 real_t vy[3];
10712 for (size_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
10713 ind[k] = remaining[(guess_vert + k) % npolys];
10714 const size_t vi = static_cast<size_t>(ind[k].vertex_index);
10715 vx[k] = vertices[vi * 3 + axes[0]];
10716 vy[k] = vertices[vi * 3 + axes[1]];
10717 }
10718
10719 const real_t e0x = vx[1] - vx[0];
10720 const real_t e0y = vy[1] - vy[0];
10721 const real_t e1x = vx[2] - vx[1];
10722 const real_t e1y = vy[2] - vy[1];
10723 const real_t cross_val = e0x * e1y - e0y * e1x;
10724 const real_t area =
10725 (vx[0] * vy[1] - vy[0] * vx[1]) * static_cast<real_t>(0.5);
10726 if (cross_val * area < static_cast<real_t>(0.0)) {
10727 guess_vert += 1;
10728 continue;
10729 }
10730
10731 bool overlap = false;
10732 for (size_t other_vert = 3; other_vert < npolys; ++other_vert) {
10733 const size_t idx = (guess_vert + other_vert) % npolys;
10734 const size_t ovi = static_cast<size_t>(remaining[idx].vertex_index);
10735 const real_t tx = vertices[ovi * 3 + axes[0]];
10736 const real_t ty = vertices[ovi * 3 + axes[1]];
10737 if (pnpoly(3, vx, vy, tx, ty)) {
10738 overlap = true;
10739 break;
10740 }
10741 }
10742
10743 if (overlap) {
10744 guess_vert += 1;
10745 continue;
10746 }
10747
10748 dst[out++] = ind[0];
10749 dst[out++] = ind[1];
10750 dst[out++] = ind[2];
10751 remaining.erase(remaining.begin() +
10752 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>((guess_vert + 1) % npolys));
10753 }
10754
10755 if (remaining.size() == 3) {
10756 dst[out++] = remaining[0];
10757 dst[out++] = remaining[1];
10758 dst[out++] = remaining[2];
10759 }
10760
10761 return out;
10762}
10763
10764// Pointer+size overloads for TypedArray-based API
10765static inline bool opt_is_valid_face_vertex(const real_t * /*vertices*/,
10766 size_t vertices_size,
10767 const index_t &idx) {
10768 if (idx.vertex_index < 0) return false;
10769 const size_t vi = static_cast<size_t>(idx.vertex_index);
10770 return ((3 * vi + 2) < vertices_size);
10771}
10772
10773static inline size_t opt_triangulate_face(const real_t *vertices,
10774 size_t vertices_size,
10775 const index_t *face,
10776 size_t face_count,
10777 index_t *dst) {
10778 if (face_count < 3) return 0;
10779 if (face_count == 3) {
10780 dst[0] = face[0]; dst[1] = face[1]; dst[2] = face[2];
10781 return 3;
10782 }
10783
10784 for (size_t i = 0; i < face_count; i++) {
10785 if (!opt_is_valid_face_vertex(vertices, vertices_size, face[i])) return 0;
10786 }
10787
10788 if (face_count == 4) {
10789 const size_t vi0 = static_cast<size_t>(face[0].vertex_index);
10790 const size_t vi1 = static_cast<size_t>(face[1].vertex_index);
10791 const size_t vi2 = static_cast<size_t>(face[2].vertex_index);
10792 const size_t vi3 = static_cast<size_t>(face[3].vertex_index);
10793 const real_t e02x = vertices[vi2*3+0] - vertices[vi0*3+0];
10794 const real_t e02y = vertices[vi2*3+1] - vertices[vi0*3+1];
10795 const real_t e02z = vertices[vi2*3+2] - vertices[vi0*3+2];
10796 const real_t e13x = vertices[vi3*3+0] - vertices[vi1*3+0];
10797 const real_t e13y = vertices[vi3*3+1] - vertices[vi1*3+1];
10798 const real_t e13z = vertices[vi3*3+2] - vertices[vi1*3+2];
10799 const real_t sqr02 = e02x*e02x + e02y*e02y + e02z*e02z;
10800 const real_t sqr13 = e13x*e13x + e13y*e13y + e13z*e13z;
10801 if (sqr02 < sqr13) {
10802 dst[0]=face[0]; dst[1]=face[1]; dst[2]=face[2];
10803 dst[3]=face[0]; dst[4]=face[2]; dst[5]=face[3];
10804 } else {
10805 dst[0]=face[0]; dst[1]=face[1]; dst[2]=face[3];
10806 dst[3]=face[1]; dst[4]=face[2]; dst[5]=face[3];
10807 }
10808 return 6;
10809 }
10810
10811 // General polygon — ear clipping
10812 std::vector<index_t> remaining(face, face + face_count);
10813 size_t axes[2] = {1, 2};
10814 for (size_t k = 0; k < face_count; ++k) {
10815 const size_t vi0 = static_cast<size_t>(face[(k+0)%face_count].vertex_index);
10816 const size_t vi1 = static_cast<size_t>(face[(k+1)%face_count].vertex_index);
10817 const size_t vi2 = static_cast<size_t>(face[(k+2)%face_count].vertex_index);
10818 const real_t e0x = vertices[vi1*3+0]-vertices[vi0*3+0];
10819 const real_t e0y = vertices[vi1*3+1]-vertices[vi0*3+1];
10820 const real_t e0z = vertices[vi1*3+2]-vertices[vi0*3+2];
10821 const real_t e1x = vertices[vi2*3+0]-vertices[vi1*3+0];
10822 const real_t e1y = vertices[vi2*3+1]-vertices[vi1*3+1];
10823 const real_t e1z = vertices[vi2*3+2]-vertices[vi1*3+2];
10824 const real_t cx = std::fabs(e0y*e1z - e0z*e1y);
10825 const real_t cy = std::fabs(e0z*e1x - e0x*e1z);
10826 const real_t cz = std::fabs(e0x*e1y - e0y*e1x);
10827 const real_t epsilon = std::numeric_limits<real_t>::epsilon();
10828 if (cx > epsilon || cy > epsilon || cz > epsilon) {
10829 if (!(cx > cy && cx > cz)) {
10830 axes[0] = 0;
10831 if (cz > cx && cz > cy) axes[1] = 1;
10832 }
10833 break;
10834 }
10835 }
10836
10837 size_t out = 0;
10838 size_t guess_vert = 0;
10839 size_t remaining_iterations = remaining.size();
10840 size_t previous_remaining_vertices = remaining.size();
10841 while (remaining.size() > 3 && remaining_iterations > 0) {
10842 const size_t npolys = remaining.size();
10843 if (guess_vert >= npolys) guess_vert -= npolys;
10844 if (previous_remaining_vertices != npolys) {
10845 previous_remaining_vertices = npolys;
10846 remaining_iterations = npolys;
10847 } else {
10848 remaining_iterations--;
10849 }
10850 index_t ind[3];
10851 real_t vx[3], vy[3];
10852 for (size_t k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
10853 ind[k] = remaining[(guess_vert + k) % npolys];
10854 const size_t vi = static_cast<size_t>(ind[k].vertex_index);
10855 vx[k] = vertices[vi*3+axes[0]];
10856 vy[k] = vertices[vi*3+axes[1]];
10857 }
10858 const real_t e0x_ = vx[1]-vx[0], e0y_ = vy[1]-vy[0];
10859 const real_t e1x_ = vx[2]-vx[1], e1y_ = vy[2]-vy[1];
10860 const real_t cross_val = e0x_*e1y_ - e0y_*e1x_;
10861 const real_t area = (vx[0]*vy[1] - vy[0]*vx[1]) * static_cast<real_t>(0.5);
10862 if (cross_val * area < static_cast<real_t>(0.0)) {
10863 guess_vert += 1; continue;
10864 }
10865 bool overlap = false;
10866 for (size_t other_vert = 3; other_vert < npolys; ++other_vert) {
10867 const size_t idx = (guess_vert + other_vert) % npolys;
10868 const size_t ovi = static_cast<size_t>(remaining[idx].vertex_index);
10869 const real_t ptx = vertices[ovi*3+axes[0]];
10870 const real_t pty = vertices[ovi*3+axes[1]];
10871 if (pnpoly(3, vx, vy, ptx, pty)) { overlap = true; break; }
10872 }
10873 if (overlap) { guess_vert += 1; continue; }
10874 dst[out++] = ind[0]; dst[out++] = ind[1]; dst[out++] = ind[2];
10875 remaining.erase(remaining.begin() +
10876 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>((guess_vert + 1) % npolys));
10877 }
10878 if (remaining.size() == 3) {
10879 dst[out++] = remaining[0]; dst[out++] = remaining[1]; dst[out++] = remaining[2];
10880 }
10881 return out;
10882}
10883
10884static bool opt_parseLine(OptCommand *command, const char *p, size_t p_len,
10885 bool triangulate, bool *parse_error,
10886 std::string *parse_error_message) {
10887 // Parse directly from the original buffer without copying.
10888 // The caller guarantees that p[p_len] is '\n' (or a sentinel),
10889 // so character-scanning helpers that stop on '\n' are safe.
10890 if (parse_error) *parse_error = false;
10891 if (parse_error_message) parse_error_message->clear();
10892 const char *token = p;
10893 command->type = OPT_CMD_EMPTY;
10894 opt_skip_space(&token);
10895
10896 if (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(token[0]) || token[0] == '#') return false;
10897
10898 // vertex
10899 if (token[0] == 'v' && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[1])) {
10900 token += 2;
10901 real_t x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
10902 real_t r = real_t(1.0), g = real_t(1.0), b = real_t(1.0);
10903 real_t w = real_t(1.0);
10904 if (!opt_tryParseFloatToken(&x, &token) ||
10905 !opt_tryParseFloatToken(&y, &token) ||
10906 !opt_tryParseFloatToken(&z, &token)) {
10907 if (parse_error) *parse_error = true;
10908 if (parse_error_message) *parse_error_message = "failed to parse `v' line";
10909 return false;
10910 }
10911 const char *extra_token = token;
10912 opt_skip_space(&extra_token);
10913 const int extra_components = opt_count_remaining_scalars(extra_token);
10914 if (extra_components == 1) {
10915 // v x y z w (4 total) — weight only
10916 const char *weight_cursor = extra_token;
10917 if (opt_tryParseFloatToken(&w, &weight_cursor)) {
10918 command->has_vertex_weight = true;
10919 command->vw = w;
10920 }
10921 } else if (extra_components == 3) {
10922 // v x y z r g b (6 total) — color, weight = r (legacy compat)
10923 real_t cr = r, cg = g, cb = b;
10924 const char *color_cursor = extra_token;
10925 if (opt_tryParseFloatToken(&cr, &color_cursor) &&
10926 opt_tryParseFloatToken(&cg, &color_cursor) &&
10927 opt_tryParseFloatToken(&cb, &color_cursor)) {
10928 command->has_vertex_weight = true;
10929 command->vw = cr;
10930 command->has_vertex_color = true;
10931 command->vc_r = cr;
10932 command->vc_g = cg;
10933 command->vc_b = cb;
10934 }
10935 } else if (extra_components >= 4) {
10936 // v x y z w r g b (7+ total) — weight + color.
10937 // NOTE: 7-component vertices are NOT part of the OBJ spec nor the common
10938 // vertex-color extension, which define only xyz / xyzw / xyzrgb and treat
10939 // weight and color as mutually exclusive. tinyobjloader accepts this as
10940 // an extension: the 4th value is the weight, the next three are RGB.
10941 // (The classic LoadObj / LoadObjWithCallback path instead caps at 6 and
10942 // ignores any extra tokens, so it differs from LoadObjOpt here.)
10943 real_t vw = real_t(1.0), cr = r, cg = g, cb = b;
10944 const char *wc_cursor = extra_token;
10945 if (opt_tryParseFloatToken(&vw, &wc_cursor) &&
10946 opt_tryParseFloatToken(&cr, &wc_cursor) &&
10947 opt_tryParseFloatToken(&cg, &wc_cursor) &&
10948 opt_tryParseFloatToken(&cb, &wc_cursor)) {
10949 command->has_vertex_weight = true;
10950 command->vw = vw;
10951 command->has_vertex_color = true;
10952 command->vc_r = cr;
10953 command->vc_g = cg;
10954 command->vc_b = cb;
10955 }
10956 }
10957 command->vx = x;
10958 command->vy = y;
10959 command->vz = z;
10960 command->type = OPT_CMD_V;
10961 return true;
10962 }
10963
10964 // normal
10965 if (token[0] == 'v' && token[1] == 'n' && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[2])) {
10966 token += 3;
10967 real_t x = 0, y = 0, z = 0;
10968 if (!opt_tryParseFloatToken(&x, &token) ||
10969 !opt_tryParseFloatToken(&y, &token) ||
10970 !opt_tryParseFloatToken(&z, &token)) {
10971 if (parse_error) *parse_error = true;
10972 if (parse_error_message) *parse_error_message = "failed to parse `vn' line";
10973 return false;
10974 }
10975 command->nx = x;
10976 command->ny = y;
10977 command->nz = z;
10978 command->type = OPT_CMD_VN;
10979 return true;
10980 }
10981
10982 // texcoord
10983 if (token[0] == 'v' && token[1] == 't' && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[2])) {
10984 token += 3;
10985 real_t x = 0, y = 0, w = 0;
10986 if (!opt_tryParseFloatToken(&x, &token)) {
10987 if (parse_error) *parse_error = true;
10988 if (parse_error_message) *parse_error_message = "failed to parse `vt' line";
10989 return false;
10990 }
10991 const char *y_token = token;
10992 if (opt_tryParseFloatToken(&y, &y_token)) {
10993 token = y_token;
10994 }
10995 const char *extra_token = token;
10996 opt_skip_space(&extra_token);
10997 if (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(extra_token[0]) && extra_token[0] != '#' &&
10998 opt_tryParseFloatToken(&w, &extra_token)) {
10999 command->has_texcoord_w = true;
11000 command->tw = w;
11001 }
11002 command->tx = x;
11003 command->ty = y;
11004 command->type = OPT_CMD_VT;
11005 return true;
11006 }
11007
11008 // face
11009 if (token[0] == 'f' && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[1])) {
11010 token += 2;
11011 opt_skip_space(&token);
11012
11013 // Collect face vertices (use small stack buffer for typical case)
11014 opt_index_t face_buf[8];
11015 std::vector<opt_index_t> face_overflow;
11016 int face_count = 0;
11017
11018 while (!TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(token[0]) && !opt_is_comment_start(token)) {
11019 opt_index_t vi;
11020 if (!opt_parseRawTriple(&token, &vi)) {
11021 if (parse_error) *parse_error = true;
11022 if (parse_error_message) {
11023 *parse_error_message = "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
11024 }
11025 return false;
11026 }
11027 opt_skip_space(&token);
11028 if (face_count < 8) {
11029 face_buf[face_count++] = vi;
11030 } else {
11031 if (face_count == 8) {
11032 face_overflow.reserve(16);
11033 for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) face_overflow.push_back(face_buf[k]);
11034 }
11035 face_overflow.push_back(vi);
11036 face_count++;
11037 }
11038 }
11039
11040 command->type = OPT_CMD_F;
11041 command->face_vertex_count = static_cast<unsigned int>(face_count);
11042
11043 // Preserve degenerate faces so warnings and EOF shape behavior can match
11044 // the legacy loader, but do not reserve output slots for them.
11045 if (face_count < 3) {
11046 command->degenerate_face = true;
11047 command->emitted_face_count = 0;
11048 command->emitted_face_verts = 0;
11049 command->f_count = 0;
11050 return true;
11051 }
11052
11053 if (triangulate) {
11054 command->emitted_face_count = static_cast<unsigned int>(face_count - 2);
11055 command->emitted_face_verts = 3;
11056 command->f_count = command->emitted_face_count * 3;
11057
11058 opt_index_t *dst = command->f_inline;
11059 if (command->face_vertex_count > OptCommand::kInlineIndexCapacity) {
11060 command->f_heap.resize(command->face_vertex_count);
11061 dst = command->f_heap.data();
11062 }
11063 if (face_count <= 8) {
11064 for (int k = 0; k < face_count; k++) dst[k] = face_buf[k];
11065 } else {
11066 for (size_t k = 0; k < face_overflow.size(); k++) dst[k] = face_overflow[k];
11067 }
11068 } else {
11069 command->emitted_face_count = 1;
11070 command->emitted_face_verts = static_cast<unsigned int>(face_count);
11071 command->f_count = static_cast<unsigned int>(face_count);
11072 command->face_vertex_count = static_cast<unsigned int>(face_count);
11073
11074 opt_index_t *dst = command->f_inline;
11075 if (command->f_count > OptCommand::kInlineIndexCapacity) {
11076 command->f_heap.resize(command->f_count);
11077 dst = command->f_heap.data();
11078 }
11079
11080 if (face_count <= 8) {
11081 for (int k = 0; k < face_count; k++) dst[k] = face_buf[k];
11082 } else {
11083 for (size_t k = 0; k < face_overflow.size(); k++) {
11084 dst[k] = face_overflow[k];
11085 }
11086 }
11087 }
11088 return true;
11089 }
11090
11091 // usemtl
11092 if (std::strncmp(token, "usemtl", 6) == 0 &&
11093 TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[6])) {
11094 token += 7;
11095 opt_skip_space(&token);
11096 command->material_name = token;
11097 command->material_name_len = static_cast<unsigned int>(
11098 opt_length_until_token_or_comment(token,
11099 p_len - static_cast<size_t>(token - p)));
11100 command->type = OPT_CMD_USEMTL;
11101 return true;
11102 }
11103
11104 // mtllib
11105 if (std::strncmp(token, "mtllib", 6) == 0 &&
11106 TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[6])) {
11107 token += 7;
11108 opt_skip_space(&token);
11109 command->mtllib_name = token;
11110 command->mtllib_name_len = static_cast<unsigned int>(
11111 opt_length_until_newline(token,
11112 p_len - static_cast<size_t>(token - p)));
11113 command->type = OPT_CMD_MTLLIB;
11114 return true;
11115 }
11116
11117 // group
11118 if (token[0] == 'g' &&
11119 (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[1]) || TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(token[1]) ||
11120 token[1] == '\0')) {
11121 if (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[1])) {
11122 token += 2;
11123 } else {
11124 token += 1;
11125 }
11126 command->group_name_storage = opt_parseGroupName(
11127 token, p_len - static_cast<size_t>(token - p));
11128 command->group_name = nullptr;
11129 command->group_name_len =
11130 static_cast<unsigned int>(command->group_name_storage.size());
11131 command->group_name_empty = command->group_name_storage.empty();
11132 command->type = OPT_CMD_G;
11133 return true;
11134 }
11135
11136 // object
11137 if (token[0] == 'o' && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[1])) {
11138 token += 2;
11139 command->object_name = token;
11140 command->object_name_len = static_cast<unsigned int>(
11141 p_len - static_cast<size_t>(token - p));
11142 command->type = OPT_CMD_O;
11143 return true;
11144 }
11145
11146 // smoothing group
11147 if (token[0] == 's' && TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_SPACE(token[1])) {
11148 token += 2;
11149 opt_skip_space(&token);
11150 if (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(token[0])) {
11151 command->smoothing_group_id = 0;
11152 } else if (token[0] == 'o' && token[1] == 'f' && token[2] == 'f' &&
11153 (TINYOBJ_OPT_IS_NEW_LINE(token[3]) || token[3] == '\0' ||
11154 token[3] == ' ' || token[3] == '\t')) {
11155 command->smoothing_group_id = 0;
11156 } else {
11157 const int sm = opt_my_atoi(token);
11158 command->smoothing_group_id = (sm > 0) ? static_cast<unsigned int>(sm) : 0;
11159 }
11160 command->type = OPT_CMD_S;
11161 return true;
11162 }
11163
11164 return false;
11165}
11166
11167// ---- SIMD newline scanning ----
11168
11169#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_SIMD
11170
11171// Include <intrin.h> for _BitScanForward on MSVC. Placed here (not at the top)
11172// because it's only needed when TINYOBJLOADER_USE_SIMD is enabled.
11173#if defined(_MSC_VER)
11174#include <intrin.h>
11175#endif
11176
11177// Portable count-trailing-zeros for SIMD bitmask extraction
11178static inline unsigned int tinyobj_ctz(unsigned int x) {
11179#if defined(_MSC_VER)
11180 unsigned long idx;
11181 _BitScanForward(&idx, x);
11182 return static_cast<unsigned int>(idx);
11183#else
11184 return static_cast<unsigned int>(__builtin_ctz(x));
11185#endif
11186}
11187
11188#if defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_AVX2)
11189
11191static void simd_find_newlines(const char *buf, size_t len,
11192 std::vector<size_t> &positions) {
11193 const __m256i nl = _mm256_set1_epi8('\n');
11194 const __m256i cr = _mm256_set1_epi8('\r');
11195 size_t i = 0;
11196 for (; i + 32 <= len; i += 32) {
11197 __m256i chunk =
11198 _mm256_loadu_si256(reinterpret_cast<const __m256i *>(buf + i));
11199 __m256i cmp_nl = _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(chunk, nl);
11200 __m256i cmp_cr = _mm256_cmpeq_epi8(chunk, cr);
11201 __m256i combined = _mm256_or_si256(cmp_nl, cmp_cr);
11202 unsigned int mask = static_cast<unsigned int>(_mm256_movemask_epi8(combined));
11203 while (mask) {
11204 unsigned int bit = tinyobj_ctz(mask);
11205 positions.push_back(i + bit);
11206 mask &= mask - 1;
11207 }
11208 }
11209 // Scalar tail
11210 for (; i < len; i++) {
11211 if (buf[i] == '\n' || buf[i] == '\r') positions.push_back(i);
11212 }
11213}
11214
11215#elif defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_SSE2)
11216
11218static void simd_find_newlines(const char *buf, size_t len,
11219 std::vector<size_t> &positions) {
11220 const __m128i nl = _mm_set1_epi8('\n');
11221 const __m128i cr = _mm_set1_epi8('\r');
11222 size_t i = 0;
11223 for (; i + 16 <= len; i += 16) {
11224 __m128i chunk =
11225 _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i *>(buf + i));
11226 __m128i cmp_nl = _mm_cmpeq_epi8(chunk, nl);
11227 __m128i cmp_cr = _mm_cmpeq_epi8(chunk, cr);
11228 __m128i combined = _mm_or_si128(cmp_nl, cmp_cr);
11229 int mask = _mm_movemask_epi8(combined);
11230 while (mask) {
11231 int bit = static_cast<int>(tinyobj_ctz(static_cast<unsigned int>(mask)));
11232 positions.push_back(i + static_cast<size_t>(bit));
11233 mask &= mask - 1;
11234 }
11235 }
11236 // Scalar tail
11237 for (; i < len; i++) {
11238 if (buf[i] == '\n' || buf[i] == '\r') positions.push_back(i);
11239 }
11240}
11241
11242#elif defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_NEON)
11243
11245static void simd_find_newlines(const char *buf, size_t len,
11246 std::vector<size_t> &positions) {
11247 const uint8x16_t nl = vdupq_n_u8('\n');
11248 const uint8x16_t cr = vdupq_n_u8('\r');
11249 size_t i = 0;
11250 for (; i + 16 <= len; i += 16) {
11251 uint8x16_t chunk = vld1q_u8(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(buf + i));
11252 uint8x16_t cmp_nl = vceqq_u8(chunk, nl);
11253 uint8x16_t cmp_cr = vceqq_u8(chunk, cr);
11254 uint8x16_t combined = vorrq_u8(cmp_nl, cmp_cr);
11255 for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
11256 if (vgetq_lane_u8(combined, 0) != 0) {
11257 positions.push_back(i + static_cast<size_t>(j));
11258 }
11259 combined = vextq_u8(combined, combined, 1);
11260 }
11261 }
11262 for (; i < len; i++) {
11263 if (buf[i] == '\n' || buf[i] == '\r') positions.push_back(i);
11264 }
11265}
11266
11267#endif // SIMD variant
11268
11272static void simd_build_line_infos(const char *buf, size_t len,
11273 const std::vector<size_t> &nl_positions,
11274 std::vector<LineInfo> &out) {
11275 out.reserve(nl_positions.size() + 1);
11276 size_t prev = 0;
11277 for (size_t k = 0; k < nl_positions.size(); k++) {
11278 size_t pos = nl_positions[k];
11279 // Skip the '\n' in a '\r\n' pair (the '\r' already created a boundary)
11280 if (buf[pos] == '\n' && pos > 0 && buf[pos - 1] == '\r') {
11281 prev = pos + 1;
11282 continue;
11283 }
11284 size_t line_len = pos - prev;
11285 if (line_len > 0) {
11286 LineInfo info;
11287 info.pos = prev;
11288 info.len = line_len;
11289 out.push_back(info);
11290 }
11291 prev = pos + 1;
11292 }
11293 // Handle last line without trailing newline
11294 if (prev < len) {
11295 size_t line_len = len - prev;
11296 if (line_len > 0) {
11297 LineInfo info;
11298 info.pos = prev;
11299 info.len = line_len;
11300 out.push_back(info);
11301 }
11302 }
11303}
11304
11305#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_USE_SIMD
11306
11308static void scalar_find_line_infos(const char *buf, size_t start, size_t end,
11309 std::vector<LineInfo> &out) {
11310 size_t prev = start;
11311 for (size_t i = start; i < end; i++) {
11312 if (buf[i] == '\n' || buf[i] == '\r') {
11313 size_t line_len = i - prev;
11314 // Skip \r in \r\n pair
11315 if (buf[i] == '\r' && (i + 1 < end) && buf[i + 1] == '\n') {
11316 if (line_len > 0) {
11317 LineInfo info;
11318 info.pos = prev;
11319 info.len = line_len;
11320 out.push_back(info);
11321 }
11322 i++; // skip the \n in \r\n
11323 } else {
11324 // bare \n or bare \r
11325 if (line_len > 0) {
11326 LineInfo info;
11327 info.pos = prev;
11328 info.len = line_len;
11329 out.push_back(info);
11330 }
11331 }
11332 prev = i + 1;
11333 }
11334 }
11335 if (prev < end) {
11336 size_t line_len = end - prev;
11337 if (line_len > 0) {
11338 LineInfo info;
11339 info.pos = prev;
11340 info.len = line_len;
11341 out.push_back(info);
11342 }
11343 }
11344}

11346template <typename DstVec, typename SrcVec>
11347static void opt_assign_vector(DstVec *dst, const SrcVec &src) {
11348 if (!dst) return;
11349 dst->assign(src.begin(), src.end());
11350}
11351
11352static void ConvertLegacyShapeToBasic(const shape_t &src, basic_shape_t<> *dst) {
11353 if (!dst) return;
11354 dst->name = src.name;
11355 opt_assign_vector(&dst->mesh.indices, src.mesh.indices);
11356 opt_assign_vector(&dst->mesh.num_face_vertices, src.mesh.num_face_vertices);
11357 opt_assign_vector(&dst->mesh.material_ids, src.mesh.material_ids);
11358 opt_assign_vector(&dst->mesh.smoothing_group_ids,
11359 src.mesh.smoothing_group_ids);
11360 dst->mesh.tags = src.mesh.tags;
11361 opt_assign_vector(&dst->lines.indices, src.lines.indices);
11362 opt_assign_vector(&dst->lines.num_line_vertices, src.lines.num_line_vertices);
11363 opt_assign_vector(&dst->points.indices, src.points.indices);
11364}
11365
11366static void ConvertLegacyResultToBasic(
11367 const attrib_t &src_attrib, const std::vector<shape_t> &src_shapes,
11368 const std::vector<material_t> &src_materials, basic_attrib_t<> *dst_attrib,
11369 std::vector<basic_shape_t<> > *dst_shapes,
11370 std::vector<material_t> *dst_materials) {
11371 if (dst_attrib) {
11372 opt_assign_vector(&dst_attrib->vertices, src_attrib.vertices);
11373 opt_assign_vector(&dst_attrib->vertex_weights, src_attrib.vertex_weights);
11374 opt_assign_vector(&dst_attrib->normals, src_attrib.normals);
11375 opt_assign_vector(&dst_attrib->texcoords, src_attrib.texcoords);
11376 opt_assign_vector(&dst_attrib->texcoord_ws, src_attrib.texcoord_ws);
11377 opt_assign_vector(&dst_attrib->colors, src_attrib.colors);
11378 dst_attrib->skin_weights = src_attrib.skin_weights;
11379 dst_attrib->indices.clear();
11380 dst_attrib->face_num_verts.clear();
11381 dst_attrib->material_ids.clear();
11382 for (size_t si = 0; si < src_shapes.size(); si++) {
11383 const mesh_t &mesh = src_shapes[si].mesh;
11384 dst_attrib->indices.insert(dst_attrib->indices.end(), mesh.indices.begin(),
11385 mesh.indices.end());
11386 dst_attrib->face_num_verts.insert(dst_attrib->face_num_verts.end(),
11387 mesh.num_face_vertices.begin(),
11388 mesh.num_face_vertices.end());
11389 dst_attrib->material_ids.insert(dst_attrib->material_ids.end(),
11390 mesh.material_ids.begin(),
11391 mesh.material_ids.end());
11392 }
11393 }
11394
11395 if (dst_shapes) {
11396 dst_shapes->clear();
11397 dst_shapes->resize(src_shapes.size());
11398 for (size_t i = 0; i < src_shapes.size(); i++) {
11399 ConvertLegacyShapeToBasic(src_shapes[i], &(*dst_shapes)[i]);
11400 }
11401 }
11402
11403 if (dst_materials) {
11404 (*dst_materials) = src_materials;
11405 }
11406}

11410static inline bool opt_line_start_is_legacy(const char *p, size_t rem) {
11411 while (rem > 0 && (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t')) { p++; rem--; }
11412 if (rem >= 3 && p[0] == 'v' && p[1] == 'w' &&
11413 (p[2] == ' ' || p[2] == '\t'))
11414 return true;
11415 if (rem >= 2 &&
11416 ((p[0] == 'l' || p[0] == 'p' || p[0] == 't') &&
11417 (p[1] == ' ' || p[1] == '\t')))
11418 return true;
11419 return false;
11420}
11421
11425static bool opt_buffer_requires_legacy_fallback(const char *buf, size_t len) {
11426 if (!buf || len == 0) return false;
11427 // Check at start of buffer
11428 if (opt_line_start_is_legacy(buf, len)) return true;
11429 // Scan for line breaks (\n first, then bare \r)
11430 for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
11431 const char needle = (pass == 0) ? '\n' : '\r';
11432 const char *p = buf;
11433 size_t remaining = len;
11434 for (;;) {
11435 const char *nl = static_cast<const char *>(
11436 std::memchr(p, needle, remaining));
11437 if (!nl) break;
11438 size_t offset = static_cast<size_t>(nl - buf) + 1;
11439 if (offset >= len) break;
11440 // Skip \n in \r\n pair on the \r pass to avoid double-checking
11441 if (needle == '\r' && offset < len && buf[offset] == '\n') {
11442 p = buf + offset + 1;
11443 remaining = len - offset - 1;
11444 continue;
11445 }
11446 if (opt_line_start_is_legacy(buf + offset, len - offset)) return true;
11447 p = buf + offset;
11448 remaining = len - offset;
11449 }
11450 }
11451 return false;
11452}
11453
11460class OptFloatCache {
11461 public:
11462 static const int kFp32MaxKeyLen =
11463 std::numeric_limits<float>::digits10 + 2; // 8
11464 static const int kRealMaxKeyLen =
11465 std::numeric_limits<real_t>::digits10 + 2;
11466 static const int kAlphabetSize = 15;
11467
11468 explicit OptFloatCache(int max_nodes = 1024, bool fp32_keys = true)
11469 : max_nodes_(max_nodes < 2 ? 2 : (max_nodes > 65535 ? 65535 : max_nodes)),
11470 max_key_len_(fp32_keys ? kFp32MaxKeyLen : kRealMaxKeyLen) {
11471 nodes_.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(max_nodes_));
11472 nodes_.resize(1);
11473 std::memset(&nodes_[0], 0, sizeof(Node));
11474 }
11475
11476 static inline int char_index(char c) {
11477 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return c - '0';
11478 switch (c) {
11479 case '+': return 10;
11480 case '-': return 11;
11481 case '.': return 12;
11482 case 'e': return 13;
11483 case 'E': return 14;
11484 }
11485 return -1;
11486 }
11487
11489 inline bool lookup(const char *key, int key_len, real_t *out) const {
11490 if (key_len <= 0 || key_len > max_key_len_) return false;
11491 int node = 0;
11492 for (int i = 0; i < key_len; i++) {
11493 int ci = char_index(key[i]);
11494 if (ci < 0) return false;
11495 int child = nodes_[static_cast<size_t>(node)]
11496 .children[static_cast<size_t>(ci)];
11497 if (child == 0) return false;
11498 node = child;
11499 }
11500 const Node &n = nodes_[static_cast<size_t>(node)];
11501 if (!n.has_value) return false;
11502 *out = n.value;
11503 return true;
11504 }
11505
11507 inline bool insert(const char *key, int key_len, real_t value) {
11508 if (key_len <= 0 || key_len > max_key_len_) return false;
11509 int node = 0;
11510 for (int i = 0; i < key_len; i++) {
11511 int ci = char_index(key[i]);
11512 if (ci < 0) return false;
11513 uint16_t child = nodes_[static_cast<size_t>(node)]
11514 .children[static_cast<size_t>(ci)];
11515 if (child == 0) {
11516 if (static_cast<int>(nodes_.size()) >= max_nodes_) return false;
11517 child = static_cast<uint16_t>(nodes_.size());
11518 // Write back BEFORE push_back (push_back may realloc)
11519 nodes_[static_cast<size_t>(node)]
11520 .children[static_cast<size_t>(ci)] = child;
11521 Node new_node;
11522 std::memset(&new_node, 0, sizeof(Node));
11523 nodes_.push_back(new_node);
11524 }
11525 node = static_cast<int>(child);
11526 }
11527 Node &n = nodes_[static_cast<size_t>(node)];
11528 n.value = value;
11529 n.has_value = true;
11530 return true;
11531 }
11532
11533 int max_key_len() const { return max_key_len_; }
11534
11535 private:
11536 struct Node {
11537 uint16_t children[kAlphabetSize]; // 30 bytes
11538 real_t value; // 4 or 8 bytes
11539 bool has_value; // 1 byte
11540 };
11541 std::vector<Node> nodes_;
11542 int max_nodes_;
11543 int max_key_len_;
11544};
11545
11546// Fast inline float parse: skip whitespace, call fast_float with line_end,
11547// advance cursor. No token-end pre-scan. Returns false if no float found.
11548// When cache is non-null, checks/populates the trie cache for short tokens.
11549// Handles nan/inf keywords with OBJ-compatible replacement values (matching
11550// opt_tryParseDouble behavior).
11551#ifndef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
11552static inline bool opt_fast_parse_float(real_t *out, const char **cursor,
11553 const char *line_end,
11554 OptFloatCache *cache = nullptr) {
11555 const char *p = *cursor;
11556 while (p < line_end && (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t')) p++;
11557 if (p >= line_end || *p == '\n' || *p == '\r' || *p == '#') return false;
11558
11559 // Check for nan/inf keywords before calling fast_float (which doesn't
11560 // handle them). Map to OBJ-compatible values: nan→0, +inf→max, -inf→lowest.
11561 {
11562 const char *q = p;
11563 if (q < line_end && (*q == '+' || *q == '-')) ++q;
11564 if (q < line_end) {
11565 char fc = *q;
11566 if (fc >= 'A' && fc <= 'Z') fc += 32;
11567 if (fc == 'n' || fc == 'i') {
11568 double special_val;
11569 const char *end_ptr;
11570 if (detail_fp::tryParseNanInf(p, line_end, &special_val, &end_ptr)) {
11571 *out = static_cast<real_t>(special_val);
11572 *cursor = end_ptr;
11573 return true;
11574 }
11575 }
11576 }
11577 }
11578
11579 // --- Cache fast path: scan up to max_key_len chars for trie lookup ---
11580 if (cache) {
11581 const char *tok_start = p;
11582 const char *kp = p;
11583 int klen = 0;
11584 int mkl = cache->max_key_len();
11585 while (klen < mkl && kp < line_end) {
11586 char c = *kp;
11587 if (c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '#' ||
11588 c == '\0')
11589 break;
11590 if (OptFloatCache::char_index(c) < 0) break;
11591 klen++;
11592 kp++;
11593 }
11594 // Token is cacheable if it ended at a delimiter (not mid-token)
11595 bool at_delim = (kp >= line_end || *kp == ' ' || *kp == '\t' ||
11596 *kp == '\n' || *kp == '\r' || *kp == '#' || *kp == '\0');
11597 if (klen > 0 && at_delim) {
11598 real_t cached;
11599 if (cache->lookup(tok_start, klen, &cached)) {
11600 *out = cached;
11601 *cursor = kp;
11602 return true;
11603 }
11604 // Cache miss — parse normally, then insert
11605 real_t tmp;
11606 auto r = fast_float::from_chars(tok_start, line_end, tmp,
11607 fast_float::chars_format::general |
11608 fast_float::chars_format::allow_leading_plus);
11609 if (r.ec != tinyobj_ff::ff_errc::ok) return false;
11610 *out = tmp;
11611 *cursor = r.ptr;
11612 cache->insert(tok_start, klen, tmp);
11613 return true;
11614 }
11615 // Token too long or has non-float chars — fall through to uncached parse
11616 }
11617
11618 // --- Uncached parse ---
11619 real_t tmp;
11620 auto r = fast_float::from_chars(p, line_end, tmp,
11621 fast_float::chars_format::general |
11622 fast_float::chars_format::allow_leading_plus);
11623 if (r.ec != tinyobj_ff::ff_errc::ok) return false;
11624 *out = tmp;
11625 *cursor = r.ptr;
11626 return true;
11627}
11628#endif
11629
11630// Parse a single line and store into compact per-type thread data.
11631// Fast path: v/vn/vt lines are parsed directly using fast_float with line_end,
11632// bypassing OptCommand entirely. Face/meta lines fall back to opt_parseLine.
11633static void opt_parseLineToThreadData(
11634 OptThreadData &td, const char *line_ptr, size_t line_len,
11635 bool triangulate, size_t line_number,
11636 OptFloatCache *cache = nullptr) {
11637 const char *token = line_ptr;
11638 while (*token == ' ' || *token == '\t') token++;
11639 if (*token == '\n' || *token == '\r' || *token == '#' || *token == '\0')
11640 return;
11641
11642#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
11643 (void)cache; // only consumed by the fast_float fast path below
11644#else
11645 const char *line_end = line_ptr + line_len;
11646
11647 // ---- Fast path: vertex position (v x y z [w] [r g b]) ----
11648 if (token[0] == 'v' && (token[1] == ' ' || token[1] == '\t')) {
11649 const char *cur = token + 2;
11650 real_t x, y, z;
11651 if (!opt_fast_parse_float(&x, &cur, line_end, cache) ||
11652 !opt_fast_parse_float(&y, &cur, line_end, cache) ||
11653 !opt_fast_parse_float(&z, &cur, line_end, cache)) {
11654 td.error_line = line_number;
11655 td.error_message = "failed to parse `v' line";
11656 return;
11657 }
11658 // Write xyz (batch: resize + direct write)
11659 size_t off = td.v_pos.size();
11660 td.v_pos.resize(off + 3);
11661 td.v_pos[off] = x; td.v_pos[off+1] = y; td.v_pos[off+2] = z;
11662
11663 // Check for extra components (weight / color)
11664 real_t extra[4];
11665 int nextra = 0;
11666 while (nextra < 4 && opt_fast_parse_float(&extra[nextra], &cur, line_end, cache))
11667 nextra++;
11668
11669 if (nextra == 1) {
11670 // v x y z w (4 total) — weight only, no color
11671 if (!td.saw_any_weight) {
11672 td.saw_any_weight = true;
11673 td.v_weight.resize(td.num_v, real_t(1.0));
11674 }
11675 td.v_weight.push_back(extra[0]);
11676 td.saw_missing_color = true;
11677 if (td.saw_any_color) {
11678 size_t coff = td.v_color.size();
11679 td.v_color.resize(coff + 3);
11680 td.v_color[coff] = real_t(1.0);
11681 td.v_color[coff+1] = real_t(1.0);
11682 td.v_color[coff+2] = real_t(1.0);
11683 }
11684 } else if (nextra == 3) {
11685 // v x y z r g b (6 total) — color, weight = r (legacy compat)
11686 if (!td.saw_any_weight) {
11687 td.saw_any_weight = true;
11688 td.v_weight.resize(td.num_v, real_t(1.0));
11689 }
11690 td.v_weight.push_back(extra[0]);
11691 if (!td.saw_any_color) {
11692 td.saw_any_color = true;
11693 td.v_color.resize(td.num_v * 3, real_t(1.0));
11694 }
11695 size_t coff = td.v_color.size();
11696 td.v_color.resize(coff + 3);
11697 td.v_color[coff] = extra[0];
11698 td.v_color[coff+1] = extra[1];
11699 td.v_color[coff+2] = extra[2];
11700 } else if (nextra >= 4) {
11701 // v x y z w r g b (7+ total) — weight + color.
11702 // NOTE: 7-component vertices are NOT part of the OBJ spec nor the common
11703 // vertex-color extension, which define only xyz / xyzw / xyzrgb and treat
11704 // weight and color as mutually exclusive. tinyobjloader accepts this as
11705 // an extension: the 4th value is the weight, the next three are RGB.
11706 // (The classic LoadObj / LoadObjWithCallback path instead caps at 6 and
11707 // ignores any extra tokens, so it differs from LoadObjOpt here.)
11708 if (!td.saw_any_weight) {
11709 td.saw_any_weight = true;
11710 td.v_weight.resize(td.num_v, real_t(1.0));
11711 }
11712 td.v_weight.push_back(extra[0]);
11713 if (!td.saw_any_color) {
11714 td.saw_any_color = true;
11715 td.v_color.resize(td.num_v * 3, real_t(1.0));
11716 }
11717 size_t coff = td.v_color.size();
11718 td.v_color.resize(coff + 3);
11719 td.v_color[coff] = extra[1];
11720 td.v_color[coff+1] = extra[2];
11721 td.v_color[coff+2] = extra[3];
11722 } else {
11723 // nextra == 0 or 2 — no color
11724 if (td.saw_any_weight) td.v_weight.push_back(real_t(1.0));
11725 td.saw_missing_color = true;
11726 if (td.saw_any_color) {
11727 size_t coff = td.v_color.size();
11728 td.v_color.resize(coff + 3);
11729 td.v_color[coff] = real_t(1.0);
11730 td.v_color[coff+1] = real_t(1.0);
11731 td.v_color[coff+2] = real_t(1.0);
11732 }
11733 }
11734 td.num_v++;
11735 return;
11736 }
11737
11738 // ---- Fast path: normal (vn x y z) ----
11739 if (token[0] == 'v' && token[1] == 'n' &&
11740 (token[2] == ' ' || token[2] == '\t')) {
11741 const char *cur = token + 3;
11742 real_t x, y, z;
11743 if (!opt_fast_parse_float(&x, &cur, line_end, cache) ||
11744 !opt_fast_parse_float(&y, &cur, line_end, cache) ||
11745 !opt_fast_parse_float(&z, &cur, line_end, cache)) {
11746 td.error_line = line_number;
11747 td.error_message = "failed to parse `vn' line";
11748 return;
11749 }
11750 size_t off = td.vn_data.size();
11751 td.vn_data.resize(off + 3);
11752 td.vn_data[off] = x; td.vn_data[off+1] = y; td.vn_data[off+2] = z;
11753 td.num_vn++;
11754 return;
11755 }
11756
11757 // ---- Fast path: texcoord (vt u [v [w]]) ----
11758 if (token[0] == 'v' && token[1] == 't' &&
11759 (token[2] == ' ' || token[2] == '\t')) {
11760 const char *cur = token + 3;
11761 real_t u = 0, v = 0;
11762 if (!opt_fast_parse_float(&u, &cur, line_end, cache)) {
11763 td.error_line = line_number;
11764 td.error_message = "failed to parse `vt' line";
11765 return;
11766 }
11767 opt_fast_parse_float(&v, &cur, line_end, cache); // v is optional
11768 real_t w = 0;
11769 bool has_w = opt_fast_parse_float(&w, &cur, line_end, cache);
11770
11771 size_t off = td.vt_data.size();
11772 td.vt_data.resize(off + 2);
11773 td.vt_data[off] = u; td.vt_data[off+1] = v;
11774 if (has_w) {
11775 if (!td.saw_any_texcoord_w) {
11776 td.saw_any_texcoord_w = true;
11777 td.vt_w.resize(td.num_vt, real_t(0.0));
11778 }
11779 td.vt_w.push_back(w);
11780 } else if (td.saw_any_texcoord_w) {
11781 td.vt_w.push_back(real_t(0.0));
11782 }
11783 td.num_vt++;
11784 return;
11785 }
11786#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
11787
11788 // ---- Slow path: face / meta commands via opt_parseLine ----
11789 OptCommand cmd;
11790 bool parse_error = false;
11791 bool ok = opt_parseLine(&cmd, line_ptr, line_len, triangulate,
11792 &parse_error, nullptr);
11793 if (parse_error) {
11794 td.error_line = line_number;
11795 std::string msg;
11796 opt_parseLine(&cmd, line_ptr, line_len, triangulate, nullptr, &msg);
11797 td.error_message = msg;
11798 return;
11799 }
11800 if (!ok) return;
11801
11802 switch (cmd.type) {
11803#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
11804 // When fast_float is disabled, v/vn/vt fall through to here
11805 case OPT_CMD_V: {
11806 size_t off = td.v_pos.size();
11807 td.v_pos.resize(off + 3);
11808 td.v_pos[off] = cmd.vx; td.v_pos[off+1] = cmd.vy; td.v_pos[off+2] = cmd.vz;
11809 if (cmd.has_vertex_weight) {
11810 if (!td.saw_any_weight) {
11811 td.saw_any_weight = true;
11812 td.v_weight.resize(td.num_v, real_t(1.0));
11813 }
11814 td.v_weight.push_back(cmd.vw);
11815 } else if (td.saw_any_weight) {
11816 td.v_weight.push_back(real_t(1.0));
11817 }
11818 if (cmd.has_vertex_color) {
11819 if (!td.saw_any_color) {
11820 td.saw_any_color = true;
11821 td.v_color.resize(td.num_v * 3, real_t(1.0));
11822 }
11823 td.v_color.push_back(cmd.vc_r);
11824 td.v_color.push_back(cmd.vc_g);
11825 td.v_color.push_back(cmd.vc_b);
11826 } else {
11827 td.saw_missing_color = true;
11828 if (td.saw_any_color) {
11829 td.v_color.push_back(real_t(1.0));
11830 td.v_color.push_back(real_t(1.0));
11831 td.v_color.push_back(real_t(1.0));
11832 }
11833 }
11834 td.num_v++;
11835 break;
11836 }
11837 case OPT_CMD_VN: {
11838 size_t off = td.vn_data.size();
11839 td.vn_data.resize(off + 3);
11840 td.vn_data[off] = cmd.nx; td.vn_data[off+1] = cmd.ny; td.vn_data[off+2] = cmd.nz;
11841 td.num_vn++;
11842 break;
11843 }
11844 case OPT_CMD_VT: {
11845 size_t off = td.vt_data.size();
11846 td.vt_data.resize(off + 2);
11847 td.vt_data[off] = cmd.tx; td.vt_data[off+1] = cmd.ty;
11848 if (cmd.has_texcoord_w) {
11849 if (!td.saw_any_texcoord_w) {
11850 td.saw_any_texcoord_w = true;
11851 td.vt_w.resize(td.num_vt, real_t(0.0));
11852 }
11853 td.vt_w.push_back(cmd.tw);
11854 } else if (td.saw_any_texcoord_w) {
11855 td.vt_w.push_back(real_t(0.0));
11856 }
11857 td.num_vt++;
11858 break;
11859 }
11860#endif // TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
11861 case OPT_CMD_F: {
11862 OptFaceCmd fc;
11863 fc.face_vertex_count = cmd.face_vertex_count;
11864 fc.emitted_face_count = cmd.emitted_face_count;
11865 fc.emitted_face_verts = cmd.emitted_face_verts;
11866 fc.f_count = cmd.f_count;
11867 fc.degenerate = cmd.degenerate_face;
11868 fc.source_line = static_cast<uint32_t>(line_number);
11869 fc.v_count_before = static_cast<uint32_t>(td.num_v);
11870 fc.vn_count_before = static_cast<uint32_t>(td.num_vn);
11871 fc.vt_count_before = static_cast<uint32_t>(td.num_vt);
11872 if (!cmd.f_heap.empty()) {
11873 fc.f_heap = std::move(cmd.f_heap);
11874 } else if (cmd.face_vertex_count <= OptFaceCmd::kInlineCap) {
11875 for (uint32_t k = 0; k < cmd.face_vertex_count; k++)
11876 fc.f_inline[k] = cmd.f_inline[k];
11877 } else {
11878 fc.f_heap.assign(cmd.f_inline, cmd.f_inline + cmd.face_vertex_count);
11879 }
11880 td.num_f_indices += fc.f_count;
11881 td.num_f_faces += fc.emitted_face_count;
11882 OptSeqEntry se;
11883 se.kind = OptSeqEntry::SEQ_FACE;
11884 se.index = static_cast<uint32_t>(td.faces.size());
11885 td.seq.push_back(se);
11886 td.faces.push_back(std::move(fc));
11887 break;
11888 }
11889 case OPT_CMD_G:
11890 case OPT_CMD_O:
11891 case OPT_CMD_USEMTL:
11892 case OPT_CMD_MTLLIB:
11893 case OPT_CMD_S: {
11894 OptMetaCmd mc;
11895 mc.type = cmd.type;
11896 mc.source_line = static_cast<uint32_t>(line_number);
11897 if (cmd.type == OPT_CMD_G) {
11898 mc.str_storage = cmd.group_name_storage;
11899 mc.str_ptr = cmd.group_name;
11900 mc.str_len = cmd.group_name_len;
11901 mc.group_name_empty = cmd.group_name_empty;
11902 } else if (cmd.type == OPT_CMD_O) {
11903 mc.str_ptr = cmd.object_name;
11904 mc.str_len = cmd.object_name_len;
11905 } else if (cmd.type == OPT_CMD_USEMTL) {
11906 mc.str_ptr = cmd.material_name;
11907 mc.str_len = cmd.material_name_len;
11908 } else if (cmd.type == OPT_CMD_MTLLIB) {
11909 mc.str_ptr = cmd.mtllib_name;
11910 mc.str_len = cmd.mtllib_name_len;
11911 } else if (cmd.type == OPT_CMD_S) {
11912 mc.smoothing_group_id = cmd.smoothing_group_id;
11913 td.saw_any_smoothing = true;
11914 }
11915 OptSeqEntry se;
11916 se.kind = OptSeqEntry::SEQ_META;
11917 se.index = static_cast<uint32_t>(td.metas.size());
11918 td.seq.push_back(se);
11919 td.metas.push_back(std::move(mc));
11920 break;
11921 }
11922 default:
11923 break;
11924 }
11925}
11926
11927} // namespace opt_internal
11928
11929// Internal implementation with optional basedir for material path resolution
11930static bool LoadObjOpt_internal(basic_attrib_t<> *attrib,
11931 std::vector<basic_shape_t<>> *shapes,
11932 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
11933 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
11934 const char *buf, size_t buf_len,
11935 const std::string &mtl_basedir,
11936 const std::string &source_name,
11937 bool enable_mtllib_loading,
11938 const OptLoadConfig &config) {
11939 using namespace opt_internal;
11940
11941 if (!attrib || !shapes) {
11942 if (err) *err = "attrib and shapes must not be null.";
11943 return false;
11944 }
11945
11946 attrib->vertices.clear();
11947 attrib->vertex_weights.clear();
11948 attrib->normals.clear();
11949 attrib->texcoords.clear();
11950 attrib->texcoord_ws.clear();
11951 attrib->colors.clear();
11952 attrib->skin_weights.clear();
11953 attrib->indices.clear();
11954 attrib->face_num_verts.clear();
11955 attrib->material_ids.clear();
11956 shapes->clear();
11957 if (materials) materials->clear();
11958
11959 if (buf_len < 1) return true; // empty buffer is not an error
11960
11961 if (!buf) {
11962 if (err) *err = "buf must not be null when buf_len > 0.";
11963 return false;
11964 }
11965
11966 // Ensure buffer ends with a newline for safe tokenization (avoids
11967 // one-byte over-read on the last line when parsing directly from the
11968 // buffer without per-line copies).
11969 const char *work_buf = buf;
11970 size_t work_len = buf_len;
11971 std::vector<char> buf_with_sentinel;
11972 if (buf[buf_len - 1] != '\n') {
11973 buf_with_sentinel.assign(buf, buf + buf_len);
11974 buf_with_sentinel.push_back('\n');
11975 work_buf = buf_with_sentinel.data();
11976 work_len = buf_with_sentinel.size();
11977 }
11978
11979 // Determine thread count
11980 int num_threads = 1;
11981#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MULTITHREADING
11982 if (config.num_threads < 0) {
11983 num_threads = static_cast<int>(std::thread::hardware_concurrency());
11984 if (num_threads < 1) num_threads = 1;
11985 } else if (config.num_threads > 1) {
11986 num_threads = config.num_threads;
11987 }
11988 if (num_threads > kOptMaxThreads) num_threads = kOptMaxThreads;
11989#else
11990#endif
11991
11992 // ---- Phase 1: find line boundaries ----
11993 std::vector<LineInfo> all_line_infos;
11994
11995#if defined(TINYOBJLOADER_USE_SIMD) && \
11996 (defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_SSE2) || defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_AVX2) || \
11997 defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_NEON))
11998 {
11999 std::vector<size_t> nl_positions;
12000 nl_positions.reserve(work_len / 64);
12001 simd_find_newlines(work_buf, work_len, nl_positions);
12002 simd_build_line_infos(work_buf, work_len, nl_positions, all_line_infos);
12003 }
12004#else
12005 {
12006 all_line_infos.reserve(work_len / 64);
12007 scalar_find_line_infos(work_buf, 0, work_len, all_line_infos);
12008 }
12009#endif
12010
12011 const size_t total_lines = all_line_infos.size();
12012 if (total_lines == 0) return true;
12013
12014 // Fast buffer-level check for legacy-only tokens (replaces per-line scan)
12015 if (opt_buffer_requires_legacy_fallback(work_buf, work_len)) {
12016 std::string input(buf, buf + buf_len);
12017 std::istringstream iss(input);
12018 attrib_t legacy_attrib;
12019 std::vector<shape_t> legacy_shapes;
12020 std::vector<material_t> legacy_materials;
12021 MaterialFileReader mat_reader(mtl_basedir);
12022 MaterialReader *reader =
12023 enable_mtllib_loading ? static_cast<MaterialReader *>(&mat_reader) : NULL;
12024 const bool ok = LoadObj(&legacy_attrib, &legacy_shapes, &legacy_materials,
12025 warn, err, &iss, reader, config.triangulate, false);
12026 if (!ok) {
12027 return false;
12028 }
12029 ConvertLegacyResultToBasic(legacy_attrib, legacy_shapes, legacy_materials,
12030 attrib, shapes, materials);
12031 return true;
12032 }
12033
12034 // ---- Phase 2: parse lines (compact storage) ----
12035 // Single-threaded or multi-threaded depending on compile option.
12036
12037 const size_t num_t = static_cast<size_t>(num_threads);
12038 std::vector<OptThreadData> thread_data(num_t);
12039
12040#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MULTITHREADING
12041 // Multi-threaded path
12042 {
12043 size_t lines_per_thread = total_lines / num_t;
12044 std::vector<std::thread> workers;
12045 workers.reserve(num_t);
12046
12047 for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; t++) {
12048 size_t start = static_cast<size_t>(t) * lines_per_thread;
12049 size_t end = (t == num_threads - 1)
12050 ? total_lines
12051 : (static_cast<size_t>(t) + 1) * lines_per_thread;
12052
12053 workers.emplace_back([&, t, start, end]() {
12054 OptThreadData &td = thread_data[static_cast<size_t>(t)];
12055 size_t est_lines = end - start;
12056 td.v_pos.reserve(est_lines * 2);
12057 td.faces.reserve(est_lines / 3);
12058 td.seq.reserve(est_lines / 3);
12059 OptFloatCache *tc = nullptr;
12060#ifndef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
12061 OptFloatCache thread_cache(config.float_cache_max_nodes,
12062 config.fp32_cache);
12063 if (config.float_cache) tc = &thread_cache;
12064#endif
12065 for (size_t i = start; i < end; i++) {
12066 opt_parseLineToThreadData(td, &work_buf[all_line_infos[i].pos],
12067 all_line_infos[i].len, config.triangulate,
12068 i + 1, tc);
12069 if (td.error_line != 0) break;
12070 }
12071 });
12072 }
12073 for (auto &w : workers) w.join();
12074 }
12075
12076#else
12077 // Single-threaded path
12078 {
12079 OptThreadData &td = thread_data[0];
12080 td.v_pos.reserve(total_lines * 2);
12081 td.faces.reserve(total_lines / 3);
12082 td.seq.reserve(total_lines / 3);
12083 OptFloatCache *tc = nullptr;
12084#ifndef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
12085 OptFloatCache thread_cache(config.float_cache_max_nodes,
12086 config.fp32_cache);
12087 if (config.float_cache) tc = &thread_cache;
12088#endif
12089 for (size_t i = 0; i < total_lines; i++) {
12090 opt_parseLineToThreadData(td, &work_buf[all_line_infos[i].pos],
12091 all_line_infos[i].len, config.triangulate,
12092 i + 1, tc);
12093 if (td.error_line != 0) break;
12094 }
12095 }
12096#endif
12097
12098 size_t first_error_line = 0;
12099 std::string first_error_message;
12100 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12101 if (thread_data[t].error_line == 0) continue;
12102 if (first_error_line == 0 || thread_data[t].error_line < first_error_line) {
12103 first_error_line = thread_data[t].error_line;
12104 first_error_message = thread_data[t].error_message;
12105 }
12106 }
12107
12108 // ---- Phase 3: process sequential material state ----
12109 // Compute v/vn/vt prefix sums across threads
12110 std::vector<size_t> v_prefix(num_t), vn_prefix(num_t), vt_prefix(num_t);
12111 v_prefix[0] = vn_prefix[0] = vt_prefix[0] = 0;
12112 for (size_t t = 1; t < num_t; t++) {
12113 v_prefix[t] = v_prefix[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_v;
12114 vn_prefix[t] = vn_prefix[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vn;
12115 vt_prefix[t] = vt_prefix[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vt;
12116 }
12117
12118 std::map<std::string, int> material_map;
12119 std::vector<int> initial_material_id(num_t, -1);
12120 size_t eof_pending_degenerate_faces = 0;
12121 size_t phase3_error_line = 0;
12122 std::string phase3_error_message;
12123 {
12124 MaterialFileReader mat_file_reader(mtl_basedir);
12125 std::set<std::string> material_filenames;
12126 std::vector<material_t> temp_materials;
12127 std::vector<material_t> *material_dst = materials ? materials : &temp_materials;
12128 int running_material_id = -1;
12129 size_t pending_degenerate_faces = 0;
12130 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12131 if (phase3_error_line != 0) {
12132 break;
12133 }
12134
12135 initial_material_id[t] = running_material_id;
12136 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
12137
12138 for (size_t si = 0; si < td.seq.size(); si++) {
12139 const OptSeqEntry &entry = td.seq[si];
12140
12141 if (entry.kind == OptSeqEntry::SEQ_FACE) {
12142 const OptFaceCmd &face = td.faces[entry.index];
12143
12144 // Compute running counts from prefix sums + per-face stored counts
12145 int rv = static_cast<int>(v_prefix[t] + face.v_count_before);
12146 int rvn = static_cast<int>(vn_prefix[t] + face.vn_count_before);
12147 int rvt = static_cast<int>(vt_prefix[t] + face.vt_count_before);
12148
12149 if (first_error_line != 0 && face.source_line >= first_error_line) {
12150 continue;
12151 }
12152
12153 if (face.degenerate) {
12154 pending_degenerate_faces++;
12155 continue;
12156 }
12157
12158 for (size_t k = 0; k < face.face_vertex_count; k++) {
12159 const opt_index_t &raw = face.face_indices()[k];
12160 int resolved_idx = -1;
12161
12162 if (!opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
12163 raw.vertex_index, rv, false, source_name,
12164 face.source_line, warn, &resolved_idx)) {
12165 phase3_error_line = face.source_line;
12166 phase3_error_message =
12167 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
12168 break;
12169 }
12170
12171 if (raw.texcoord_index != opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
12172 if (!opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
12173 raw.texcoord_index, rvt, true, source_name,
12174 face.source_line, warn, &resolved_idx)) {
12175 phase3_error_line = face.source_line;
12176 phase3_error_message =
12177 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
12178 break;
12179 }
12180 }
12181
12182 if (raw.normal_index != opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
12183 if (!opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
12184 raw.normal_index, rvn, true, source_name,
12185 face.source_line, warn, &resolved_idx)) {
12186 phase3_error_line = face.source_line;
12187 phase3_error_message =
12188 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
12189 break;
12190 }
12191 }
12192 }
12193
12194 if (phase3_error_line != 0) {
12195 break;
12196 }
12197
12198 continue;
12199 }
12200
12201 // SEQ_META
12202 OptMetaCmd &meta = thread_data[t].metas[entry.index];
12203
12204 if (first_error_line != 0 && meta.source_line >= first_error_line) {
12205 continue;
12206 }
12207
12208 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_G || meta.type == OPT_CMD_O) {
12209 for (size_t deg = 0; deg < pending_degenerate_faces; deg++) {
12210 if (warn) {
12211 (*warn) += "Degenerated face found\n.";
12212 }
12213 }
12214 pending_degenerate_faces = 0;
12215 }
12216
12217 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_G && meta.group_name_empty) {
12218 if (warn) {
12219 std::stringstream ss;
12220 ss << "Empty group name. line: " << meta.source_line << "\n";
12221 (*warn) += ss.str();
12222 }
12223 continue;
12224 }
12225
12226 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_MTLLIB) {
12227 if (!enable_mtllib_loading) {
12228 continue;
12229 }
12230
12231 std::string line_rest;
12232 if (meta.str_ptr && meta.str_len > 0) {
12233 line_rest.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
12234 }
12235
12236 std::vector<std::string> filenames;
12237 SplitString(line_rest, ' ', '\\', filenames);
12238 RemoveEmptyTokens(&filenames);
12239
12240 if (filenames.empty()) {
12241 if (warn) {
12242 std::stringstream ss;
12243 ss << "Looks like empty filename for mtllib. Use default "
12244 "material (line "
12245 << meta.source_line << ".)\n";
12246 (*warn) += ss.str();
12247 }
12248 continue;
12249 }
12250
12251 bool found = false;
12252 for (size_t s = 0; s < filenames.size(); s++) {
12253 if (material_filenames.count(filenames[s]) > 0) {
12254 found = true;
12255 continue;
12256 }
12257
12258 std::string warn_mtl;
12259 std::string err_mtl;
12260 bool ok = mat_file_reader(filenames[s], material_dst, &material_map,
12261 &warn_mtl, &err_mtl);
12262
12263 if (warn && !warn_mtl.empty()) {
12264 (*warn) += warn_mtl;
12265 }
12266
12267 if (err && !err_mtl.empty()) {
12268 (*err) += err_mtl;
12269 }
12270
12271 if (ok) {
12272 found = true;
12273 material_filenames.insert(filenames[s]);
12274 break;
12275 }
12276 }
12277
12278 if (!found) {
12279 if (warn) {
12280 (*warn) +=
12281 "Failed to load material file(s). Use default material.\n";
12282 }
12283 }
12284 continue;
12285 }
12286
12287 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_USEMTL) {
12288 std::string mat_name;
12289 if (meta.str_ptr && meta.str_len > 0) {
12290 mat_name.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
12291 }
12292 while (!mat_name.empty() &&
12293 (mat_name.back() == '\r' || mat_name.back() == '\n')) {
12294 mat_name.pop_back();
12295 }
12296
12297 std::map<std::string, int>::const_iterator it = material_map.find(mat_name);
12298 if (it != material_map.end()) {
12299 meta.resolved_material_id = it->second;
12300 } else {
12301 meta.resolved_material_id = -1;
12302 if (warn) {
12303 (*warn) += "material [ '" + mat_name + "' ] not found in .mtl\n";
12304 }
12305 }
12306 running_material_id = meta.resolved_material_id;
12307 continue;
12308 }
12309 }
12310
12311 }
12312
12313 if (first_error_line == 0) {
12314 eof_pending_degenerate_faces = pending_degenerate_faces;
12315 }
12316 }
12317
12318 if (phase3_error_line != 0) {
12319 if (err) {
12320 std::stringstream ss;
12321 ss << "Failed parse line(line " << phase3_error_line << "). "
12322 << phase3_error_message << "\n";
12323 if (!err->empty()) {
12324 (*err) += ss.str();
12325 } else {
12326 (*err) = ss.str();
12327 }
12328 }
12329 return false;
12330 }
12331
12332 if (first_error_line != 0) {
12333 if (err) {
12334 std::stringstream ss;
12335 ss << "Failed parse line(line " << first_error_line << "). "
12336 << first_error_message << "\n";
12337 if (!err->empty()) {
12338 (*err) += ss.str();
12339 } else {
12340 (*err) = ss.str();
12341 }
12342 }
12343 return false;
12344 }
12345
12346 // ---- Phase 4: merge results ----
12347 size_t num_v = 0, num_vn = 0, num_vt = 0;
12348 size_t total_idx = 0; // total index_t entries across all faces
12349 size_t total_faces = 0; // total emitted faces
12350 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12351 num_v += thread_data[t].num_v;
12352 num_vn += thread_data[t].num_vn;
12353 num_vt += thread_data[t].num_vt;
12354 total_idx += thread_data[t].num_f_indices;
12355 total_faces += thread_data[t].num_f_faces;
12356 }
12357
12358 // Guard against size_t overflow in vertex/normal/texcoord allocation
12359 if (num_v > SIZE_MAX / 3 || num_vn > SIZE_MAX / 3 || num_vt > SIZE_MAX / 2) {
12360 if (err) {
12361 (*err) += "Integer overflow in vertex/normal/texcoord count.\n";
12362 }
12363 return false;
12364 }
12365
12366 attrib->vertices.resize(num_v * 3);
12367 attrib->vertex_weights.resize(num_v, real_t(1.0));
12368 attrib->normals.resize(num_vn * 3);
12369 attrib->texcoords.resize(num_vt * 2);
12370 attrib->texcoord_ws.resize(num_vt, real_t(0.0));
12371 std::vector<unsigned int> all_smoothing_group_ids(
12372 static_cast<size_t>(total_faces), 0);
12373 attrib->indices.resize(total_idx);
12374 attrib->face_num_verts.resize(static_cast<size_t>(total_faces));
12375 attrib->material_ids.resize(static_cast<size_t>(total_faces), -1);
12376 std::vector<unsigned char> thread_saw_any_vertex_color(num_t, 0);
12377 std::vector<unsigned char> thread_missing_vertex_color(num_t, 0);
12378 std::vector<real_t> all_colors(num_v * 3, real_t(1.0));
12379
12380 // Compute per-thread offsets
12381 std::vector<size_t> v_off(num_t), n_off(num_t), t_off(num_t), f_off(num_t),
12382 face_off(num_t);
12383 v_off[0] = n_off[0] = t_off[0] = f_off[0] = face_off[0] = 0;
12384 for (size_t t = 1; t < num_t; t++) {
12385 v_off[t] = v_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_v;
12386 n_off[t] = n_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vn;
12387 t_off[t] = t_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vt;
12388 f_off[t] = f_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_f_indices;
12389 face_off[t] = face_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_f_faces;
12390 }
12391
12392 // Carry parser state that persists across lines, such as smoothing groups,
12393 // across thread chunk boundaries before merging in parallel.
12394 std::vector<unsigned int> initial_smoothing_group_id(num_t, 0);
12395 unsigned int running_smoothing_group_id = 0;
12396 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12397 initial_smoothing_group_id[t] = running_smoothing_group_id;
12398 for (size_t mi = 0; mi < thread_data[t].metas.size(); mi++) {
12399 if (thread_data[t].metas[mi].type == OPT_CMD_S) {
12400 running_smoothing_group_id = thread_data[t].metas[mi].smoothing_group_id;
12401 }
12402 }
12403 }
12404
12405 // Merge parsed data into final arrays
12406 std::vector<std::vector<unsigned int> > command_written_faces(num_t);
12407 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12408 command_written_faces[t].assign(thread_data[t].faces.size(), 0);
12409 }
12410 std::vector<size_t> written_index_counts(num_t, 0);
12411 std::vector<size_t> written_face_counts(num_t, 0);
12412 std::vector<size_t> merge_error_lines(num_t, 0);
12413 std::vector<std::string> merge_error_messages(num_t);
12414 std::vector<int> thread_greatest_v_idx(num_t, -1);
12415 std::vector<int> thread_greatest_vn_idx(num_t, -1);
12416 std::vector<int> thread_greatest_vt_idx(num_t, -1);
12417 auto merge_vertex_thread = [&](size_t t) {
12418 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
12419 // Bulk copy positions
12420 if (!td.v_pos.empty()) {
12421 std::memcpy(&attrib->vertices[v_off[t] * 3], td.v_pos.data(),
12422 td.v_pos.size() * sizeof(real_t));
12423 }
12424 // Copy weights
12425 if (td.saw_any_weight) {
12426 for (size_t i = 0; i < td.num_v; i++)
12427 attrib->vertex_weights[v_off[t] + i] = td.v_weight[i];
12428 }
12429 // Copy colors
12430 if (td.saw_any_color) {
12431 std::memcpy(&all_colors[v_off[t] * 3], td.v_color.data(),
12432 td.v_color.size() * sizeof(real_t));
12433 thread_saw_any_vertex_color[t] = 1;
12434 if (td.saw_missing_color) thread_missing_vertex_color[t] = 1;
12435 } else if (td.saw_missing_color) {
12436 thread_missing_vertex_color[t] = 1;
12437 }
12438 // Bulk copy normals
12439 if (!td.vn_data.empty()) {
12440 std::memcpy(&attrib->normals[n_off[t] * 3], td.vn_data.data(),
12441 td.vn_data.size() * sizeof(real_t));
12442 }
12443 // Bulk copy texcoords
12444 if (!td.vt_data.empty()) {
12445 std::memcpy(&attrib->texcoords[t_off[t] * 2], td.vt_data.data(),
12446 td.vt_data.size() * sizeof(real_t));
12447 }
12448 if (td.saw_any_texcoord_w) {
12449 for (size_t i = 0; i < td.num_vt; i++)
12450 attrib->texcoord_ws[t_off[t] + i] = td.vt_w[i];
12451 }
12452 };
12453 auto merge_thread = [&](size_t t) {
12454 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
12455 size_t fc = f_off[t], fcc = face_off[t];
12456 int current_mat_id = initial_material_id[t];
12457 unsigned int current_smoothing_id = initial_smoothing_group_id[t];
12458 int greatest_v_idx = -1;
12459 int greatest_vn_idx = -1;
12460 int greatest_vt_idx = -1;
12461
12462 for (size_t si = 0; si < td.seq.size(); si++) {
12463 const OptSeqEntry &entry = td.seq[si];
12464 if (entry.kind == OptSeqEntry::SEQ_META) {
12465 const OptMetaCmd &meta = td.metas[entry.index];
12466 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_USEMTL)
12467 current_mat_id = meta.resolved_material_id;
12468 else if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_S)
12469 current_smoothing_id = meta.smoothing_group_id;
12470 continue;
12471 }
12472 // SEQ_FACE
12473 const OptFaceCmd &face = td.faces[entry.index];
12474 if (face.degenerate) {
12475 command_written_faces[t][entry.index] = 0;
12476 continue;
12477 }
12478 // Compute running counts for index resolution
12479 size_t vc = v_off[t] + face.v_count_before;
12480 size_t nc = n_off[t] + face.vn_count_before;
12481 size_t tc = t_off[t] + face.vt_count_before;
12482
12483 std::vector<index_t> resolved_face(face.face_vertex_count);
12484 for (size_t k = 0; k < face.face_vertex_count; k++) {
12485 const opt_index_t &vi = face.face_indices()[k];
12486 index_t idx;
12487 if (!opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(vi.vertex_index,
12488 static_cast<int>(vc),
12489 &idx.vertex_index, false)) {
12490 merge_error_lines[t] = face.source_line;
12491 merge_error_messages[t] =
12492 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
12493 return;
12494 }
12495 opt_updateGreatestIndex(idx.vertex_index, &greatest_v_idx);
12496 if (vi.texcoord_index == opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
12497 idx.texcoord_index = -1;
12498 } else {
12499 if (!opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(vi.texcoord_index,
12500 static_cast<int>(tc),
12501 &idx.texcoord_index, true)) {
12502 merge_error_lines[t] = face.source_line;
12503 merge_error_messages[t] =
12504 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
12505 return;
12506 }
12507 if (idx.texcoord_index >= 0) {
12508 opt_updateGreatestIndex(idx.texcoord_index, &greatest_vt_idx);
12509 }
12510 }
12511 if (vi.normal_index == opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
12512 idx.normal_index = -1;
12513 } else {
12514 if (!opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(vi.normal_index,
12515 static_cast<int>(nc),
12516 &idx.normal_index, true)) {
12517 merge_error_lines[t] = face.source_line;
12518 merge_error_messages[t] =
12519 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
12520 return;
12521 }
12522 if (idx.normal_index >= 0) {
12523 opt_updateGreatestIndex(idx.normal_index, &greatest_vn_idx);
12524 }
12525 }
12526 resolved_face[k] = idx;
12527 }
12528 size_t written_index_count = 0;
12529 size_t written_face_count = 0;
12530 if (config.triangulate) {
12531 written_index_count = opt_triangulate_face(
12532 attrib->vertices, resolved_face.data(), resolved_face.size(),
12533 &attrib->indices[fc]);
12534 written_face_count = written_index_count / 3;
12535 } else {
12536 written_index_count = resolved_face.size();
12537 written_face_count = 1;
12538 for (size_t k = 0; k < resolved_face.size(); k++) {
12539 attrib->indices[fc + k] = resolved_face[k];
12540 }
12541 }
12542 for (size_t k = 0; k < written_face_count; k++) {
12543 attrib->face_num_verts[fcc + k] = config.triangulate
12544 ? 3
12545 : static_cast<int>(face.emitted_face_verts);
12546 attrib->material_ids[fcc + k] = current_mat_id;
12547 all_smoothing_group_ids[fcc + k] = current_smoothing_id;
12548 }
12549 command_written_faces[t][entry.index] =
12550 static_cast<unsigned int>(written_face_count);
12551 fc += written_index_count;
12552 fcc += written_face_count;
12553 }
12554 written_index_counts[t] = fc - f_off[t];
12555 written_face_counts[t] = fcc - face_off[t];
12556 thread_greatest_v_idx[t] = greatest_v_idx;
12557 thread_greatest_vn_idx[t] = greatest_vn_idx;
12558 thread_greatest_vt_idx[t] = greatest_vt_idx;
12559 };
12560
12561#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MULTITHREADING
12562 if (num_threads > 1) {
12563 std::vector<std::thread> workers;
12564 workers.reserve(num_t);
12565 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12566 workers.emplace_back([&, t]() { merge_vertex_thread(t); });
12567 }
12568 for (auto &w : workers) w.join();
12569 workers.clear();
12570 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12571 workers.emplace_back([&, t]() { merge_thread(t); });
12572 }
12573 for (auto &w : workers) w.join();
12574 } else {
12575 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_vertex_thread(t);
12576 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_thread(t);
12577 }
12578#else
12579 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_vertex_thread(t);
12580 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_thread(t);
12581#endif
12582
12583 size_t first_merge_error_line = 0;
12584 std::string first_merge_error_message;
12585 for (size_t t = 0; t < merge_error_lines.size(); t++) {
12586 if (merge_error_lines[t] == 0) continue;
12587 if (first_merge_error_line == 0 ||
12588 merge_error_lines[t] < first_merge_error_line) {
12589 first_merge_error_line = merge_error_lines[t];
12590 first_merge_error_message = merge_error_messages[t];
12591 }
12592 }
12593
12594 if (first_merge_error_line != 0) {
12595 attrib->vertices.clear();
12596 attrib->vertex_weights.clear();
12597 attrib->normals.clear();
12598 attrib->texcoords.clear();
12599 attrib->texcoord_ws.clear();
12600 attrib->colors.clear();
12601 attrib->skin_weights.clear();
12602 attrib->indices.clear();
12603 attrib->face_num_verts.clear();
12604 attrib->material_ids.clear();
12605 shapes->clear();
12606 if (materials) materials->clear();
12607
12608 if (err) {
12609 std::stringstream ss;
12610 ss << "Failed parse line(line " << first_merge_error_line << "). "
12611 << first_merge_error_message << "\n";
12612 if (!err->empty()) {
12613 (*err) += ss.str();
12614 } else {
12615 (*err) = ss.str();
12616 }
12617 }
12618 return false;
12619 }
12620
12621 bool saw_any_vertex_color = false;
12622 bool saw_missing_vertex_color = false;
12623 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12624 saw_any_vertex_color =
12625 saw_any_vertex_color || (thread_saw_any_vertex_color[t] != 0);
12626 saw_missing_vertex_color =
12627 saw_missing_vertex_color || (thread_missing_vertex_color[t] != 0);
12628 }
12629
12630 if (saw_any_vertex_color && !saw_missing_vertex_color) {
12631 attrib->colors.swap(all_colors);
12632 } else {
12633 attrib->colors.clear();
12634 }
12635
12636 size_t actual_num_indices = 0;
12637 size_t actual_num_faces = 0;
12638 int greatest_v_idx = -1;
12639 int greatest_vn_idx = -1;
12640 int greatest_vt_idx = -1;
12641 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12642 actual_num_indices += written_index_counts[t];
12643 actual_num_faces += written_face_counts[t];
12644 opt_updateGreatestIndex(thread_greatest_v_idx[t], &greatest_v_idx);
12645 opt_updateGreatestIndex(thread_greatest_vn_idx[t], &greatest_vn_idx);
12646 opt_updateGreatestIndex(thread_greatest_vt_idx[t], &greatest_vt_idx);
12647 }
12648
12649 // Compact face arrays to remove gaps left by threads that wrote fewer
12650 // indices/faces than pre-allocated (e.g. triangulation returning 0 for
12651 // faces with out-of-bounds vertex indices).
12652 if (num_t > 1) {
12653 size_t dst_idx = 0;
12654 size_t dst_face = 0;
12655 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12656 size_t src_idx = f_off[t];
12657 size_t src_face = face_off[t];
12658 size_t idx_count = written_index_counts[t];
12659 size_t fc_count = written_face_counts[t];
12660 if (dst_idx != src_idx && idx_count > 0) {
12661 std::memmove(&attrib->indices[dst_idx], &attrib->indices[src_idx],
12662 idx_count * sizeof(index_t));
12663 }
12664 if (dst_face != src_face && fc_count > 0) {
12665 std::memmove(&attrib->face_num_verts[dst_face],
12666 &attrib->face_num_verts[src_face],
12667 fc_count * sizeof(int));
12668 std::memmove(&attrib->material_ids[dst_face],
12669 &attrib->material_ids[src_face],
12670 fc_count * sizeof(int));
12671 std::memmove(&all_smoothing_group_ids[dst_face],
12672 &all_smoothing_group_ids[src_face],
12673 fc_count * sizeof(unsigned int));
12674 }
12675 dst_idx += idx_count;
12676 dst_face += fc_count;
12677 }
12678 }
12679
12680 attrib->indices.resize(actual_num_indices);
12681 attrib->face_num_verts.resize(actual_num_faces);
12682 attrib->material_ids.resize(actual_num_faces);
12683 all_smoothing_group_ids.resize(actual_num_faces);
12684
12685 opt_appendOutOfBoundsWarnings(
12686 warn, greatest_v_idx, greatest_vn_idx, greatest_vt_idx,
12687 static_cast<int>(attrib->vertices.size() / 3),
12688 static_cast<int>(attrib->normals.size() / 3),
12689 static_cast<int>(attrib->texcoords.size() / 2),
12690 all_line_infos.size() + 1);
12691 for (size_t deg = 0; deg < eof_pending_degenerate_faces; deg++) {
12692 if (warn) {
12693 (*warn) += "Degenerated face found\n.";
12694 }
12695 }
12696
12697 // ---- Phase 5: construct shapes ----
12698 {
12699 // Precompute prefix-sum of index offsets for O(1) slicing
12700 const size_t total_faces = attrib->face_num_verts.size();
12701 std::vector<size_t> idx_prefix(total_faces + 1);
12702 idx_prefix[0] = 0;
12703 for (size_t fi = 0; fi < total_faces; fi++) {
12704 idx_prefix[fi + 1] =
12705 idx_prefix[fi] + static_cast<size_t>(attrib->face_num_verts[fi]);
12706 }
12707
12708 size_t face_count = 0;
12709 basic_shape_t<> shape;
12710 size_t face_prev_offset = 0;
12711 bool shape_has_face_record = false;
12712 bool have_active_shape_name = false;
12713
12714 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
12715 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
12716 for (size_t si = 0; si < td.seq.size(); si++) {
12717 const OptSeqEntry &entry = td.seq[si];
12718 if (entry.kind == OptSeqEntry::SEQ_META) {
12719 const OptMetaCmd &meta = td.metas[entry.index];
12720 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_O || meta.type == OPT_CMD_G) {
12721 std::string name;
12722 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_O && meta.str_ptr) {
12723 name.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
12724 } else if (!meta.str_storage.empty()) {
12725 name = meta.str_storage;
12726 } else if (meta.str_ptr) {
12727 name.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
12728 }
12729 while (!name.empty() &&
12730 (name.back() == '\r' || name.back() == '\n'))
12731 name.pop_back();
12732
12733 if (face_count == 0) {
12734 shape.name = name;
12735 face_prev_offset = 0;
12736 have_active_shape_name = true;
12737 } else {
12738 if (!have_active_shape_name) {
12739 // faces before first group/object
12740 basic_shape_t<> prev_shape;
12741 prev_shape.mesh.num_face_vertices.assign(
12742 attrib->face_num_verts.begin(),
12743 attrib->face_num_verts.begin() +
12744 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12745 prev_shape.mesh.indices.assign(
12746 attrib->indices.begin(),
12747 attrib->indices.begin() +
12748 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(idx_prefix[face_count]));
12749 prev_shape.mesh.material_ids.assign(
12750 attrib->material_ids.begin(),
12751 attrib->material_ids.begin() +
12752 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12753 prev_shape.mesh.smoothing_group_ids.assign(
12754 all_smoothing_group_ids.begin(),
12755 all_smoothing_group_ids.begin() +
12756 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
