12757 shapes->push_back(std::move(prev_shape));
12758 } else if (face_count > face_prev_offset) {
12759 // push previous shape
12760 basic_shape_t<> prev_shape;
12761 prev_shape.name = shape.name;
12762 prev_shape.mesh.num_face_vertices.assign(
12763 attrib->face_num_verts.begin() +
12764 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_prev_offset),
12765 attrib->face_num_verts.begin() +
12766 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12767 prev_shape.mesh.indices.assign(
12768 attrib->indices.begin() +
12769 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(idx_prefix[face_prev_offset]),
12770 attrib->indices.begin() +
12771 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(idx_prefix[face_count]));
12772 prev_shape.mesh.material_ids.assign(
12773 attrib->material_ids.begin() +
12774 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_prev_offset),
12775 attrib->material_ids.begin() +
12776 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12777 prev_shape.mesh.smoothing_group_ids.assign(
12778 all_smoothing_group_ids.begin() +
12779 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_prev_offset),
12780 all_smoothing_group_ids.begin() +
12781 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12782 shapes->push_back(std::move(prev_shape));
12783 }
12784 shape.name = name;
12785 face_prev_offset = face_count;
12786 have_active_shape_name = true;
12787 }
12788 shape_has_face_record = false;
12789 }
12790 } else {
12791 // SEQ_FACE
12792 shape_has_face_record = true;
12793 face_count += command_written_faces[t][entry.index];
12794 }
12795 }
12796 }
12797
12798 // Final shape
12799 if (face_count > face_prev_offset || shape_has_face_record) {
12800 basic_shape_t<> final_shape;
12801 final_shape.name = shape.name;
12802 final_shape.mesh.num_face_vertices.assign(
12803 attrib->face_num_verts.begin() +
12804 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_prev_offset),
12805 attrib->face_num_verts.begin() +
12806 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12807 final_shape.mesh.indices.assign(
12808 attrib->indices.begin() +
12809 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(idx_prefix[face_prev_offset]),
12810 attrib->indices.begin() +
12811 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(idx_prefix[face_count]));
12812 final_shape.mesh.material_ids.assign(
12813 attrib->material_ids.begin() +
12814 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_prev_offset),
12815 attrib->material_ids.begin() +
12816 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12817 final_shape.mesh.smoothing_group_ids.assign(
12818 all_smoothing_group_ids.begin() +
12819 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_prev_offset),
12820 all_smoothing_group_ids.begin() +
12821 static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(face_count));
12822 shapes->push_back(std::move(final_shape));
12823 }
12824 }
12825
12826 return true;
12827}
12828
12829// ---- LoadObjOpt (buffer version, public API) ----
12830
12831bool LoadObjOpt(basic_attrib_t<> *attrib,
12832 std::vector<basic_shape_t<>> *shapes,
12833 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
12834 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
12835 const char *buf, size_t buf_len,
12836 const OptLoadConfig &config) {
12837 return LoadObjOpt_internal(attrib, shapes, materials, warn, err,
12838 buf, buf_len, std::string(), "<stream>", false,
12839 config);
12840}
12841
12842// ---- LoadObjOpt (file version) ----
12843
12844bool LoadObjOpt(basic_attrib_t<> *attrib,
12845 std::vector<basic_shape_t<>> *shapes,
12846 std::vector<material_t> *materials,
12847 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
12848 const char *filename,
12849 const char *mtl_basedir,
12850 const OptLoadConfig &config) {
12851 if (!filename) {
12852 if (err) *err = "filename is null.";
12853 return false;
12854 }
12855
12856 std::string filepath(filename);
12857
12858 // Resolve material base directory
12859 std::string baseDir;
12860 if (mtl_basedir) {
12861 baseDir = mtl_basedir;
12862 } else {
12863 // Extract directory from filename
12864 size_t pos = filepath.find_last_of("/\\");
12865 if (pos != std::string::npos) {
12866 baseDir = filepath.substr(0, pos + 1);
12867 }
12868 }
12869 if (!baseDir.empty()) {
12870#ifndef _WIN32
12871 const char dirsep = '/';
12872#else
12873 const char dirsep = '\\';
12874#endif
12875 if (baseDir[baseDir.length() - 1] != dirsep) baseDir += dirsep;
12876 }
12877
12878#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
12879 {
12880 MappedFile mf;
12881 if (mf.open(filepath.c_str())) {
12882 return LoadObjOpt_internal(attrib, shapes, materials, warn, err,
12883 mf.data, mf.size, baseDir, filepath, true,
12884 config);
12885 }
12886 }
12887#endif
12888
12889#ifdef _WIN32
12890 std::ifstream ifs(LongPathW(UTF8ToWchar(filepath)).c_str(),
12891 std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
12892#else
12893 std::ifstream ifs(filepath.c_str(), std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
12894#endif
12895 if (!ifs.is_open()) {
12896 if (err) *err = "Cannot open file: " + filepath;
12897 return false;
12898 }
12899
12900 std::streamsize fsize = ifs.tellg();
12901 ifs.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);
12902
12903 if (fsize <= 0) {
12904 return LoadObjOpt_internal(attrib, shapes, materials, warn, err,
12905 "", static_cast<size_t>(0), baseDir, filepath,
12906 true, config);
12907 }
12908
12909 std::vector<char> buf(static_cast<size_t>(fsize));
12910 if (!ifs.read(buf.data(), fsize)) {
12911 if (err) *err = "Failed to read file: " + filepath;
12912 return false;
12913 }
12914 ifs.close();
12915
12916 // Parse the in-memory file buffer with baseDir for mtllib resolution.
12917 return LoadObjOpt_internal(attrib, shapes, materials, warn, err,
12918 buf.data(), static_cast<size_t>(fsize), baseDir,
12919 filepath, true, config);
12920}
12921
12922// ---- LoadObjOptTyped internals ----
12923
12924static bool LoadObjOptTyped_internal(OptResult *result,
12925 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
12926 const char *buf, size_t buf_len,
12927 const std::string &mtl_basedir,
12928 const std::string &source_name,
12929 bool enable_mtllib_loading,
12930 const OptLoadConfig &config) {
12931 using namespace opt_internal;
12932
12933 ArenaAllocator &arena = result->arena;
12934 OptAttrib &attrib = result->attrib;
12935 result->valid = false;
12936
12937 if (buf_len < 1) {
12938 result->valid = true;
12939 return true;
12940 }
12941 if (!buf) {
12942 if (err) *err = "buf must not be null when buf_len > 0.";
12943 return false;
12944 }
12945
12946 const char *work_buf = buf;
12947 size_t work_len = buf_len;
12948 std::vector<char> buf_with_sentinel;
12949 if (buf[buf_len - 1] != '\n') {
12950 buf_with_sentinel.assign(buf, buf + buf_len);
12951 buf_with_sentinel.push_back('\n');
12952 work_buf = buf_with_sentinel.data();
12953 work_len = buf_with_sentinel.size();
12954 }
12955
12956 int num_threads = 1;
12957#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MULTITHREADING
12958 if (config.num_threads < 0) {
12959 num_threads = static_cast<int>(std::thread::hardware_concurrency());
12960 if (num_threads < 1) num_threads = 1;
12961 } else if (config.num_threads > 1) {
12962 num_threads = config.num_threads;
12963 }
12964 if (num_threads > kOptMaxThreads) num_threads = kOptMaxThreads;
12965#else
12966#endif
12967
12968 // ---- Phase 1: find line boundaries ----
12969 std::vector<LineInfo> all_line_infos;
12970
12971#if defined(TINYOBJLOADER_USE_SIMD) && \
12972 (defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_SSE2) || defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_AVX2) || \
12973 defined(TINYOBJLOADER_SIMD_NEON))
12974 {
12975 std::vector<size_t> nl_positions;
12976 nl_positions.reserve(work_len / 64);
12977 simd_find_newlines(work_buf, work_len, nl_positions);
12978 simd_build_line_infos(work_buf, work_len, nl_positions, all_line_infos);
12979 }
12980#else
12981 {
12982 all_line_infos.reserve(work_len / 64);
12983 scalar_find_line_infos(work_buf, 0, work_len, all_line_infos);
12984 }
12985#endif
12986
12987 const size_t total_lines = all_line_infos.size();
12988 if (total_lines == 0) {
12989 result->valid = true;
12990 return true;
12991 }
12992
12993 // Fast buffer-level check for legacy-only tokens (replaces per-line scan)
12994 if (opt_buffer_requires_legacy_fallback(work_buf, work_len)) {
12995 basic_attrib_t<> tmp_attrib;
12996 std::vector<basic_shape_t<>> tmp_shapes;
12997 std::vector<material_t> tmp_materials;
12998 std::string input(buf, buf + buf_len);
12999 std::istringstream iss(input);
13000 attrib_t legacy_attrib;
13001 std::vector<shape_t> legacy_shapes;
13002 std::vector<material_t> legacy_materials;
13003 MaterialFileReader mat_reader(mtl_basedir);
13004 MaterialReader *reader =
13005 enable_mtllib_loading ? static_cast<MaterialReader *>(&mat_reader) : NULL;
13006 const bool ok = LoadObj(&legacy_attrib, &legacy_shapes, &legacy_materials,
13007 warn, err, &iss, reader, config.triangulate, false);
13008 if (!ok) return false;
13009 ConvertLegacyResultToBasic(legacy_attrib, legacy_shapes, legacy_materials,
13010 &tmp_attrib, &tmp_shapes, &tmp_materials);
13011#define TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(dst, src) \
13012 do { \
13013 if (!(src).empty()) { \
13014 (dst).allocate(arena, (src).size()); \
13015 std::memcpy((dst).data(), (src).data(), \
13016 (src).size() * sizeof((src)[0])); \
13017 } \
13018 } while (0)
13019 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.vertices, tmp_attrib.vertices);
13020 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.vertex_weights, tmp_attrib.vertex_weights);
13021 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.normals, tmp_attrib.normals);
13022 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.texcoords, tmp_attrib.texcoords);
13023 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.texcoord_ws, tmp_attrib.texcoord_ws);
13024 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.colors, tmp_attrib.colors);
13025 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.indices, tmp_attrib.indices);
13026 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.face_num_verts, tmp_attrib.face_num_verts);
13027 TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_(attrib.material_ids, tmp_attrib.material_ids);
13028#undef TINYOBJ_COPY_VEC_TO_ARENA_
13029 // Flatten per-shape smoothing_group_ids into attrib
13030 {
13031 size_t total_sg = 0;
13032 for (size_t si = 0; si < tmp_shapes.size(); si++)
13033 total_sg += tmp_shapes[si].mesh.smoothing_group_ids.size();
13034 if (total_sg > 0) {
13035 attrib.smoothing_group_ids.allocate(arena, total_sg);
13036 size_t off = 0;
13037 for (size_t si = 0; si < tmp_shapes.size(); si++) {
13038 const auto &sg = tmp_shapes[si].mesh.smoothing_group_ids;
13039 if (!sg.empty()) {
13040 std::memcpy(&attrib.smoothing_group_ids[off], sg.data(),
13041 sg.size() * sizeof(sg[0]));
13042 off += sg.size();
13043 }
13044 }
13045 }
13046 }
13047 result->shapes.clear();
13048 size_t idx_off = 0, face_off = 0;
13049 for (size_t si = 0; si < tmp_shapes.size(); si++) {
13050 OptShapeRange sr;
13051 sr.name = tmp_shapes[si].name;
13052 sr.face_offset = face_off;
13053 sr.face_count = tmp_shapes[si].mesh.num_face_vertices.size();
13054 sr.index_offset = idx_off;
13055 sr.index_count = tmp_shapes[si].mesh.indices.size();
13056 face_off += sr.face_count;
13057 idx_off += sr.index_count;
13058 result->shapes.push_back(std::move(sr));
13059 }
13060 result->materials = tmp_materials;
13061 result->valid = true;
13062 return true;
13063 }
13064
13065 // ---- Phase 2: parse lines (compact storage) ----
13066 const size_t num_t = static_cast<size_t>(num_threads);
13067 std::vector<OptThreadData> thread_data(num_t);
13068
13069#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MULTITHREADING
13070 {
13071 size_t lines_per_thread = total_lines / num_t;
13072 std::vector<std::thread> workers;
13073 workers.reserve(num_t);
13074
13075 for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; t++) {
13076 size_t start = static_cast<size_t>(t) * lines_per_thread;
13077 size_t end = (t == num_threads - 1)
13078 ? total_lines
13079 : (static_cast<size_t>(t) + 1) * lines_per_thread;
13080
13081 workers.emplace_back([&, t, start, end]() {
13082 OptThreadData &td = thread_data[static_cast<size_t>(t)];
13083 size_t est_lines = end - start;
13084 td.v_pos.reserve(est_lines * 2);
13085 td.faces.reserve(est_lines / 3);
13086 td.seq.reserve(est_lines / 3);
13087 OptFloatCache *tc = nullptr;
13088#ifndef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
13089 OptFloatCache thread_cache(config.float_cache_max_nodes,
13090 config.fp32_cache);
13091 if (config.float_cache) tc = &thread_cache;
13092#endif
13093 for (size_t i = start; i < end; i++) {
13094 opt_parseLineToThreadData(td, &work_buf[all_line_infos[i].pos],
13095 all_line_infos[i].len, config.triangulate,
13096 i + 1, tc);
13097 if (td.error_line != 0) break;
13098 }
13099 });
13100 }
13101 for (auto &w : workers) w.join();
13102 }
13103#else
13104 {
13105 OptThreadData &td = thread_data[0];
13106 td.v_pos.reserve(total_lines * 2);
13107 td.faces.reserve(total_lines / 3);
13108 td.seq.reserve(total_lines / 3);
13109 OptFloatCache *tc = nullptr;
13110#ifndef TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT
13111 OptFloatCache thread_cache(config.float_cache_max_nodes,
13112 config.fp32_cache);
13113 if (config.float_cache) tc = &thread_cache;
13114#endif
13115 for (size_t i = 0; i < total_lines; i++) {
13116 opt_parseLineToThreadData(td, &work_buf[all_line_infos[i].pos],
13117 all_line_infos[i].len, config.triangulate,
13118 i + 1, tc);
13119 if (td.error_line != 0) break;
13120 }
13121 }
13122#endif
13123
13124 // Check for parse errors
13125 size_t first_error_line = 0;
13126 std::string first_error_message;
13127 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13128 if (thread_data[t].error_line == 0) continue;
13129 if (first_error_line == 0 || thread_data[t].error_line < first_error_line) {
13130 first_error_line = thread_data[t].error_line;
13131 first_error_message = thread_data[t].error_message;
13132 }
13133 }
13134
13135 // ---- Phase 3: process sequential material state ----
13136 // Compute v/vn/vt prefix sums across threads
13137 std::vector<size_t> v_prefix(num_t), vn_prefix(num_t), vt_prefix(num_t);
13138 v_prefix[0] = vn_prefix[0] = vt_prefix[0] = 0;
13139 for (size_t t = 1; t < num_t; t++) {
13140 v_prefix[t] = v_prefix[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_v;
13141 vn_prefix[t] = vn_prefix[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vn;
13142 vt_prefix[t] = vt_prefix[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vt;
13143 }
13144
13145 std::map<std::string, int> material_map;
13146 std::vector<int> initial_material_id(num_t, -1);
13147 size_t eof_pending_degenerate_faces = 0;
13148 size_t phase3_error_line = 0;
13149 std::string phase3_error_message;
13150 {
13151 MaterialFileReader mat_file_reader(mtl_basedir);
13152 std::set<std::string> material_filenames;
13153 std::vector<material_t> *material_dst = &result->materials;
13154 int running_material_id = -1;
13155 size_t pending_degenerate_faces = 0;
13156
13157 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13158 if (phase3_error_line != 0) break;
13159 initial_material_id[t] = running_material_id;
13160 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
13161
13162 for (size_t si = 0; si < td.seq.size(); si++) {
13163 const OptSeqEntry &entry = td.seq[si];
13164
13165 if (entry.kind == OptSeqEntry::SEQ_FACE) {
13166 const OptFaceCmd &face = td.faces[entry.index];
13167 int rv = static_cast<int>(v_prefix[t] + face.v_count_before);
13168 int rvn = static_cast<int>(vn_prefix[t] + face.vn_count_before);
13169 int rvt = static_cast<int>(vt_prefix[t] + face.vt_count_before);
13170
13171 if (first_error_line != 0 && face.source_line >= first_error_line) continue;
13172
13173 if (face.degenerate) {
13174 pending_degenerate_faces++;
13175 continue;
13176 }
13177
13178 for (size_t k = 0; k < face.face_vertex_count; k++) {
13179 const opt_index_t &raw = face.face_indices()[k];
13180 int resolved_idx = -1;
13181 if (!opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
13182 raw.vertex_index, rv, false, source_name,
13183 face.source_line, warn, &resolved_idx)) {
13184 phase3_error_line = face.source_line;
13185 phase3_error_message = "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
13186 break;
13187 }
13188 if (raw.texcoord_index != opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
13189 if (!opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
13190 raw.texcoord_index, rvt, true, source_name,
13191 face.source_line, warn, &resolved_idx)) {
13192 phase3_error_line = face.source_line;
13193 phase3_error_message = "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
13194 break;
13195 }
13196 }
13197 if (raw.normal_index != opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
13198 if (!opt_validateAndResolveFaceIndexLikeLegacy(
13199 raw.normal_index, rvn, true, source_name,
13200 face.source_line, warn, &resolved_idx)) {
13201 phase3_error_line = face.source_line;
13202 phase3_error_message = "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
13203 break;
13204 }
13205 }
13206 }
13207 if (phase3_error_line != 0) break;
13208 continue;
13209 }
13210
13211 // SEQ_META
13212 OptMetaCmd &meta = thread_data[t].metas[entry.index];
13213
13214 if (first_error_line != 0 && meta.source_line >= first_error_line) continue;
13215
13216 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_G || meta.type == OPT_CMD_O) {
13217 for (size_t deg = 0; deg < pending_degenerate_faces; deg++) {
13218 if (warn) (*warn) += "Degenerated face found\n.";
13219 }
13220 pending_degenerate_faces = 0;
13221 }
13222
13223 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_G && meta.group_name_empty) {
13224 if (warn) {
13225 (*warn) += "Empty group name. line: " +
13226 std::to_string(meta.source_line) + "\n";
13227 }
13228 continue;
13229 }
13230
13231 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_MTLLIB) {
13232 if (!enable_mtllib_loading) continue;
13233 std::string line_rest;
13234 if (meta.str_ptr && meta.str_len > 0) {
13235 line_rest.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
13236 }
13237 std::vector<std::string> filenames;
13238 SplitString(line_rest, ' ', '\\', filenames);
13239 RemoveEmptyTokens(&filenames);
13240 if (filenames.empty()) {
13241 if (warn) {
13242 (*warn) += "Looks like empty filename for mtllib. Use default "
13243 "material (line " +
13244 std::to_string(meta.source_line) + ".)\n";
13245 }
13246 continue;
13247 }
13248 bool found = false;
13249 for (size_t s = 0; s < filenames.size(); s++) {
13250 if (material_filenames.count(filenames[s]) > 0) {
13251 found = true;
13252 continue;
13253 }
13254 std::string warn_mtl, err_mtl;
13255 bool ok = mat_file_reader(filenames[s], material_dst, &material_map,
13256 &warn_mtl, &err_mtl);
13257 if (warn && !warn_mtl.empty()) (*warn) += warn_mtl;
13258 if (err && !err_mtl.empty()) (*err) += err_mtl;
13259 if (ok) {
13260 found = true;
13261 material_filenames.insert(filenames[s]);
13262 break;
13263 }
13264 }
13265 if (!found && warn) {
13266 (*warn) += "Failed to load material file(s). Use default material.\n";
13267 }
13268 continue;
13269 }
13270
13271 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_USEMTL) {
13272 std::string mat_name;
13273 if (meta.str_ptr && meta.str_len > 0) {
13274 mat_name.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
13275 }
13276 while (!mat_name.empty() &&
13277 (mat_name.back() == '\r' || mat_name.back() == '\n')) {
13278 mat_name.pop_back();
13279 }
13280 std::map<std::string, int>::const_iterator it = material_map.find(mat_name);
13281 if (it != material_map.end()) {
13282 meta.resolved_material_id = it->second;
13283 } else {
13284 meta.resolved_material_id = -1;
13285 if (warn) (*warn) += "material [ '" + mat_name + "' ] not found in .mtl\n";
13286 }
13287 running_material_id = meta.resolved_material_id;
13288 continue;
13289 }
13290 }
13291
13292 }
13293 if (first_error_line == 0) {
13294 eof_pending_degenerate_faces = pending_degenerate_faces;
13295 }
13296 }
13297
13298 if (phase3_error_line != 0) {
13299 if (err) {
13300 (*err) += "Failed parse line(line " +
13301 std::to_string(phase3_error_line) + "). " +
13302 phase3_error_message + "\n";
13303 }
13304 return false;
13305 }
13306
13307 if (first_error_line != 0) {
13308 if (err) {
13309 (*err) += "Failed parse line(line " +
13310 std::to_string(first_error_line) + "). " +
13311 first_error_message + "\n";
13312 }
13313 return false;
13314 }
13315
13316 // ---- Phase 4: allocate arena arrays and merge ----
13317 size_t num_v = 0, num_vn = 0, num_vt = 0;
13318 size_t total_idx = 0; // total index_t entries across all faces
13319 size_t total_faces = 0; // total emitted faces
13320 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13321 num_v += thread_data[t].num_v;
13322 num_vn += thread_data[t].num_vn;
13323 num_vt += thread_data[t].num_vt;
13324 total_idx += thread_data[t].num_f_indices;
13325 total_faces += thread_data[t].num_f_faces;
13326 }
13327
13328 // Guard against size_t overflow in vertex/normal/texcoord allocation
13329 if (num_v > SIZE_MAX / 3 || num_vn > SIZE_MAX / 3 || num_vt > SIZE_MAX / 2) {
13330 if (err) {
13331 (*err) += "Integer overflow in vertex/normal/texcoord count.\n";
13332 }
13333 return false;
13334 }
13335
13336 // Determine which optional arrays are needed
13337 bool any_color = false;
13338 bool any_weight = false, any_texcoord_w = false, any_smoothing = false;
13339 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13340 if (thread_data[t].saw_any_color) any_color = true;
13341 if (thread_data[t].saw_any_weight) any_weight = true;
13342 if (thread_data[t].saw_any_texcoord_w) any_texcoord_w = true;
13343 if (thread_data[t].saw_any_smoothing) any_smoothing = true;
13344 }
13345
13346 // Allocate from arena
13347 attrib.vertices.allocate(arena, num_v * 3);
13348 if (any_weight) {
13349 attrib.vertex_weights.allocate(arena, num_v);
13350 for (size_t i = 0; i < num_v; i++)
13351 attrib.vertex_weights[i] = real_t(1.0);
13352 }
13353 attrib.normals.allocate(arena, num_vn * 3);
13354 attrib.texcoords.allocate(arena, num_vt * 2);
13355 if (any_texcoord_w) {
13356 attrib.texcoord_ws.allocate(arena, num_vt);
13357 }
13358 attrib.indices.allocate(arena, total_idx);
13359 attrib.face_num_verts.allocate(arena, total_faces);
13360 attrib.material_ids.allocate(arena, total_faces);
13361 for (size_t i = 0; i < total_faces; i++)
13362 attrib.material_ids[i] = -1;
13363
13364 // Smoothing group ids — only if any smoothing commands seen
13365 TypedArray<unsigned int> all_smoothing_group_ids;
13366 if (any_smoothing) {
13367 all_smoothing_group_ids.allocate(arena, total_faces);
13368 }
13369
13370 // Colors — allocate temp only if any vertex has color
13371 TypedArray<real_t> all_colors;
13372 if (any_color) {
13373 all_colors.allocate(arena, num_v * 3);
13374 for (size_t i = 0; i < num_v * 3; i++)
13375 all_colors[i] = real_t(1.0);
13376 }
13377
13378 // Compute per-thread offsets
13379 std::vector<size_t> v_off(num_t), n_off(num_t), t_off(num_t), f_off(num_t),
13380 face_off(num_t);
13381 v_off[0] = n_off[0] = t_off[0] = f_off[0] = face_off[0] = 0;
13382 for (size_t t = 1; t < num_t; t++) {
13383 v_off[t] = v_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_v;
13384 n_off[t] = n_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vn;
13385 t_off[t] = t_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_vt;
13386 f_off[t] = f_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_f_indices;
13387 face_off[t] = face_off[t - 1] + thread_data[t - 1].num_f_faces;
13388 }
13389
13390 // Carry smoothing group state across thread boundaries
13391 std::vector<unsigned int> initial_smoothing_group_id(num_t, 0);
13392 unsigned int running_smoothing_group_id = 0;
13393 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13394 initial_smoothing_group_id[t] = running_smoothing_group_id;
13395 for (size_t mi = 0; mi < thread_data[t].metas.size(); mi++) {
13396 if (thread_data[t].metas[mi].type == OPT_CMD_S) {
13397 running_smoothing_group_id = thread_data[t].metas[mi].smoothing_group_id;
13398 }
13399 }
13400 }
13401
13402 // Per-thread face tracking for shape construction
13403 std::vector<std::vector<unsigned int>> command_written_faces(num_t);
13404 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13405 command_written_faces[t].assign(thread_data[t].faces.size(), 0);
13406 }
13407 std::vector<size_t> written_index_counts(num_t, 0);
13408 std::vector<size_t> written_face_counts(num_t, 0);
13409 std::vector<size_t> merge_error_lines(num_t, 0);
13410 std::vector<std::string> merge_error_messages(num_t);
13411 std::vector<int> thread_greatest_v_idx(num_t, -1);
13412 std::vector<int> thread_greatest_vn_idx(num_t, -1);
13413 std::vector<int> thread_greatest_vt_idx(num_t, -1);
13414 std::vector<unsigned char> thread_saw_any_vertex_color(num_t, 0);
13415 std::vector<unsigned char> thread_missing_vertex_color(num_t, 0);
13416
13417 auto merge_vertex_thread = [&](size_t t) {
13418 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
13419 // Bulk copy positions
13420 if (!td.v_pos.empty()) {
13421 std::memcpy(&attrib.vertices[v_off[t] * 3], td.v_pos.data(),
13422 td.v_pos.size() * sizeof(real_t));
13423 }
13424 // Copy weights
13425 if (any_weight && td.saw_any_weight) {
13426 for (size_t i = 0; i < td.num_v; i++)
13427 attrib.vertex_weights[v_off[t] + i] = td.v_weight[i];
13428 }
13429 // Copy colors
13430 if (any_color) {
13431 if (td.saw_any_color) {
13432 std::memcpy(&all_colors[v_off[t] * 3], td.v_color.data(),
13433 td.v_color.size() * sizeof(real_t));
13434 thread_saw_any_vertex_color[t] = 1;
13435 if (td.saw_missing_color) thread_missing_vertex_color[t] = 1;
13436 } else if (td.saw_missing_color) {
13437 thread_missing_vertex_color[t] = 1;
13438 }
13439 }
13440 // Bulk copy normals
13441 if (!td.vn_data.empty()) {
13442 std::memcpy(&attrib.normals[n_off[t] * 3], td.vn_data.data(),
13443 td.vn_data.size() * sizeof(real_t));
13444 }
13445 // Bulk copy texcoords
13446 if (!td.vt_data.empty()) {
13447 std::memcpy(&attrib.texcoords[t_off[t] * 2], td.vt_data.data(),
13448 td.vt_data.size() * sizeof(real_t));
13449 }
13450 if (any_texcoord_w && td.saw_any_texcoord_w) {
13451 for (size_t i = 0; i < td.num_vt; i++)
13452 attrib.texcoord_ws[t_off[t] + i] = td.vt_w[i];
13453 }
13454 };
13455
13456 auto merge_thread = [&](size_t t) {
13457 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
13458 size_t fc = f_off[t], fcc = face_off[t];
13459 int current_mat_id = initial_material_id[t];
13460 unsigned int current_smoothing_id = initial_smoothing_group_id[t];
13461 int greatest_v_idx = -1;
13462 int greatest_vn_idx = -1;
13463 int greatest_vt_idx = -1;
13464
13465 // Reusable scratch buffer for resolved face indices
13466 index_t resolved_inline[8];
13467 std::vector<index_t> resolved_heap;
13468
13469 for (size_t si = 0; si < td.seq.size(); si++) {
13470 const OptSeqEntry &entry = td.seq[si];
13471 if (entry.kind == OptSeqEntry::SEQ_META) {
13472 const OptMetaCmd &meta = td.metas[entry.index];
13473 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_USEMTL)
13474 current_mat_id = meta.resolved_material_id;
13475 else if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_S)
13476 current_smoothing_id = meta.smoothing_group_id;
13477 continue;
13478 }
13479 // SEQ_FACE
13480 const OptFaceCmd &face = td.faces[entry.index];
13481 if (face.degenerate) {
13482 command_written_faces[t][entry.index] = 0;
13483 continue;
13484 }
13485 // Compute running counts for index resolution
13486 size_t vc = v_off[t] + face.v_count_before;
13487 size_t nc = n_off[t] + face.vn_count_before;
13488 size_t tc = t_off[t] + face.vt_count_before;
13489
13490 // Use stack buffer for typical faces, heap only for large polygons
13491 index_t *resolved_face;
13492 if (face.face_vertex_count <= 8) {
13493 resolved_face = resolved_inline;
13494 } else {
13495 resolved_heap.resize(face.face_vertex_count);
13496 resolved_face = resolved_heap.data();
13497 }
13498 for (size_t k = 0; k < face.face_vertex_count; k++) {
13499 const opt_index_t &vi = face.face_indices()[k];
13500 index_t idx;
13501 if (!opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(vi.vertex_index,
13502 static_cast<int>(vc),
13503 &idx.vertex_index, false)) {
13504 merge_error_lines[t] = face.source_line;
13505 merge_error_messages[t] =
13506 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
13507 return;
13508 }
13509 opt_updateGreatestIndex(idx.vertex_index, &greatest_v_idx);
13510 if (vi.texcoord_index == opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
13511 idx.texcoord_index = -1;
13512 } else {
13513 if (!opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(vi.texcoord_index,
13514 static_cast<int>(tc),
13515 &idx.texcoord_index, true)) {
13516 merge_error_lines[t] = face.source_line;
13517 merge_error_messages[t] =
13518 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
13519 return;
13520 }
13521 if (idx.texcoord_index >= 0)
13522 opt_updateGreatestIndex(idx.texcoord_index, &greatest_vt_idx);
13523 }
13524 if (vi.normal_index == opt_index_t::kNotPresent) {
13525 idx.normal_index = -1;
13526 } else {
13527 if (!opt_resolveIndexLikeLegacy(vi.normal_index,
13528 static_cast<int>(nc),
13529 &idx.normal_index, true)) {
13530 merge_error_lines[t] = face.source_line;
13531 merge_error_messages[t] =
13532 "failed to parse `f' line (invalid vertex index)";
13533 return;
13534 }
13535 if (idx.normal_index >= 0)
13536 opt_updateGreatestIndex(idx.normal_index, &greatest_vn_idx);
13537 }
13538 resolved_face[k] = idx;
13539 }
13540 size_t written_index_count = 0;
13541 size_t written_face_count = 0;
13542 if (config.triangulate) {
13543 written_index_count = opt_triangulate_face(
13544 attrib.vertices.data(), attrib.vertices.size(),
13545 resolved_face, face.face_vertex_count,
13546 &attrib.indices[fc]);
13547 written_face_count = written_index_count / 3;
13548 } else {
13549 written_index_count = face.face_vertex_count;
13550 written_face_count = 1;
13551 for (size_t k = 0; k < face.face_vertex_count; k++) {
13552 attrib.indices[fc + k] = resolved_face[k];
13553 }
13554 }
13555 for (size_t k = 0; k < written_face_count; k++) {
13556 attrib.face_num_verts[fcc + k] = config.triangulate
13557 ? 3
13558 : static_cast<int>(face.emitted_face_verts);
13559 attrib.material_ids[fcc + k] = current_mat_id;
13560 if (any_smoothing) {
13561 all_smoothing_group_ids[fcc + k] = current_smoothing_id;
13562 }
13563 }
13564 command_written_faces[t][entry.index] =
13565 static_cast<unsigned int>(written_face_count);
13566 fc += written_index_count;
13567 fcc += written_face_count;
13568 }
13569 written_index_counts[t] = fc - f_off[t];
13570 written_face_counts[t] = fcc - face_off[t];
13571 thread_greatest_v_idx[t] = greatest_v_idx;
13572 thread_greatest_vn_idx[t] = greatest_vn_idx;
13573 thread_greatest_vt_idx[t] = greatest_vt_idx;
13574 };
13575
13576#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MULTITHREADING
13577 if (num_threads > 1) {
13578 std::vector<std::thread> workers;
13579 workers.reserve(num_t);
13580 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13581 workers.emplace_back([&, t]() { merge_vertex_thread(t); });
13582 }
13583 for (auto &w : workers) w.join();
13584 workers.clear();
13585 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13586 workers.emplace_back([&, t]() { merge_thread(t); });
13587 }
13588 for (auto &w : workers) w.join();
13589 } else {
13590 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_vertex_thread(t);
13591 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_thread(t);
13592 }
13593#else
13594 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_vertex_thread(t);
13595 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) merge_thread(t);
13596#endif
13597
13598 // Check merge errors
13599 size_t first_merge_error_line = 0;
13600 std::string first_merge_error_message;
13601 for (size_t t = 0; t < merge_error_lines.size(); t++) {
13602 if (merge_error_lines[t] == 0) continue;
13603 if (first_merge_error_line == 0 ||
13604 merge_error_lines[t] < first_merge_error_line) {
13605 first_merge_error_line = merge_error_lines[t];
13606 first_merge_error_message = merge_error_messages[t];
13607 }
13608 }
13609
13610 if (first_merge_error_line != 0) {
13611 if (err) {
13612 (*err) += "Failed parse line(line " +
13613 std::to_string(first_merge_error_line) + "). " +
13614 first_merge_error_message + "\n";
13615 }
13616 return false;
13617 }
13618
13619 // Handle vertex colors: only keep if all vertices have color
13620 {
13621 bool saw_any = false, saw_missing = false;
13622 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13623 saw_any = saw_any || (thread_saw_any_vertex_color[t] != 0);
13624 saw_missing = saw_missing || (thread_missing_vertex_color[t] != 0);
13625 }
13626 if (saw_any && !saw_missing) {
13627 attrib.colors = all_colors; // share arena pointer
13628 }
13629 // else attrib.colors stays empty (default)
13630 }
13631
13632 // Compute actual sizes and compact/truncate
13633 size_t actual_num_indices = 0;
13634 size_t actual_num_faces = 0;
13635 int greatest_v_idx = -1, greatest_vn_idx = -1, greatest_vt_idx = -1;
13636 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13637 actual_num_indices += written_index_counts[t];
13638 actual_num_faces += written_face_counts[t];
13639 opt_updateGreatestIndex(thread_greatest_v_idx[t], &greatest_v_idx);
13640 opt_updateGreatestIndex(thread_greatest_vn_idx[t], &greatest_vn_idx);
13641 opt_updateGreatestIndex(thread_greatest_vt_idx[t], &greatest_vt_idx);
13642 }
13643
13644 // Compact face arrays to remove gaps left by threads that wrote fewer
13645 // indices/faces than pre-allocated (e.g. triangulation returning 0 for
13646 // faces with out-of-bounds vertex indices).
13647 if (num_t > 1) {
13648 size_t dst_idx = 0;
13649 size_t dst_face = 0;
13650 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13651 size_t src_idx = f_off[t];
13652 size_t src_face = face_off[t];
13653 size_t idx_count = written_index_counts[t];
13654 size_t fc_count = written_face_counts[t];
13655 if (dst_idx != src_idx && idx_count > 0) {
13656 std::memmove(&attrib.indices[dst_idx], &attrib.indices[src_idx],
13657 idx_count * sizeof(index_t));
13658 }
13659 if (dst_face != src_face && fc_count > 0) {
13660 std::memmove(&attrib.face_num_verts[dst_face],
13661 &attrib.face_num_verts[src_face],
13662 fc_count * sizeof(int));
13663 std::memmove(&attrib.material_ids[dst_face],
13664 &attrib.material_ids[src_face],
13665 fc_count * sizeof(int));
13666 if (any_smoothing) {
13667 std::memmove(&all_smoothing_group_ids[dst_face],
13668 &all_smoothing_group_ids[src_face],
13669 fc_count * sizeof(unsigned int));
13670 }
13671 }
13672 dst_idx += idx_count;
13673 dst_face += fc_count;
13674 }
13675 }
13676
13677 attrib.indices.truncate(actual_num_indices);
13678 attrib.face_num_verts.truncate(actual_num_faces);
13679 attrib.material_ids.truncate(actual_num_faces);
13680 if (any_smoothing) {
13681 all_smoothing_group_ids.truncate(actual_num_faces);
13682 attrib.smoothing_group_ids = all_smoothing_group_ids;
13683 }
13684
13685 opt_appendOutOfBoundsWarnings(
13686 warn, greatest_v_idx, greatest_vn_idx, greatest_vt_idx,
13687 static_cast<int>(attrib.vertices.size() / 3),
13688 static_cast<int>(attrib.normals.size() / 3),
13689 static_cast<int>(attrib.texcoords.size() / 2),
13690 all_line_infos.size() + 1);
13691 for (size_t deg = 0; deg < eof_pending_degenerate_faces; deg++) {
13692 if (warn) (*warn) += "Degenerated face found\n.";
13693 }
13694
13695 // ---- Phase 5: construct shape ranges (views, no copies) ----
13696 {
13697 const size_t total_faces = attrib.face_num_verts.size();
13698 // Build prefix-sum for index offsets
13699 TypedArray<size_t> idx_prefix;
13700 idx_prefix.allocate(arena, total_faces + 1);
13701 idx_prefix[0] = 0;
13702 for (size_t fi = 0; fi < total_faces; fi++) {
13703 idx_prefix[fi + 1] =
13704 idx_prefix[fi] + static_cast<size_t>(attrib.face_num_verts[fi]);
13705 }
13706
13707 size_t face_count = 0;
13708 std::string current_name;
13709 size_t face_prev_offset = 0;
13710 bool have_active_shape_name = false;
13711
13712 auto emit_shape = [&](const std::string &name, size_t f_start, size_t f_end) {
13713 if (f_end <= f_start) return;
13714 OptShapeRange sr;
13715 sr.name = name;
13716 sr.face_offset = f_start;
13717 sr.face_count = f_end - f_start;
13718 sr.index_offset = idx_prefix[f_start];
13719 sr.index_count = idx_prefix[f_end] - idx_prefix[f_start];
13720 result->shapes.push_back(std::move(sr));
13721 };
13722
13723 for (size_t t = 0; t < num_t; t++) {
13724 const OptThreadData &td = thread_data[t];
13725 for (size_t si = 0; si < td.seq.size(); si++) {
13726 const OptSeqEntry &entry = td.seq[si];
13727 if (entry.kind == OptSeqEntry::SEQ_META) {
13728 const OptMetaCmd &meta = td.metas[entry.index];
13729 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_O || meta.type == OPT_CMD_G) {
13730 std::string name;
13731 if (meta.type == OPT_CMD_O && meta.str_ptr) {
13732 name.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
13733 } else if (!meta.str_storage.empty()) {
13734 name = meta.str_storage;
13735 } else if (meta.str_ptr) {
13736 name.assign(meta.str_ptr, meta.str_len);
13737 }
13738 while (!name.empty() &&
13739 (name.back() == '\r' || name.back() == '\n'))
13740 name.pop_back();
13741
13742 if (face_count == 0) {
13743 current_name = name;
13744 face_prev_offset = 0;
13745 have_active_shape_name = true;
13746 } else {
13747 if (!have_active_shape_name) {
13748 emit_shape(std::string(), 0, face_count);
13749 } else if (face_count > face_prev_offset) {
13750 emit_shape(current_name, face_prev_offset, face_count);
13751 }
13752 current_name = name;
13753 face_prev_offset = face_count;
13754 have_active_shape_name = true;
13755 }
13756 }
13757 } else {
13758 // SEQ_FACE
13759 face_count += command_written_faces[t][entry.index];
13760 }
13761 }
13762 }
13763
13764 // Final shape
13765 if (face_count > face_prev_offset || face_count == 0) {
13766 emit_shape(current_name, face_prev_offset, face_count);
13767 }
13768 }
13769
13770 result->valid = true;
13771 return true;
13772}

13774// ---- LoadObjOptTyped (buffer version, public API) ----
13775
13776OptResult LoadObjOptTyped(const char *buf, size_t buf_len,
13777 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
13778 const OptLoadConfig &config) {
13779 OptResult result;
13780 LoadObjOptTyped_internal(&result, warn, err, buf, buf_len,
13781 std::string(), "<stream>", false, config);
13782 return result;
13783}
13784
13785// ---- LoadObjOptTyped (file version) ----
13786
13787OptResult LoadObjOptTyped(const char *filename,
13788 std::string *warn, std::string *err,
13789 const char *mtl_basedir,
13790 const OptLoadConfig &config) {
13791 OptResult result;
13792 if (!filename) {
13793 if (err) *err = "filename is null.";
13794 return result;
13795 }
13796
13797 std::string filepath(filename);
13798 std::string baseDir;
13799 if (mtl_basedir) {
13800 baseDir = mtl_basedir;
13801 } else {
13802 size_t pos = filepath.find_last_of("/\\");
13803 if (pos != std::string::npos) {
13804 baseDir = filepath.substr(0, pos + 1);
13805 }
13806 }
13807 if (!baseDir.empty()) {
13808#ifndef _WIN32
13809 const char dirsep = '/';
13810#else
13811 const char dirsep = '\\';
13812#endif
13813 if (baseDir[baseDir.length() - 1] != dirsep) baseDir += dirsep;
13814 }
13815
13816#ifdef TINYOBJLOADER_USE_MMAP
13817 {
13818 MappedFile mf;
13819 if (mf.open(filepath.c_str())) {
13820 LoadObjOptTyped_internal(&result, warn, err, mf.data, mf.size,
13821 baseDir, filepath, true, config);
13822 return result;
13823 }
13824 }
13825#endif
13826
13827#ifdef _WIN32
13828 std::ifstream ifs(LongPathW(UTF8ToWchar(filepath)).c_str(),
13829 std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
13830#else
13831 std::ifstream ifs(filepath.c_str(), std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
13832#endif
13833 if (!ifs.is_open()) {
13834 if (err) *err = "Cannot open file: " + filepath;
13835 return result;
13836 }
13837
13838 std::streamsize fsize = ifs.tellg();
13839 ifs.seekg(0, std::ios::beg);
13840
13841 if (fsize <= 0) {
13842 LoadObjOptTyped_internal(&result, warn, err, "", 0,
13843 baseDir, filepath, true, config);
13844 return result;
13845 }
13846
13847 std::vector<char> file_buf(static_cast<size_t>(fsize));
13848 if (!ifs.read(file_buf.data(), fsize)) {
13849 if (err) *err = "Failed to read file: " + filepath;
13850 return result;
13851 }
13852 ifs.close();
13853
13854 LoadObjOptTyped_internal(&result, warn, err, file_buf.data(),
13855 static_cast<size_t>(fsize), baseDir, filepath,
13856 true, config);
13857 return result;
13858}
